armA.definition: Used to ask people to listen to important information or an order.
armA.arabic: كلمة بتتقال بصوت عالي عشان الناس تسكت وتركز، زي 'انتباه!'.
examples: Attention please!
Attention! The store is closing in five minutes.
Ladies and gentlemen, may I have your attention?
Attention all passengers, the train is delayed.
Attention to detail is critical in this job.
Attention! Company, halt!
armA.mnemonic: زي لما الضابط يقول للعساكر 'Attention' 'انتباه' عشان يوقفوا ثابت.

armB.definition: Said loudly to tell people to listen, watch, or stand straight in a formal situation.
armB.arabic: صيغة نداء أو أمر تقال بصوت عال لجذب انتباه الحاضرين أو تنبيههم للاستماع، وتستخدم كثيرا في السياقات الرسمية والعسكرية.
examples: Attention, please! The flight to Rome is now boarding.
The officer shouted, "Attention!" and all the soldiers stood up straight.
Attention, everyone, we need to begin the meeting immediately.
armB.mnemonic: تذكر بداية الكلمة أت مثل إشارة لتنبيه شخص ليسمع ما ستقوله بصوت مرتفع عند النداء في المطار أو الطابور

armA.definition: A small piece of stiff paper or plastic used for identification, payment, or sending greetings.
armA.arabic: قطعة صغيرة مستطيلة من البلاستيك أو الورق المقوى، تستخدم للدفع المالي، إثبات الهوية، أو إرسال المعايدات.
examples: You can pay with cash or a credit card.
She sent me a lovely birthday card.
Please show your identity card at the entrance.
armA.mnemonic: تذكر كلمة كارت الشائعة في العامية للدفع أو الهوية فهي مطابقة تماما للكلمة الإنجليزية "card"

armB.definition: A small rectangular piece of stiff paper or plastic used for various purposes.
armB.arabic: قطعة ورق مقوى أو بلاستيك، زي كارت البنك، أو كروت اللعب، أو كارت المعايدة.
examples: I sent a birthday card to my mom.
Can I pay by credit card?
He showed his ID card to the guard.
Pick a card from the deck.
She played her cards right to get the promotion.
The organization holds all the cards in this negotiation.
armB.mnemonic: شبه كلمة 'Cart' 'عربية تسوق'.. عشان تشتري بالـ 'Cart' محتاج 'Card' تدفع بيه.

armA.definition: Travelling through a place on the way to another, or using a particular medium or person.
armA.arabic: حرف جر يعني المرور بمكان في طريقك إلى وجهة أخرى، أو إنجاز أمر باستخدام وسيلة أو شخص معين كواسطة.
examples: We flew to Sydney via Singapore.
You can send the official application via email.
She heard about the job opening via a mutual friend.
armA.mnemonic: تذكر انها كلمة لاتينية تعني طريقا، تماما مثل الطرق الرومانية القديمة التي تسير من خلالها لتصل إلى غايتك.

armB.definition: Traveling through a place on the way to a destination, or by means of.
armB.arabic: إنك تروح مكان عن طريق مكان تاني، أو تعمل حاجة بواسطة أداة معينة.
examples: I went home via the park.
He sent the message via email.
We are flying to Tokyo via Dubai.
The news was broadcast via satellite to millions.
She achieved success via a highly unconventional route.
The disease is transmitted via respiratory droplets in the air.

armA.definition: The speed or frequency at which an event happens over a particular period.
armA.arabic: المعدل أو السرعة التي يحدث بها شيء ما خلال فترة زمنية محددة، مثل معدل السرعة أو النمو.
examples: The car was moving at a very high rate of speed.
What is the daily rate for this hotel room?
The country has a low unemployment rate this year.
armA.mnemonic: تذكر كلمة "rate" بربطها بكلمة رتبة او ترتيب لمعرفة قياس او معدل الشيء بمقارنته مع الزمن او السعر

armB.definition: A measurement of the speed, cost, or frequency of something.
armB.arabic: معدل أو نسبة. زي لما تقول سرعة دقات القلب، أو سعر الفايدة، أو تقييم لحاجة معينة
examples: The heart rate increases when you run.
What is the hourly rate for this job?
The crime rate has fallen this year.
Interest rates are very low right now.
The rate of inflation is worrying economists.
At this rate, we will never finish on time.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'Rate' قريبة من 'راتب'.. والراتب هو 'Rate' بتتحاسب عليه كل شهر

armA.definition: Most important, successful, or advanced.
armA.arabic: صفة بتوصف الشيء أو الشخص اللي في المقدمة، يعني الأهم أو الأنجح في مجاله.
examples: He is a leading player.
She played the leading role in the play.
Heart disease is a leading cause of death.
They are the leading experts in this field.
The leading edge of technology changes rapidly.
He asked a leading question to trap the witness.
armA.mnemonic: جاية من 'Lead' 'يقود'.. فالـ 'Leading' هو القائد أو المتصدر.

armB.definition: Most important, best, or in first place among others.
armB.arabic: يصف الشيء او الشخص الذي يحتل المركز الاول او الاكثر اهمية وتاثيرا بين الاخرين.
examples: She is one of the leading scientists in cancer research.
The company became a leading producer of electric cars.
He played a leading role in negotiating the peace agreement.
armB.mnemonic: تذكر ان القائد "leader" يسير دائما في المقدمة لذلك تصف كلمة "leading" الشيء الابرز او الاكثر اهمية في مجاله.

armA.definition: At a high speed or without taking much time.
armA.arabic: بسرعة أو دون إضاعة الكثير من الوقت؛ يُستخدم لوصف حركة أو فعل يتم في وقت قصير.
examples: He walked quickly to catch the bus.
Please finish your breakfast quickly so we can leave.
She learned the rules of the game very quickly.
armA.mnemonic: تذكر صوت نقرة الفأرة كليك الذي يتم في لحظة سريعة يشبه نطق كلمة "quickly" ليعبر عن السرعة.

armB.definition: At a fast speed; rapidly.
armB.arabic: بسرعة.. لما تعمل حاجة في وقت قليل.
examples: Come here quickly!
She walked quickly to the shop.
The disease spread quickly through the village.
We need to act quickly to solve this problem.
The situation deteriorated more quickly than expected.
He quickly grasped the complexity of the philosophical argument.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'Quick' يعني سريع.. ومشروب 'Nesquik' بيتعمل 'Quickly' بسرعة.

armA.definition: Something that you say or write formally to give information.
armA.arabic: كلام رسمي بتقوله أو بتكتبه عشان توضح معلومة أو تعلن عن حاجة.
examples: The police made a statement.
Is that a true statement?
I received my bank statement today.
The prime minister issued a statement regarding the crisis.
Her dress made a bold fashion statement.
The artist's work is a powerful political statement against war.
armA.mnemonic: جاية من 'State' يعني يصرّح.. فالـ 'Statement' هو التصريح نفسه.

armB.definition: Something that someone says or writes formally to give facts or information.
armB.arabic: كلام أو نص رسمي يقال أو يكتب لتوضيح حقيقة أو إعطاء معلومة محددة.
examples: Is that a question or a statement?
The police asked her to write a short statement.
The company issued a formal statement about the problem.
armB.mnemonic: تذكر الفعل state بمعنى يصرح أو يوضح وعند إضافة ment يصبح الاسم statement أي تصريح أو بيان رسمي

armA.definition: In, at, or to this place or current location.
armA.arabic: يستخدم للإشارة إلى المكان الذي يتواجد فيه المتحدث الآن، أي هذا الموضع القريب.
examples: Please sit here next to me.
I have lived here for five years.
Put the groceries here on the kitchen counter.
armA.mnemonic: تذكر ان كلمة "here" موجودة حرفيا داخل كلمة "where" فإذا حذفت الواو من اين حصلت على هنا

armB.definition: In, at, or to this place or position.
armB.arabic: هنا، في المكان اللي إحنا فيه دلوقتي.
examples: Come here.
I live near here.
Here is the money I owe you.
Look here, we need to solve this problem.
Here lies the difficulty of the situation.
Herein lies the proof of his innocence.
armB.mnemonic: نفس نطق 'Hear' يسمع.. أنا قادر أسمعك 'Here' في المكان ده.

armA.definition: A thing or person that is being discussed, described, or dealt with; a field of study.
armA.arabic: الموضوع اللي بنتكلم فيه، أو المادة الدراسية اللي بتدرسها في المدرسة زي التاريخ أو العلوم.
examples: Math is my favorite subject.
We changed the subject of the conversation.
History is an interesting subject to study.
The email had no subject line.
The subject of the painting is a young woman.
The ethics of AI is a complex subject involving philosophy and technology.
armA.mnemonic: الـ 'Subject' هو الموضوع أو المادة.. افتكر إنك بتفتح الـ 'Sub'-way عشان تختار الـ 'Subject' اللي هتاكله.

armB.definition: An area of knowledge studied in school, or a thing being discussed or written about.
armB.arabic: المادة الدراسية التي يتعلمها الطالب في المدرسة، أو الموضوع الأساسي الذي نتحدث أو نكتب عنه.
examples: English is my favorite school subject.
We talked about a new subject during the meeting.
The teacher changed the subject after the bell rang.
armB.mnemonic: تذكر بداية الكلمة sub بمعنى تحت و ject بمعنى يلقي، كأنه الشيء المطروح تحت النقاش أو للدراسة على الطاولة.

armA.definition: Weighing a lot and difficult to lift or carry.
armA.arabic: يصف الشيء الذي له وزن كبير ويصعب حمله أو رفعه، ويستخدم أيضا لوصف الأمور الكثيفة أو الشديدة.
examples: This suitcase is too heavy for me to carry upstairs.
Drive carefully because there is heavy rain on the road.
We were stuck in heavy traffic for two hours this morning.
armA.mnemonic: تخيل كلمة "heavy" مرتبطة برفع شيء ضخم يسقط على الأرض بقوة ويحدث صوتا قويا يجعلك تتأوه من ثقله.

armB.definition: Of great weight; difficult to lift or move.
armB.arabic: حاجة وزنها تقيل وصعب تشيلها، أو حاجة كميتها كبيرة.
examples: This box is very heavy.
There was heavy rain yesterday.
Traffic is heavy this morning.
He paid a heavy price for his mistake.
The air was heavy with the scent of flowers.
The novel is a bit heavy going for casual readers.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'Heave' يعني يرفع بصعوبة.. الحاجة الـ 'Heavy' محتاجة 'Heave'.

armA.definition: An amount or number that is twice as large as another.
armA.arabic: مقدار أو عدد يساوي ضعف كمية أخرى أو مثليها.
examples: He asked for five dollars, but I gave him double.
She earned ten pounds yesterday, and today she made double.
If you buy two shirts, the total cost will be double.
armA.mnemonic: تذكر كلمة دبل الشائعة في العامية للدلالة على الشيء المضاعف مرتين

armB.definition: A thing or person that is the same as another; twice the quantity.
armB.arabic: حاجة أو شخص شبه التاني بالظبط، أو كمية مضاعفة.
examples: Give me a double.
He is the double of his father.
Make that a double, please.
She acted as a double for the actress.
His body double did the dangerous stunts.
To pay double is unfair.

armA.definition: A girl or woman who shares the same parents as another person.
armA.arabic: الأخت هي الفتاة أو المرأة التي تشترك مع شخص آخر في نفس الأب والأم أو أحدهما.
examples: My older sister helps me with my homework every evening.
Do you have a brother or a sister?
She looks very much like her twin sister.
armA.mnemonic: تذكر ان كلمة "sister" تشبه كلمة "sit" فالاخت تجلس دائما بجانبك وتشاركك الحديث والالعاب.

armB.definition: A girl or woman who has the same parents as another person.
armB.arabic: البنت اللي ليها نفس الأب والأم معاك، فرد من العيلة أقرب ما يكون ليك.
examples: I have one sister.
My older sister lives in Paris.
She is like a sister to me.
The two cities are sister cities.
The nuns in the convent are called sisters.
We must fight for the rights of our sisters around the world.
armB.mnemonic: تشبه 'Sista' بالعامية.. هي أختك اللي من نفس الأب والأم.

armA.definition: The state of existing, or any living creature such as a person or animal.
armA.arabic: الوجود كحالة عامة للحياة والتحقق، أو الكائن الحي في حد ذاته سواء كان إنسانا أو مخلوقا آخر.
examples: Every living being deserves respect and care.
Scientists wonder if any alien being could survive in such harsh conditions.
The poem explores the mystery of human being and consciousness.
armA.mnemonic: تذكر ان الفعل be يعني يكون، وبإضافة ing يتحول الى اسم ليعبر عن الكائن او الوجود نفسه.

armB.definition: Existence, or a living creature (especially a person).
armB.arabic: كلمة ليها معنيين: يا إما الكائن نفسه زي 'Human being'، يا إما الوجود نفسه والكيان الداخلي للشخص.
examples: A human being needs water to survive.
We are all human beings.
Strange beings from another planet landed here.
The organization came into being last year.
She felt it with every fiber of her being.
Philosophers have debated the nature of being for centuries.
armB.mnemonic: جاية من الفعل 'Be' 'يكون'.. الـ 'Being' هو الكينونة أو الكائن نفسه اللي 'موجود'.

armA.definition: A person trained and licensed to treat sick or injured people.
armA.arabic: شخص مؤهل طبيا لعلاج المرضى والمصابين وتقديم الرعاية الصحية لهم.
examples: I feel sick, so I need to see a doctor today.
The doctor told him to rest and drink plenty of water.
She decided to train hard and become a hospital doctor.
armA.mnemonic: تذكر ان الكلمة الانجليزية "doctor" شائعة جدا ومستخدمة مباشرة في كلامنا اليومي باللغة العربية بنفس المعنى تماما وهو دكتور او طبيب

armB.definition: A person with a medical degree whose job is to treat sick people.
armB.arabic: الشخص اللي بيعالج الناس العيانة.
examples: I need to see a doctor.
The doctor gave me some medicine.
You should go to the doctor for a check-up.
She is studying to become a doctor.
He is a doctor of physics, not medicine.
The doctor's prognosis was grim but accurate.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'Doctor' هي نفسها 'دكتور' بالعربي.

armA.definition: Relating to physical objects rather than the mind or spirit.
armA.arabic: حاجة مادية ملموسة، مش معنوية أو روحية.
examples: We live in a material world.
His material needs were met.
She is not interested in material possessions.
The storm caused significant material damage.
They focused on material gain rather than ethics.
Dialectical materialism is a philosophical concept.
armA.mnemonic: قريبة من 'Matter' 'مادة'.. الـ 'Material' هو الشيء المادي.

armB.definition: Important enough to influence a decision or outcome; having significant relevance.
armB.arabic: يُقصد به في السياق الرسمي أو القانوني الشيء المهم والمؤثر جدا في القرار أو النتيجة، أو الشيء المادي الملموس بدلا من الروحي.
examples: The witness provided material evidence that changed the course of the trial.
There was a material change in the company's financial status this quarter.
She cared more about intellectual growth than material comfort.
armB.mnemonic: تذكر كلمة matter التي تعني مسألة مهمة، فالصفة material تعني شيئا هاما وحاسما في القرار أو شيئا واقعيا ملموسا.

armA.definition: Used to identify a specific person, thing, or idea that is close in space, time, or focus.
armA.arabic: اسم إشارة يُستعمل للإشارة إلى مفرد قريب من المتكلم مكانياً أو زمنياً، بمعنى هذا أو هذه.
examples: I really like this jacket.
We need to finish this report before noon.
Is this seat taken?
armA.mnemonic: تذكر ان كلمة "this" تبدأ بصوت يشبه حرف الذال في اسم الإشارة العربي ذا او هذه للإشارة إلى الشيء القريب منك مباشرة.

armB.definition: Used to identify a specific person or thing close at hand.
armB.arabic: أداة تحديد بتيجي قبل الاسم عشان توضح إننا بنتكلم عن 'هذا' الشيء القريب.
examples: I like this car.
This week has been busy.
We need to solve this problem.
In this country, people drive on the left.
At this point in time, we cannot comment.
Under this particular interpretation, the law is invalid.

armA.definition: A television station and its programs, or a specific medium through which messages are sent.
armA.arabic: محطة تلفزيونية أو إذاعية معينة، أو مسار ووسيلة تُنقل عبرها المعلومات أو الرسائل.
examples: Could you change the channel on the TV to watch the evening news?
Email is the main channel of communication between teachers and parents.
The company created a new YouTube channel to share cooking tutorials.
armA.mnemonic: تذكر كلمة "channel" التي تشبه صوت تشانيل كأنك تقلب بين قنوات التلفزيون لتشاهد برنامجك المفضل

armB.definition: A television station, or a path through which water or information flows.
armB.arabic: محطة تلفزيون، أو مسار بتمشي فيه الماية، أو حتى طريقة لتوصيل المعلومات.
examples: What is your favorite TV channel?
Change the channel, please.
We need an open channel of communication.
The water flows through a narrow channel.
They directed the funds through official government channels.
The English Channel has historically served as a formidable defensive barrier.
armB.mnemonic: اربطها بكلمة 'Channel' في التلفزيون.. هي مَسار بتوصلك منه المَعلومة.

armA.definition: An oily substance found in animal bodies and plant seeds, essential in food and nutrition.
armA.arabic: مادة دهنية تتواجد في أجسام الكائنات الحية والنباتات، وتعتبر مصدرا هاما للطاقة في الغذاء.
examples: This milk has thirty percent less fat than regular milk.
You should trim the excess fat from the meat before cooking.
Exercise helps your body burn fat more efficiently.
armA.mnemonic: تذكر ان كلمة "fat" تشبه في نطقها كلمة فت بالعامية كانك تفت الخبز المشبع بالسمن والدهن.

armB.definition: A natural oily or greasy substance in animal bodies or food.
armB.arabic: الدهون اللي موجودة في الأكل أو في جسم الإنسان والحيوان.
examples: This meat has a lot of fat.
Butter is mostly made of fat.
I am trying to burn excess body fat.
Vegetable fats are often healthier than animal fats.
The chef trimmed the excess fat from the steak.
Fat is essential for absorbing certain vitamins.
armB.mnemonic: نفس كلمة 'Fat' الصفة، بس هنا معناها المادة نفسها 'الدهون' اللي بتخلي الواحد 'Fat'.

armA.definition: Existing or happening before something else in time or order.
armA.arabic: حاجة بتحصل قبل حاجة تانية في الوقت، أو حاجة ليها أولوية ومجهزة من بدري.
examples: I had no prior knowledge of the test.
Please give us prior notice if you cancel.
He denied the charges due to a prior agreement.
The contract requires prior approval from the manager.
Prior to the revolution, the economy was stable.
The court considered his prior convictions before sentencing.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Prior' شبه 'Prayer' 'الصلاة'.. والصلاة دايماً 'Prior' 'سابقة' ولها الأولوية قبل أي شغل.

armB.definition: Happening or existing before something else, or before a particular time.
armB.arabic: يصف شيئا حدث أو وجد في وقت سابق قبل شيء آخر، وغالبا ما يستخدم للإشارة إلى تجربة أو اتفاق سابق.
examples: She had no prior experience in teaching before taking the job.
The visit was arranged without prior notice.
You must obtain written permission prior to entering the site.
armB.mnemonic: تذكر كلمة "priority" اي اولوية فالشيء الذي يكون "prior" يسبق غيره في الوقت او الاهمية

armA.definition: An animal that lives in water, breathes with gills, and usually has fins and scales.
armA.arabic: حيوان مائي يعيش في الماء ويتنفس بالخياشيم، وله زعانف وحراشف، ويطلق أيضا على لحمه كطعام.
examples: Many colorful fish swim in the warm ocean.
We ordered grilled fish with rice for dinner.
He kept a small gold fish in a glass bowl.
armA.mnemonic: تذكر كلمة "fish" عبر صوت الفاء والشين الذي يشبه حركة الماء السريعة حين تسبح سمكة وتختفي فجأة.

armB.definition: An animal that lives in water, has fins and scales, and breathes through gills.
armB.arabic: الكائن البحري اللي بيعيش في الماية وبناكله.
examples: I like to eat fish.
The fish swam in the bowl.
We saw many colorful fish in the reef.
There are plenty more fish in the sea.
He felt like a fish out of water.
The taxonomy of these tropical fish is complex.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة سهلة وكلنا عارفينها.. 'Fish' يعني سمكة.

armA.definition: With the addition of; together with.
armA.arabic: بنستخدمها لما نكون بنضيف حاجة لحاجة تانية، بمعنى 'زائد' أو 'وكمان'.
examples: One plus one equals two.
The cost is $10 plus tax.
I have three meetings plus a lunch appointment.
The hotel offers breakfast plus free Wi-Fi.
Intelligence plus ambition is a powerful combination.
The salary includes a base rate plus a commission on sales.

armB.definition: Together with or added to another amount or thing.
armB.arabic: حرف جر يعني بالاضافة الى شيء آخر او مضافا اليه في العمليات الحسابية والجمع.
examples: Two plus three equals five.
The hotel room costs ninety dollars plus local taxes.
She has exceptional experience plus great communication skills.
armB.mnemonic: تذكر علامة الجمع المعروفة في الرياضيات باللغة الانجليزية، فكلمة "plus" تعني دائما زيادة او اضافة شيء الى شيء آخر.

armA.definition: Coming after the third in a series.
armA.arabic: الرابع في الترتيب، اللي بيجي بعد التالت.
examples: It is his fourth birthday.
They live on the fourth floor.
This is the fourth time I've seen this movie.
The fourth of July is a holiday in the US.
The press is often called the fourth estate.
He broke the fourth wall in his performance.
armA.mnemonic: جاية من 'Four' 'أربعة'.. يبقى 'Fourth' يعني الرابع

armB.definition: Coming immediately after the third item, person, or position in an ordered series.
armB.arabic: يصف الترتيب الذي يأتي مباشرة بعد الثالث في سلسلة عددية أو زمنية.
examples: This is our fourth day in the city.
She finished in fourth place in the race.
They live on the fourth floor of this building.
armB.mnemonic: تذكر الرقم اربعة وهو "four" مضافا اليه صوت الثاء "th" ليتحول من عدد الى ترتيب الرابع.

armA.definition: To include someone or something as an important, noticeable, or special part.
armA.arabic: يتضمن او يبرز شخصا او شيئا كعنصر رئيسي او مهم في عمل فني، مجلة، او حدث.
examples: Does the concert feature local musicians?
Many magazines feature stories about successful entrepreneurs.
They will feature the new technology in next month's exhibition.
armA.mnemonic: تذكر ان كلمة "feature" ترتبط بملامح الوجه البارزة، وكذلك كفعل تعني إبراز او تسليط الضوء على شيء بارز ومميز في العرض.

armB.definition: To include someone or something as an important part.
armB.arabic: إنك تبرز حاجة أو تخليها جزء أساسي ومهم في العرض.
examples: The show features a dog.
This week's magazine features a story on health.
The exhibition features paintings by Picasso.
The new album features several guest artists.
The conference will feature speakers from around the world.
The landscape is featured prominently in her novels.
armB.mnemonic: لما الفيلم يـ 'Feature' ممثل، يعني بيخليه هو 'الميزة' الأساسية.

armA.definition: A detailed plan showing how much money an individual or organization expects to earn and spend.
armA.arabic: خطة مالية تحدد مقدار الأموال المتوقع كسبها وإنفاقها خلال فترة محددة.
examples: We need to set a strict budget for home renovations.
The marketing department exceeded its annual budget by ten percent.
The government proposed a revised federal budget to tackle the rising deficit.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة "budget" جاءت تاريخيا من كلمة فرنسية قديمة تعني كيس النقود الصغير، فتخيل كيسا صغيرا تضع فيه مبلغا محددا لا يمكنك تجاوزه.

armB.definition: An estimate of income and expenditure for a set period of time.
armB.arabic: الميزانية، يعني الخطة اللي بتحطها لفلوسك، هتقبض كام وهتصرف كام في وقت معين.
examples: I have a small budget.
The holiday was over budget.
We need to stick to our monthly budget.
The government announced the new annual budget.
They are operating on a shoestring budget.
Budget constraints forced them to cancel the project.
armB.mnemonic: زمان كانوا بيحطوا الفلوس في 'Bag' شنطة.. كلمة 'Budget' جاية من أصل الكلمة دي.

armA.definition: A large area of land in the country that is owned by a family or an organization.
armA.arabic: ممتلكات كبيرة زي الأراضي والبيوت، أو كل الفلوس والأملاك اللي بيسيبها الشخص بعد وفاته.
examples: He lives on a big estate.
We visited a country estate.
She works in real estate.
The family estate was sold to pay debts.
His estate was divided among his children.
The landed estate system was central to the region's history.
armA.mnemonic: شبه كلمة 'State' 'دولة'.. الـ 'Estate' الكبيرة بتبقى زي دولة صغيرة لصحابها

armB.definition: A large area of land in the country, usually with one substantial house, owned by one person.
armB.arabic: مساحة واسعة من الأرض غالبا في الريف تضم منزلا كبيرا وتملكها جهة واحدة أو شخص واحد، وتطلق أيضا على مجمل ممتلكات وأموال الشخص المتوفى.
examples: The wealthy family owns a vast country estate with gardens and a lake.
After his death, his entire estate was divided equally among his three children.
They decided to buy a house in a newly built housing estate outside the city.
armB.mnemonic: تذكر كلمة "state" اي دولة او ولاية، والكلمة تبدأ بحرف e كأنها قطعة ارض واسعة ومستقلة مثل دويلة صغيرة

armA.definition: A thing that is or may be chosen.
armA.arabic: خيار أو بديل، حاجة ممكن تختارها من وسط حاجات تانية.
examples: I have no other option.
Select an option from the menu.
Going by train is a good option.
We are keeping our options open.
Stock options are part of the salary package.
It was the soft option, but he took it anyway.
armA.mnemonic: جاية من 'Opt' 'يختار'.. لما يكون عندك 'Option' يعني عندك حرية الاختيار.

armB.definition: Something that you can choose to have or do among different possibilities.
armB.arabic: شيء متاح لك لاختياره من بين عدة بدائل ممكنة، أي خيار أو بديل.
examples: You have the option to pay by cash or credit card.
Staying at home was not an option for us.
Surgery is considered the best option in this case.
armB.mnemonic: تذكر كلمة "opt" التي تعني يختار في الانجليزية، واضافة "ion" تجعلها اسما يعني خيار أو بديل متاح.

armA.definition: Located at the lowest point, level, or position of something.
armA.arabic: يصف الشيء الموجود في أدنى موضع أو في أسفل مكان مقارنة بغيره، مثل الدرج السفلي أو الرف الأخير.
examples: She put the heavy books on the bottom shelf.
Please sign your name on the bottom line of the page.
He tripped on the bottom step and fell.
armA.mnemonic: تذكر ان الكلمة تبدا بحرف b وهو يشبه الاتجاه نحو الاسفل عكس حرف d او فكر في زر الحذاء السفلي

armB.definition: In the lowest position; lowest.
armB.arabic: صفة للحاجة اللي تحت خالص، في أقل مستوى.
examples: Look at the bottom shelf.
Write your name on the bottom line.
The bottom drawer is stuck.
He paid the bottom price for the car.
The bottom rung of the ladder was broken.
They reached the bottom depths of the ocean.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'Bottom' شبه 'بطن'.. والبطن تحت الصدر، يعني في الجزء الأسفل.

armA.definition: Involving or affecting large numbers of people or things.
armA.arabic: حاجة بتحصل بشكل جماعي أو بتشمل عدد كبير جداً من الناس في نفس الوقت.
examples: They sell to the mass market.
Mass production makes cars cheaper.
The weapon can cause mass destruction.
There was mass hysteria when the star arrived.
The government fears mass unemployment.
We are witnessing a mass exodus of refugees.
armA.mnemonic: زي 'Mass production'.. إنتاج 'Mass' يعني إنتاج لكميات ضخمة لكل الناس.

armB.definition: Involving or affecting a very large number of people or things at the same time.
armB.arabic: يصف شيئا يحدث على نطاق واسع جدا ويشمل او يستهدف اعدادا هائلة من الناس او الاشياء دفعة واحدة.
examples: The government launched a mass vaccination campaign to protect citizens against the virus.
Improved technology led to the mass production of affordable home appliances.
The new subway line is an essential form of mass transit for daily commuters.
armB.mnemonic: تذكر كلمة ماسة واعتبر ان العمل الذي يحضره جمع غفير كأنه يحتاج بريقا كبيرا كحجر الماس ليراه الجميع

armA.definition: The cardinal number one thousand million.
armA.arabic: رقم المليار.
examples: China has over one billion people.
That company is worth two billion.
Three billion years ago, life began.
They sold five billion units.
The cost is estimated at several billion euros.
We are looking at a timescale of a billion years.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Bill' يعني فاتورة.. تخيل فاتورة بـ 'Billion' دولار

armB.definition: The number equal to one thousand million, written as 1,000,000,000.
armB.arabic: العدد الذي يساوي ألف مليون، ويُكتب في النظام العشري بواحد يتبعه تسعة أصفار، ويُسمى مليار أو بليون.
examples: The company earned over one billion dollars last year.
The world population is now well over eight billion people.
Scientists estimate the age of the Earth at over four billion years.
armB.mnemonic: تذكر ان كلمة "billion" تبدا بالمقطع bi الذي يعني اثنين للدلالة على مضاعفة ملايين المليون تاريخيا، وهي تشبه في العربية كلمة بليون او مليار.

armA.definition: A net of thin threads made by a spider to catch insects.
armA.arabic: شبكة خيوط دقيقة ورفيعة ينسجها العنكبوت لاصطياد الحشرات، وتستخدم المجازات المشتقة منها للإشارة إلى شبكة الإنترنت أو الشبكات المعقدة.
examples: A tiny spider made a web in the corner of the room.
Morning dew covered the silk web outside our window.
You can find extensive information across the global web.
armA.mnemonic: تذكر ان كلمة "web" تشبه صوت بداية "website"، لان شبكة الانترنت مستوحاة اساسا من خيوط العنكبوت المتشابكة.

armB.definition: A network of fine threads made by a spider; the Internet.
armB.arabic: شبكة خيوط بيعملها العنكبوت، أو شبكة الإنترنت اللي بتربط العالم ببعضه.
examples: The spider made a web.
I search on the web.
Flies get caught in the spider's web.
The web of lies he told eventually collapsed.
It is a complex web of political alliances.
The duck's webbed feet help it swim efficiently.
armB.mnemonic: شبكة العنكبوت أو الـ 'Web' سايت.

armA.definition: To make something free from water or liquid.
armA.arabic: إنك تنشف حاجة وتشيل منها المية.
examples: Dry your hands on the towel.
The sun will dry the clothes.
I need to dry my hair.
The wood needs time to dry out.
The tears dried on her cheeks.
The soil has dried up completely due to the drought.
armA.mnemonic: نفس الاسم، 'Dry' يعني ينشف.

armB.definition: To remove water or moisture from something, or to become free of liquid.
armB.arabic: يجفف شيئا بإزالة الماء أو الرطوبة منه، أو يجف ويفقد بلله بنفسه.
examples: Please hang your wet coat outside so it can dry.
You can dry your hands with this clean towel.
The hot summer sun will quickly dry the freshly washed clothes.

armA.definition: Relating to the nucleus of an atom or cell; relating to nuclear energy or weapons.
armA.arabic: نووي، متعلق بالطاقة النووية أو النواة.
examples: Nuclear power is strong.
They discussed nuclear energy.
The country has nuclear weapons.
Nuclear waste is a big problem.
The nuclear family consists of parents and children.
Nuclear fusion could solve our energy crisis.
armA.mnemonic: من 'Nucleus' 'نواة'.

armB.definition: Relating to the energy released when atoms are split or joined together.
armB.arabic: صفة تشير إلى ما يتعلق بالطاقة أو الأسلحة الناتجة عن شطر نواة الذرة أو دمجها، أو ما يرتبط بنواة الذرة عموما.
examples: Many countries use nuclear power to generate electricity.
World leaders met to discuss the threat of nuclear weapons.
A typical nuclear family consists of parents and their children living together.
armB.mnemonic: تذكر كلمة "nucleus" التي تعني نواة الذرة فكلمة "nuclear" هي الصفة منها وتشير إلى كل ما يتعلق بالنواة وطاقتها.

armA.definition: Two things of the same kind that are used together, or an object with two joined parts.
armA.arabic: زوج من شيئين متماثلين يستعملان معا مثل حذاءين، أو شيء واحد يتكون من جزأين متصلين كالمقص أو النظارة.
examples: I bought a new pair of shoes yesterday.
She needs a pair of scissors to cut the paper.
They worked as a pair to complete the science project.
armA.mnemonic: تذكر كلمة "pair" بأنها تشبه لفظ كلمة بير في العربية، لكن تخيل شخصين يرتديان نفس الحذاء ويجلسان بجانب بئر ماء.

armB.definition: Two things that are used together or are similar.
armB.arabic: حاجتين بييجوا مع بعض دايماً زي الجزمة 'فردتين' أو اتنين صحاب لازقين لبعض.
examples: I need a new pair of shoes.
They are a happy pair.
She has three pairs of glasses.
Work in pairs to solve the problem.
The pair of swans mated for life.
A pair of aces is a good hand in poker.
armB.mnemonic: قريبة من 'Pear' 'كمثرى' اللي غالباً بتتاكل اتنين اتنين.. الـ 'Pair' يعني اتنين من حاجة.

armA.definition: A serious, unexpected, and dangerous situation requiring immediate action.
armA.arabic: حالة طارئة وخطيرة بتحصل فجأة ولازم نتصرف فيها بسرعة جداً، زي الحوادث أو الحريق.
examples: Call 911 in an emergency.
Use the emergency exit if there is a fire.
The pilot made an emergency landing.
She keeps a flashlight for emergencies.
The government declared a state of emergency.
The hospital has a contingency plan for handling civil emergencies.
armA.mnemonic: جاية من فعل 'Emerge' 'يظهر فجأة'.. الـ 'Emergency' هي المشكلة اللي بتظهر فجأة ومحتاجة حل.

armB.definition: A sudden, serious, and dangerous situation that requires immediate action to deal with it.
armB.arabic: حالة طارئة وخطيرة تحدث فجأة وتتطلب تدخلا ومساعدة سريعة لحماية الأرواح أو الممتلكات.
examples: In case of an emergency, call nine one one immediately.
The hospital opened an extra ward to cope with the medical emergency.
The pilot had to make an emergency landing after the engine failed.
armB.mnemonic: تذكر الفعل emerge ويعني يظهر فجأة، فالأمر الطارئ emergency هو حدث مفاجئ يظهر دون سابق إنذار ويتطلب تحركا سريعا.

armA.definition: Correct, suitable, or acceptable according to social rules, standards, or conventions.
armA.arabic: يصف الشيء بأنه ملائم وصحيح ومقبول اجتماعيا أو متوافق مع القواعد والمعايير الصحيحة.
examples: Make sure you wear proper shoes for walking in the mountains.
He did not receive proper medical care after the accident.
It is not considered proper to arrive late without notifying your host.
armA.mnemonic: تذكر كلمة "property" اي الملكية الخاصة، فالشيء الذي يكون "proper" هو الذي في مكانه الصحيح ويخص المعيار السليم تماما.

armB.definition: Truly what something is said or regarded to be; genuine or appropriate.
armB.arabic: مناسب أو صحيح.. الحاجة المضبوطة اللي المفروض تتعمل بالشكل الصح.
examples: This is the proper way.
Please put it in the proper place.
You need the proper tools for the job.
It is not proper to speak like that to your boss.
Without proper authorization, you cannot enter.
Technically, the suburbs are not part of the city proper.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'Proper' قريبة من 'Prop' 'دعامة'.. الدعامة لازم تكون 'Proper' 'سليمة' عشان تشيل المبنى

armA.definition: Extremely bad or causing great fear or distress.
armA.arabic: حاجة سيئة جداً أو مرعبة، زي حادثة فظيعة أو طعم أكل وحش.
examples: I have a terrible headache.
The weather is terrible today.
It was a terrible mistake to leave the door open.
The terrible news shocked the entire community.
The country suffered from a terrible economic depression.
The tyrant's terrible reign left an indelible scar on the nation's psyche.
armA.mnemonic: من نفس أصل 'Terror' رُعْب.. الحاجة الـ 'Terrible' مُرْعِبة وسَيِّئَة.

armB.definition: Extremely bad, unpleasant, or of very low quality.
armB.arabic: صفة تعني سيء جدا او فظيع، وتستخدم لوصف الاشياء غير المريحة او ذات الجودة المتدنية للغاية.
examples: The weather was terrible so we stayed home.
I have a terrible headache today.
She felt terrible about making such a silly mistake.
armB.mnemonic: تذكر ان كلمة "terrible" ترتبط بكلمة الرعب "terror"، فالشيء السيء جدا يسبب لك فزعا وشعورا مزعجا.

armA.definition: Far on in progress or development; modern and complex.
armA.arabic: متقدم أو متطور جدًا، سواء في المستوى أو التكنولوجيا.
examples: This is an advanced class.
We use advanced technology.
His English is at an advanced level.
The cancer was in an advanced stage.
She has advanced views on education.
The civilization was highly advanced for its time.
armA.mnemonic: جاي من 'Advance' 'يتقدم'.. 'Advanced' يعني وصل لمرحلة متقدمة.

armB.definition: Having reached a high, modern, or complex level of development, skill, or study.
armB.arabic: يصف شيئا وصل إلى مستوى عال من التطور أو التعقيد، مثل التقنيات الحديثة أو المستويات الدراسية العالية.
examples: She decided to enroll in an advanced English class to improve her fluency.
Modern hospitals rely on advanced technology to treat serious illnesses.
The scientists are developing advanced methods to predict severe weather.
armB.mnemonic: تذكر كلمة advance التي تعني يتقدم الى الامام فالمستوى الذي يكون advanced هو مستوى متقدم للغاية ووصل الى مرحلة عالية

armA.definition: From a past time until now, or used to show the reason for something.
armA.arabic: كلمة بنستخدمها عشان نقول إن حاجة بدأت من وقت معين في الماضي ومستمرة، أو عشان نقول السبب 'بمعنى عشان أو بما إن'.
examples: I have been here since Monday.
She hasn't eaten since breakfast.
Since you are here, please help me.
He has improved a lot since he joined the team.
It has long since been forgotten by the public.
Since the premise is flawed, the conclusion must be rejected.
armA.mnemonic: اربطها بكلمة 'Sense'.. لما يكون عندك 'Sense' بالوقت، هتعرف إن الموضوع بدأ 'Since' فترة.

armB.definition: Starting from a particular time in the past until now, or because of a reason.
armB.arabic: تأتي أداة ربط بمعنى 'منذ أن' للإشارة إلى نقطة بداية زمنية استمر أثرها، أو بمعنى 'بما أن' لبيان السبب والعلة.
examples: I have lived in this city since I was a child.
Since it was raining heavily, we decided to stay at home.
Much has changed since the new manager took over the team.
armB.mnemonic: تذكر صوت كلمة "since" القريب من بداية كلمة "سيناريو"، وتخيل نقطة بداية السيناريو منذ وقت محدد في الماضي وحتى الآن.

armA.definition: A large amount of (used before uncountable nouns).
armA.arabic: كتير.. بتيجي قبل الاسم عشان توصف كميته.
examples: How much water?
I don't have much hope.
There isn't much difference.
He caused much trouble.
With much regret, I decline.
After much consideration, we agreed.

armB.definition: A large amount or quantity of something that cannot be counted individually.
armB.arabic: يُستخدم لتحديد كمية كبيرة من الأشياء غير المعدودة مثل الماء أو الوقت أو المال، وغالبا في النفي والاستفهام.
examples: I do not have much time today.
How much milk is left in the bottle?
There was not much snow on the road this morning.

armA.definition: Something, typically money, that is owed or due.
armA.arabic: الديون، الفلوس اللي عليك ولازم ترجعها لحد تاني.
examples: He has no debt.
I paid my debt.
She is in debt to the bank.
The company is trying to reduce its debt.
National debt has reached an all-time high.
He acknowledged his debt of gratitude to his mentor.
armA.mnemonic: حرف الـ 'b' ساكت مبيتنطقش، زي ما أنت ساكت لما حد يطلب منك سداد الـ 'Debt' 'الدين'.

armB.definition: An amount of money borrowed from someone else that must be paid back.
armB.arabic: مبلغ من المال يدين به شخص لآخر أو لجهة معينة ويجب سداده، أو حالة الالتزام المالي بالدفع.
examples: He managed to pay off his student debt within five years.
The company ran into serious debt after expanding too quickly.
National debt has increased significantly over the past decade.
armB.mnemonic: تذكر ان حرف b في كلمة "debt" صامت تماما وتلفظ دت مثل بداية كلمة دائن فكلاهما يتعلق بالمال المستحق

armA.definition: Relating to the home, household affairs, or family life.
armA.arabic: يصف ما يتعلق بالمنزل، أو شؤون الأسرة، أو الأعمال والحياة العائلية الداخلية، كما يستعمل لوصف ما هو محلي داخل الدولة.
examples: She shared the domestic chores equally with her partner.
The government announced new measures to stimulate domestic industry.
Passengers on the domestic flight were asked to show their identification.
armA.mnemonic: تذكر كلمة dome اي قبة البيت، فكل ما هو "domestic" يرتبط بداخل البيت او داخل الوطن

armB.definition: Relating to the running of a home, family, or one's own country.
armB.arabic: حاجة ليها علاقة بالبيت والعيلة، أو حاجة محلية جوه البلد مش أجنبية.
examples: Cats are domestic animals.
I don't like domestic work like cleaning.
The government focuses on domestic issues.
Domestic flights are cheaper than international ones.
The country is facing severe domestic unrest.
Gross Domestic Product (GDP) is a key economic indicator.
armB.mnemonic: اربطها بكلمة 'Dome' يعني قبة.. الـ 'Domestic' هو اللي بيحصل تحت قبة البيت أو قبة البلد

armA.definition: A person admired for courage, outstanding achievements, or noble qualities.
armA.arabic: البطل، شخص الناس بتحبه وبتحترمه عشان شجاعته أو أعماله العظيمة.
examples: He is my hero.
The movie is about a superhero.
Firefighters are often seen as heroes.
She became a national hero after winning the gold medal.
The protagonist is an anti-hero in this novel.
His hero worship of the singer was obsessive.
armA.mnemonic: زي الـ 'Super-hero'.. البطل اللي عنده قدرات خارقة.

armB.definition: A person admired for courage, outstanding achievements, or noble qualities.
armB.arabic: شخص يحظى بالإعجاب والتقدير بسبب شجاعته أو أفعاله العظيمة أو صفاته النبيلة، كمن ينقذ الآخرين أو يلهمهم.
examples: The brave firefighter became a local hero after saving the child.
My older brother has always been my childhood hero.
The main hero in the novel must overcome many dangerous obstacles.
armB.mnemonic: تذكر كلمة "hero" بربطها بكلمة هيرو المشهورة في أفلام الرسوم المتحركة والسينما حيث ينقذ الشخص الشجاع الجميع

armA.definition: Belonging to a period of history thousands of years in the past, or very old.
armA.arabic: يصف شيئا موغلا في القدم يعود لآلاف السنين وتاريخ الحضارات القديمة، أو شيئا قديما جدا.
examples: They studied the ruins of an ancient city in Greece.
The museum has a large collection of ancient coins.
In ancient times, people traveled across the desert by camel.
armA.mnemonic: تذكر نطق كلمة "ancient" القريب من بداية جملة "عنده شأن" تاريخي عظيم؛ شيء قديم جدا وله تاريخ يمتد لآلاف السنين.

armB.definition: Belonging to the very distant past.
armB.arabic: حاجة قديمة جداً من زمن فات وانتهى، زي الآثار والحضارات القديمة.
examples: This is an ancient building.
They visited ancient ruins.
Ancient Egypt is famous for pyramids.
It is an ancient custom in this village.
He studies ancient Greek philosophy.
The ancient mariner told his tale.
armB.mnemonic: شبه 'Ant' 'نملة'.. النمل موجود من عصور 'Ancient' جداً.

armA.definition: To use something to bad effect or for a bad purpose; to treat with cruelty.
armA.arabic: إنك تستخدم حاجة غلط، أو تعامل حد معاملة وحشة وعنيفة.
examples: Do not abuse animals.
He abused his position to get money.
People often abuse alcohol when they are stressed.
The prisoners were abused by the guards.
Don't abuse the hospitality of your hosts.
The politician was accused of abusing the system for personal gain.
armA.mnemonic: الفعل من 'Use' يستخدم.. 'Abuse' يسيء الاستخدام.

armB.definition: To use something incorrectly, unfairly, or for a wrong or illegal purpose.
armB.arabic: استخدام شيء ما بشكل سيئ أو غير عادل، مثل استغلال السلطة أو المنصب بطريقة خاطئة ومخالفة للأخلاق أو القانون.
examples: Corrupt officials often abuse their power for personal gain.
He warned that if users abuse the service, their accounts will be suspended.
People who abuse the trust of others often find themselves completely isolated.
armB.mnemonic: تذكر ان الفعل ينتهي بصوت الزاي على عكس الاسم الذي ينتهي بصوت السين وهو مكون من "ab" بمعنى بعيدا عن و "use" اي استخدام غير صحيح

armA.definition: To form one's features into a pleased, kind, or amused expression.
armA.arabic: إنك تعمل حركة بشفايفك تبين إنك مبسوط أو بتضحك من غير صوت.
examples: I smile when I am happy.
Please smile for the camera.
She smiled at him across the room.
He smiled politely but didn't say anything.
Fate smiled on their venture.
She smiled a wry smile of resignation.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Smile' قريبة من 'Smell' 'يشم'.. لما بتشم وردة بتعمل 'Smile'.

armB.definition: To make the corners of your mouth turn up because you are happy or friendly.
armB.arabic: أن ترفع زوايا فمك للتعبير عن الفرح أو الود أو الرضا دون إصدار صوت ضحك عالي.
examples: They always smile when they greet new visitors.
Please smile for the camera so we can take a nice photo.
I try to smile even when work becomes very stressful.
armB.mnemonic: تذكر كلمة "smiley" وهو الوجه التعبيري الضاحك الأصفر المشهور، فالفعل "smile" يعني أن تبتسم مثله.

armA.definition: Relating to a large company or business group.
armA.arabic: يصف كل ما يتعلق بالشركات والمؤسسات التجارية الكبيرة، مثل سياستها، بيئتها، أو هويتها.
examples: She left her corporate job to start a small bakery.
The firm recently updated its corporate identity and logo.
Good corporate governance is essential for long-term investment.
armA.mnemonic: تذكر كلمة "corps" او الكلمة اللاتينية "corpus" بمعنى جسد، فالشركة عبارة عن هيئة او جسد عمل جماعي واحد.

armB.definition: Relating to a large company or group.
armB.arabic: أي حاجة ليها علاقة بالشركات الكبيرة والمؤسسات الضخمة.
examples: He works in a corporate office.
They have a new corporate logo.
We attended a corporate event last night.
She wants to climb the corporate ladder.
The company needs to improve its corporate governance.
Corporate social responsibility is vital for modern brands.
armB.mnemonic: شبه كلمة 'Corp'.. أي حاجة 'Corporate' يعني خاصة بالشركات الكبيرة والبيزنس.

armA.definition: At what time; used to ask questions about time.
armA.arabic: بتستخدم عشان تسأل عن الوقت، بمعنى 'إمتى؟'.
examples: When is your birthday?
When did you arrive?
I don't know when the train leaves.
When are you planning to finish the project?
When, if ever, will they learn?
Since when has he been an expert?
armA.mnemonic: اربط 'When' بكلمة 'Win' 'يفوز'.. واسأل نفسك: 'When' will I 'win'? 'إمتى هفوز؟'.

armB.definition: At what time or period.
armB.arabic: تُستخدم للسؤال أو الإشارة إلى الوقت أو الزمن المحدد لحدوث شيء ما.
examples: When does the train arrive?
I do not know when the meeting starts.
Since when have you lived in this city?

armA.definition: Most important, basic, or central to something.
armA.arabic: يصف الشيء الاساسي او الجوهري الذي يعتمد عليه كل ما سواه.
examples: Reading and writing are core skills taught in primary school.
The company decided to focus on its core business and sell smaller branches.
Honesty remains one of our core values.
armA.mnemonic: تذكر ان لب الفاكهة او نواتها يسمى بالانجليزية "core" ومنه جاء وصف اي امر اساسي وجوهري بانه "core".

armB.definition: Most important or central to something.
armB.arabic: حاجة أساسية أو جوهرية.. مش فرعية.. زي المواد الأساسية في الدراسة
examples: English is a core subject.
We have a core team of five people.
Customer service is a core part of our business.
The company is focusing on its core activities.
Respect is a core value in this community.
The core curriculum omits several key historical events.
armB.mnemonic: زي الاسم بالظبط.. 'Core' يعني الأساس.. فـ 'Core values' يعني القيم الأساسية

armA.definition: A fictitious prose narrative of book length.
armA.arabic: قصة طويلة مكتوبة في كتاب، فيها شخصيات وأحداث وتفاصيل كتير.
examples: I read a novel.
It is a famous novel.
She is writing a novel.
The novel is set in 19th century London.
His latest novel explores themes of war.
The novel's complex narrative structure challenges the reader.
armA.mnemonic: الـ 'Novel' يعني رواية.. افتكر 'Nobel'.. نجيب محفوظ خد جايزة 'Nobel' عشان بيكتب 'Novel'.

armB.definition: A long printed story about imaginary characters and events.
armB.arabic: كتاب طويل يحكي قصة خيالية ذات شخصيات وأحداث متتابعة وتعرف بالرواية.
examples: She spent the whole weekend reading an exciting novel.
He wants to write a historical novel about ancient Egypt.
This classic novel has been translated into dozens of languages.
armB.mnemonic: تذكر ان كلمة "novel" تشبه كلمة نوفل العربية او اربطها ببدايتها مثل كلمة نيو بالانجليزية لان الرواية تروي قصة جديدة ومبتكرة

armA.definition: The flesh of an animal used as food.
armA.arabic: اللحمة اللي بناكلها من الحيوانات.
examples: I do not eat meat.
Chicken is a type of meat.
He bought some fresh meat from the butcher.
Red meat is high in iron.
The real meat of the argument was in the second chapter.
They are strictly carnivorous and eat only meat.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Meat' قريبة من 'Meet' 'يقابل'.. ممكن تقول: 'Let's meet to eat meat'.

armB.definition: The flesh of animals used as food.
armB.arabic: لحم الحيوانات أو الطيور الذي يتناوله الإنسان كطعام.
examples: I do not eat meat because I am a vegetarian.
Make sure the meat is cooked thoroughly before serving.
They bought fresh meat from the local butcher.
armB.mnemonic: تذكر ان كلمة "meat" لحم تشبه في نطقها كلمة "meet" يقابل، تخيل اصدقاء يتقابلون لتناول وجبة لحم لذيذة معاً

armA.definition: The act or sound of laughing.
armA.arabic: الضحكة نفسها. الصوت اللي بيطلع منك لما تكون مبسوط.
examples: She has a loud laugh.
We had a good laugh about it.
His laugh is contagious.
It was just a laugh, nothing serious.
She let out a hollow laugh.
The play was a laugh a minute.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Laugh' أولها 'La'.. زي لما تضحك وتقول 'لا لا لا'.

armB.definition: An act or sound of expressing happiness, amusement, or pleasure with the voice.
armB.arabic: صوت او حركة تصدر عن الانسان للتعبير عن الفرح او التسلية والسرور.
examples: She gave a loud laugh when she heard the joke.
We had a good laugh together after class.
His sudden laugh broke the silence in the room.
armB.mnemonic: تذكر ان الحرفين gh ينطقان مثل حرف الفاء في كلمة "laugh" تماما مثل صوت خروج الضحكة السريعة فاء

armA.definition: A person who determines the final content of a text or publication.
armA.arabic: الشخص المسؤول عن مراجعة وتعديل المقالات أو الكتب قبل نشرها.
examples: He is an editor.
The editor liked my story.
She works as a fashion editor.
The letter to the editor was published.
The chief editor has the final say.
Use a text editor to modify the code.
armA.mnemonic: جاية من 'Edit' يعني يعدل.. فالـ 'Editor' هو المعدل أو المحرر.

armB.definition: A person responsible for checking, correcting, and preparing texts, films, or newspapers for publication.
armB.arabic: الشخص المسؤول عن مراجعة النصوص أو المواد الإعلامية وتصحيحها وإعدادها قبل النشر أو العرض.
examples: The newspaper editor decided to put the story on the front page.
She sent her completed book draft to the editor for final corrections.
A skilled film editor can dramatically change the mood of a scene.
armB.mnemonic: تذكر كلمة "edit" اي يعدل ويصحح واضف عليها اللاحقة "or" التي تدل على الشخص الفاعل لتصبح الشخص الذي يقوم بالتعديل والمراجعة

armA.definition: A continuous flow of liquid, air, or gas; or a small river.
armA.arabic: تيار متدفق.. سواء مية زي النهر الصغير، أو هوا، أو حتى بيانات على النت
examples: There is a small stream near my house.
We crossed the stream on a bridge.
A stream of cold air came into the room.
The company has a steady stream of income.
He watched a live stream of the event.
She released a stream of consciousness in her writing.
armA.mnemonic: قريبة من 'Street' 'شارع'.. الـ 'Stream' هو شارع المية.. أو 'Live Stream' 'بث مباشر'

armB.definition: A continuous flow of liquid, or a small narrow river.
armB.arabic: مجرى مائي صغير وضيق يجري فيه الماء بشكل طبيعي، أو تدفق مستمر ومتواصل من السوائل أو الأشياء.
examples: We sat by a clear mountain stream to eat our lunch.
A constant stream of visitors entered the exhibition throughout the afternoon.
A thin stream of blood trickled down his arm after the cut.
armB.mnemonic: تخيل كلمة "stream" مرتبطة بالمصطلح الشائع في عصر الإنترنت live stream، حيث يتدفق البث المباشر بلا انقطاع تماما مثل مجرى الماء المتدفق.

armA.definition: To be unsuccessful in achieving a goal, or to stop working properly.
armA.arabic: إنك تفشل في تحقيق هدف، أو ترسب في امتحان، أو جهاز يعطل.
examples: I don't want to fail my test.
The engine failed to start.
He failed to mention the cost.
If you fail to plan, you plan to fail.
The crop failed due to the drought.
Words fail to express my gratitude.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Fail' -> فيل 'Elephant'.. لو حاولت تشيل 'فيل' أكيد هتعمل 'Fail' 'تفشل'.

armB.definition: To not succeed in doing something or not pass a test or exam.
armB.arabic: يخفق أو يرسب في تحقيق هدف ما أو في اجتياز اختبار.
examples: If you do not study hard, you might fail the driving test.
Many new businesses fail within their first year of operation.
Doctors tried everything, but the treatment began to fail.
armB.mnemonic: تذكر كلمة "fail" بالشبه الصوتي مع فِعل فيه خيبة أو انكسار مثل falling أو السقوط في الامتحان

armA.definition: To write the first preliminary version of a text, speech, or formal document.
armA.arabic: كتابة مسودة أولية لنص أو خطاب أو وثيقة رسمية قبل تنقيحها واعتمادها بصورتها النهائية.
examples: I need to draft a response to this formal complaint before noon.
The committee will draft new guidelines for workplace safety next week.
Lawyers helped draft the final contract between the two companies.
armA.mnemonic: تذكر كلمة "craft" التي تعني صناعة يدوية؛ فعندما تقوم بفعل "draft" فأنت تصنع مسودة أولية للفكرة بالورقة والقلم.

armB.definition: To prepare a preliminary version of a text; or to recruit someone for military service.
armB.arabic: يكتب مسودة أو يجهز خطة مبدئية، أو يجند حد في الجيش.
examples: Draft a letter.
We drafted a plan for the party.
She was drafted into the team.
Lawyers drafted the new contract.
He was drafted into the army at age 18.
The committee drafted a resolution to address the crisis.
armB.mnemonic: نفس فكرة الاسم.. بيعمل 'Draft' يعني بيجهز ويخطط.

armA.definition: Absolutely necessary; extremely important.
armA.arabic: حاجة مهمة جداً وماينفعش تكمل من غيرها، زي الماية للجسم.
examples: Water is essential for life.
It is essential to arrive on time.
Experience is essential for this job.
Vitamins are essential nutrients.
Trust is an essential element of any relationship.
The essential nature of the problem remains unsolved.
armA.mnemonic: جاية من 'Essence' 'جوهر'.. الحاجة الـ 'Essential' هي الجوهر اللي ماينفعش نستغنى عنه.

armB.definition: Completely necessary or extremely important in order to do something successfully.
armB.arabic: يصف الشيء الضروري للغاية أو الجوهري الذي لا يمكن الاستغناء عنه لحدوث أمر ما.
examples: Water is essential for all living things.
Good communication skills are essential in this job.
It is essential that we arrive before the meeting begins.
armB.mnemonic: تذكر كلمة "essence" التي تعني جوهر الشيء، فالأمر الـ "essential" هو ما يمس الجوهر ولا يمكن العيش بدونه.

armA.definition: Almost completely or for the most part.
armA.arabic: تُستخدم للإشارة إلى أن شيئاً ما ينطبق في معظمه أو إلى حد كبير على موقف معين، وإن لم يكن كلياً.
examples: The project was largely successful despite a few early delays.
His good health is largely due to regular exercise and a balanced diet.
The committee members largely agreed with the proposed changes.
armA.mnemonic: تذكر كلمة "large" التي تعني كبير، فإضافة "ly" تحولها إلى ظرف يعني إلى حد كبير أو في معظمه.

armB.definition: To a great extent; mostly or mainly.
armB.arabic: بمعنى 'إلى حد كبير' أو 'في الغالب'.. لما تكون الحاجة دي هي السبب الرئيسي.
examples: The room is largely empty.
It is largely a matter of time.
The success was largely due to her effort.
The old system has been largely replaced.
His theories are largely based on speculation.
The phenomenon remains largely unexplained by modern science.
armB.mnemonic: من كلمة 'Large' 'كبير'.. يعني الموضوع بيحصل بنسبة كبيرة 'Largely'

armA.definition: A line separating two countries or areas.
armA.arabic: الخط الفاصل بين بلدين أو منطقتين، أو الحافة اللي بتبقى حوالين شيء معين.
examples: We live near the border.
They crossed the border by car.
You need a passport to cross the border.
The border between the two countries is closed.
There is tension along the northern border.
The refugee crisis at the border has escalated significantly.
armA.mnemonic: شبه كلمة 'Board' 'لوحة'.. زمان كانوا بيحطوا ألواح خشب عشان يعلموا الـ 'Border'.

armB.definition: The official dividing line between two countries, states, or regions.
armB.arabic: الخط الفاصل الرسمي الذي يفصل بين دولتين أو منطقتين، وتوجد عنده عادة نقاط التفتيش والجمارك.
examples: We had to show our passports before crossing the border into Canada.
The river forms a natural border between the two countries.
Strict security measures were introduced along the northern border.
armB.mnemonic: تخيل كلمة "border" تشبه كلمة "board" اي لوح خشبي يوضع حاجزا على خط الحدود ليمنع العبور دون إذن

armA.definition: Performances, shows, or activities designed to amuse people and give them pleasure.
armA.arabic: العروض والأنشطة الممتعة مثل الموسيقى والمسرح والأفلام التي تهدف إلى تسلية الجمهور وإسعادهم.
examples: The hotel provides free live entertainment for its guests every weekend.
Cinema is one of the most popular forms of family entertainment.
They spent a lot of money on food and entertainment during their vacation.
armA.mnemonic: تذكر ان الكلمة تبدا بكلمة "enter" وكانك تدخل قاعة عرض او مسرح لتعيش اجواء التسلية والمرح

armB.definition: The action of providing amusement or enjoyment.
armB.arabic: الترفيه أو التسلية، زي الأفلام والمزيكا والألعاب.
examples: Movies are good entertainment.
We watched TV for entertainment.
The hotel provides evening entertainment.
The entertainment industry is huge.
It was just harmless entertainment.
The city offers a wide range of cultural entertainment.
armB.mnemonic: جاية من 'Enter' 'يدخل'.. الحاجة اللي 'بتدخل' السرور على قلبك.

armA.definition: An example or single occurrence of something.
armA.arabic: مثال أو حالة معينة لحاجة حصلت.
examples: Show me an instance.
For instance, look at this picture.
This is a rare instance of success.
In this particular instance, we can make an exception.
There are many instances where this rule applies.
It was a glaring instance of political corruption.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Instance' قريبة من 'Instant'.. يعني لحظة أو حالة حصلت دلوقتي.

armB.definition: A particular example or single occurrence of something.
armB.arabic: حالة أو نموذج محدد يمثل حدوث شيء ما أو يوضح فكرة عامة.
examples: This is a clear instance of how bad communication leads to delays.
In the first instance, you should contact customer support directly.
There was only one recorded instance of equipment failure this year.
armB.mnemonic: تذكر عبارة for instance الشهيرة التي تعني على سبيل المثال، فكلمة "instance" بحد ذاتها تعني مثال أو حالة ملموسة.

armA.definition: All of space, time, matter, and energy that exists everywhere.
armA.arabic: الكون بأكمله، ويشمل كل الفضاء والأجرام السماوية والمادة والطاقة الموجودة.
examples: Scientists believe that the universe began with a massive explosion billions of years ago.
There are billions of galaxies scattered throughout the known universe.
He often wondered if life existed elsewhere in the vast universe.
armA.mnemonic: تذكر البداية "uni" التي تعني واحد مثل "unicycle"، فالكلمة تعبر عن كل الوجود مجموعا في كل واحد متكامل.

armB.definition: All of space and everything in it, including stars, planets, and galaxies.
armB.arabic: الكون كله، الأرض والكواكب والنجوم وكل حاجة موجودة.
examples: The sun is in the universe.
We live in a large universe.
Scientists study the origins of the universe.
Is there life elsewhere in the universe?
He believes in a parallel universe.
The expansion of the universe is accelerating.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'Uni' يعني واحد.. الـ 'Universe' هو الكون الواحد اللي بيجمعنا كلنا.

armA.definition: Connected with or typical of the countryside rather than towns or cities.
armA.arabic: يصف ما يتعلق بالريف والقرى والمناطق الطبيعية البعيدة عن المدن الصاخبة والحياة الحضرية.
examples: Many young people leave rural areas to find work in large cities.
Public transport in rural communities is often limited and infrequent.
They bought a small cottage to enjoy a quiet rural lifestyle away from traffic.
armA.mnemonic: تذكر كلمة "rural" بربطها بكلمة "rustic" أو بحرف الراء المشترك مع كلمة ريف لتتخيل الحياة الهادئة في القرى

armB.definition: Relating to or characteristic of the countryside rather than the town.
armB.arabic: ريفي.. أي حاجة ليها علاقة بالريف والزراعة، عكس المدن.
examples: She lives in a rural area.
Rural life is very quiet.
We drove through the rural countryside.
The government is investing in rural development.
Rural depopulation is a major issue in this region.
The dichotomy between rural and urban values is stark.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'Rural' فيها صوت 'Roar'.. زي أصوات الحيوانات في الريف.

armA.definition: Decided on beforehand; or equipped/furnished (of a room).
armA.arabic: ليها معنيين: يا إما شخص تم تعيينه في وظيفة، يا إما مكان مجهز ومفروش بشكل معين 'زي غرفة فندق'.
examples: He arrived at the appointed time.
She is the newly appointed manager.
Guests must meet in the lobby at the appointed hour.
The committee members were appointed by the president.
We stayed in a luxuriously appointed suite at the hotel.
The strictly appointed hierarchy of the organization stifled creativity.
armA.mnemonic: من 'Appointment' يعني موعد.. لما حاجة تكون 'Appointed' يعني تم تحديدها أو تعيينها.

armB.definition: Decided on or officially arranged beforehand.
armB.arabic: يصف وقتا او مكانا او ترتيبا تم تحديده والاتفاق عليه مسبقا وبشكل رسمي.
examples: All delegates arrived at the appointed time for the opening remarks.
We agreed to gather at the appointed place right after the conference.
He failed to appear at the appointed hour, causing concern among his peers.
armB.mnemonic: تذكر كلمة "point" اي يشير او يحدد نقطة محددة، فالشيء الذي يكون "appointed" هو ما تم تحديد نقطته وزمنه مسبقا.

armA.definition: To talk with someone in a friendly, informal, and relaxed way.
armA.arabic: الحديث مع شخص بطريقة ودية وغير رسمية، سواء كان ذلك وجها لوجه أو عبر الإنترنت بهدف التسلية وتبادل الأخبار.
examples: We often sit together during lunch to chat about our day.
I will chat with my friend online this evening.
They love to chat over a hot cup of coffee.
armA.mnemonic: تذكر كلمة شات المستخدمة يوميا في برامج المحادثة مثل واتساب فهي تعني التحدث والدردشة بودية

armB.definition: To talk in a friendly and informal way.
armB.arabic: يدردش أو يتكلم مع حد بشكل ودي وبسيط.
examples: I chat with my friends.
She likes to chat on the phone.
We chatted for hours about nothing.
He was chatting up a girl at the bar.
They chatted amiably despite their differences.
We chatted away the afternoon in the garden.
armB.mnemonic: نفس كلمة 'شات'.. بتعمل شات مع صاحبك.

armA.definition: Correct in all details and free from any error or mistake.
armA.arabic: صفة تصف الشيء الصحيح تماما والخالي من الأخطاء، سواء كان معلومة، أو قياسا، أو وصفا يطابق الحقيقة بدقة.
examples: Scientists need an accurate measurement before they can publish the research results.
The newspaper published an accurate account of what happened during the meeting.
Modern weather models are remarkably accurate in predicting heavy storms.
armA.mnemonic: تذكر الكلمة من جزئها cure اللاتيني الذي يعني العناية والاهتمام، فالشيء الذي يعامل بـ cure وعناية تامة يصبح accurate وخاليا من الخطأ.

armB.definition: Correct in all details; exact and free from error.
armB.arabic: دقيق ومظبوط جدًا، مفيهوش أي غلطة.
examples: The clock is accurate.
Is this information accurate?
Please give an accurate description.
The figures are not completely accurate.
Accurate forecasting is essential for business.
Historians strive for an accurate account of events.
armB.mnemonic: شبه كلمة 'A cure' 'علاج'.. الدكتور الشاطر لازم تشخيصه يكون 'Accurate' عشان يديك الـ 'Cure' الصح.

armA.definition: Used to give your own opinion; or doing something yourself rather than asking someone else.
armA.arabic: لما تعمل حاجة بنفسك مش حد تاني، أو لما تقول رأيك الخاص.
examples: I don't know him personally.
Personally, I like blue.
The manager thanked us personally.
You shouldn't take his comments personally.
I am personally responsible for this error.
Personally speaking, the evidence is inconclusive.
armA.mnemonic: جاية من 'Person' 'شخص'.. يعني حاجة بتعملها 'شخصياً'

armB.definition: From one's own viewpoint, or directly by oneself rather than through another person.
armB.arabic: تُستخدم للتعبير عن الرأي الخاص، أو للدلالة على القيام بأمر ما بنفسك وبشكل مباشر دون وسيط.
examples: Personally, I prefer working from home rather than in a busy office.
The manager decided to apologize personally to every unhappy customer.
She took his casual criticism very personally.
armB.mnemonic: تذكر كلمة "person" اي شخص، فإذا أضفت لها اللاحقة تصبح الكلمة تعبيرا عن رأيك كشخص محدد أو قيامك بالعمل بنفسك.

armA.definition: Used to express that something is possible, but not certain.
armA.arabic: فعل مساعد يُستخدم للتعبير عن احتمال حدوث شيء ما مع وجود نسبة من الشك وعدم التأكد.
examples: Take an umbrella because it might rain later.
I might go to the party if I finish my work early.
We might see our teacher at the library this afternoon.
armA.mnemonic: تذكر ان كلمة "might" تشبه صوتا كلمة "night" في الليل قد تحدث احتمالات ومفاجآت غير مؤكدة

armB.definition: Used to express possibility or make a polite suggestion.
armB.arabic: يمكن أو احتمال.. بتستخدمها لما تكون مش متأكد من حاجة، أو بتطلب بأدب.
examples: It might rain.
I might go to the party.
You might want to check this.
He asked if he might borrow the car.
Whatever the outcome might be, we are ready.
Might I suggest a different approach?
armB.mnemonic: 'Might' يعني ممكن.. 'Might' أروح و 'Might' لأ.

armA.definition: From the beginning to the end; completely.
armA.arabic: يعني من الأول للآخر، أو بشكل كامل. زي لما تقرأ كتاب كله 'through' أو تتبل مية لحد جسمك.
examples: Please let me through.
I read the book straight through.
We were wet through after the rain.
He slept through the storm.
We need to think this matter through carefully.
The proposal was carried through despite strong opposition.
armA.mnemonic: افتكر 'Through' بإنك بتعدي في الحاجة لحد ما تخلصها.. يعني بتعملها 'Through' للنهاية.

armB.definition: From one end or side of an opening, space, or obstacle to the other.
armB.arabic: يستخدم لوصف الحركة من طرف شيء مجوف أو مساحة مفتوحة إلى الطرف الآخر والخروج منه.
examples: The gate was open, so we walked through.
The tunnel was dark, but the train quickly passed through.
He opened the door and invited me to go through.
armB.mnemonic: تخيل انك ترمي كرة بقوة فتنطلق ثرو مثل كلمة "throw" وتعبر من جانب الى اخر تماما كما تعني كلمة "through"

armA.definition: A particular way of considering something; a point of view.
armA.arabic: وجهة نظر أو طريقة معينة بتشوف بيها الأمور.
examples: I see it differently.
That is my view.
Try to see things from my perspective.
Traveling gives you a new perspective on life.
The novel is written from the perspective of a child.
We need to put these problems into historical perspective.
armA.mnemonic: جاية من 'Spectacles' 'نظارة'.. الـ 'Perspective' هو النظارة اللي بتشوف بيها الدنيا.

armB.definition: A particular way of viewing or thinking about something, influenced by personal experience.
armB.arabic: زاوية رؤية أو وجهة نظر خاصة يفكر بها الشخص في موضوع معين بناء على تجاربه وظروفه.
examples: Traveling abroad gave him a completely fresh perspective on life.
We need to look at this issue from a broader perspective.
Talking to a close friend helped put her problems into perspective.
armB.mnemonic: تذكر ان الجزء spect في كلمة "perspective" يعني النظر والرؤية مثل كلمة "inspect" لذلك تعني الكلمة زاوية النظر للامور او وجهة النظر

armA.definition: An unexpected event or disaster that causes great sadness, shock, or damage to someone.
armA.arabic: حدث غير متوقع ومؤلم يسبب صدمة كبيرة أو انتكاسة للمرء في خططه أو حياته الشخصية.
examples: Losing his job was a severe blow to his confidence.
The news of the factory closing came as a terrible blow to the town.
Her injury was a major blow to the national team.
armA.mnemonic: تخيل ريحا عاتية تعصف فجأة فتسقط كل الخطط ارضا كأنها صدمة قوية نزلت على الشخص

armB.definition: A hard hit with a hand or a weapon.
armB.arabic: خبطة قوية بالإيد أو بأداة، وممكن تيجي بمعنى مصيبة أو صدمة مفاجئة.
examples: He gave the door a blow.
It was a heavy blow to his head.
Losing his job was a severe blow.
They exchanged blows in the street.
The news dealt a crushing blow to their hopes.
She softened the blow by telling him gently.
armB.mnemonic: افتكر لما 'Blue' 'أزرق'.. لما تاخد 'Blow' قوية جسمك بيزرق.

armA.definition: In addition to what has been said, or furthermore.
armA.arabic: تُستخدم كظرف لإضافة معلومة أو سبب داعم لما قيل سابقاً، بمعنى بالإضافة إلى ذلك أو علاوة على ذلك.
examples: I do not want to go out tonight; besides, it is raining heavily.
The phone was too expensive, and besides, my current one works fine.
We cannot afford the trip, and besides, neither of us has enough vacation time.
armA.translations: عِلاوَةً على ذلك / فضلًا عن ذلك
armA.mnemonic: تذكر كلمة "beside" التي تعني بجانب وأضف لها حرف s لتتذكر أنك تضع فكرة أخرى بجانب الفكرة الأولى لتعني علاوة على ذلك

armB.definition: In addition to; also; apart from.
armB.arabic: بمعنى بالإضافة لكدة، أو غير كدة. بنستخدمها لما نزود معلومة أو سبب تاني.
examples: Who is here besides you?
I don't want to go; besides, I am tired.
Besides milk, we need to buy bread.
It's too late to go out now. Besides, it's starting to rain.
He has many other interests besides his work.
Besides being a talented musician, she is also a published author.
armB.mnemonic: هي كلمة 'Beside' 'بجانب' وحطينا لها 's' الجمع.. يعني بتحط حاجات كتير 'بجانب' بعضها.. يبقى بالإضافة لذلك.

armA.definition: To stop doing something, or to leave a job or school permanently.
armA.arabic: التوقف نهائيا عن فعل شيء ما، أو الاستقالة ومغادرة العمل أو الدراسة.
examples: He decided to quit his job and start his own business.
I want to quit smoking for my health.
Press the escape key if you want to quit the game.
armA.mnemonic: تذكر زر الخروج من الالعاب والبرامج المكتوب عليه "Quit" الذي تضغط عليه للتوقف والمغادرة.

armB.definition: To leave a job, school, etc., or to stop doing something.
armB.arabic: يسيب الشغل أو يبطل يعمل حاجة كان بيعملها 'زي التدخين'.
examples: I quit.
He quit his job.
She wants to quit smoking.
Don't quit now, you're almost there.
He decided to quit the rat race and move to the country.
The engine quit on us in the middle of the highway.
armB.mnemonic: زي 'Exit'.. بس 'Quit'.. يعني خرجت خالص.

armA.definition: Lacking intelligence or good judgment; foolish or stupid in informal contexts.
armA.arabic: يستخدم هذا المصطلح غالبا بشكل غير رسمي لوصف تصرف او شخص غير ذكي او احمق، كما كان يستخدم تاريخيا لوصف العاجز عن الكلام.
examples: It was a dumb mistake that could have been avoided with a little care.
She stood dumb with astonishment when the unexpected verdict was read.
He made a dumb decision to leave his secure job without another offer.
armA.mnemonic: تذكر ان الحرف الأخير صامت مثل الشخص العاجز عن الكلام، فلا ينطق حرف b في كلمة "dumb".

armB.definition: Temporarily unable or unwilling to speak; informal meaning is stupid.
armB.arabic: بتتقال بمعنى 'غبي' في الكلام العادي، بس معناها الأصلي 'أخرس' أو مش قادر يتكلم من الصدمة.
examples: That was a dumb mistake.
Don't be dumb.
He went dumb with fear.
Playing dumb won't help you now.
They stared in dumb amazement at the sight.
The sheer magnitude of the disaster left us struck dumb.
armB.mnemonic: زي 'Dam' 'سد'.. السد بيسكت المية، والـ 'Dumb' ساكت مبيتكلمش 'أو غبي'.

armA.definition: The period of life after stopping work permanently, usually due to age.
armA.arabic: فترة التقاعد، لما الشخص يوقف شغل نهائيًا 'غالبًا بسبب السن' ويرتاح.
examples: My grandfather is in retirement.
She is saving money for her retirement.
He took early retirement at the age of 55.
They bought a small house for their retirement.
The compulsory retirement age varies by country.
He announced his retirement from professional tennis.
armA.mnemonic: جاي من 'Tire' 'يتعب'.. الواحد لما يتعب من الشغل سنين طويلة بيطلع 'Retirement' يرتاح.

armB.definition: The period in life when someone stops working permanently, usually because of age.
armB.arabic: التوقف الدائم عن العمل والوظيفة، غالبا بسبب بلوغ سن معينة، أو الفترة الزمنية التي تلي ذلك.
examples: He began planning for his retirement years before leaving his career.
Many people enjoy traveling and pursuing hobbies during retirement.
She decided to take early retirement after thirty years at the bank.
armB.mnemonic: تذكر ان الفعل "retire" يعني يتقاعد او ينسحب للراحة، واضافة "ment" تحوله لاسم ليدل على مرحلة الراحة الدائمة بعد العمل

armA.definition: A person who operates the flying controls of an aircraft.
armA.arabic: الشخص اللي بيسوق الطيارة.
examples: The pilot flies the plane.
He wants to be a pilot.
The pilot announced our arrival.
Airline pilots undergo rigorous training.
The harbor pilot guided the ship into the dock.
The automatic pilot took over control of the aircraft.
armA.mnemonic: هو 'الطيار' بايلت.

armB.definition: A person who operates the flying controls of an aircraft.
armB.arabic: الشخص المؤهل لقيادة الطائرة وتوجيهها في الجو.
examples: The pilot safely landed the aircraft during the storm.
She trained for years to become a commercial pilot.
The co-pilot took control when the pilot needed a break.
armB.mnemonic: تذكر ان كلمة "pilot" تبدأ بنطق يشبه طيران باي في السماء ليقود الطائرة

armA.definition: To give official or legal permission to someone to do, own, or use something.
armA.arabic: منح إذن أو تصريح رسمي وقانوني لشخص أو جهة لممارسة نشاط معين أو استخدام تقنية أو بيع منتج.
examples: The state decided to license local vendors to operate along the boardwalk.
They plan to license their software to several global telecommunications firms next quarter.
Authorities refuse to license any facility that fails to meet strict safety standards.
armA.mnemonic: تذكر ان الفعل مشتق من الكلمة اللاتينية licere ومعناها يسمح او يجوز ومنها جاءت رخصة القيادة اي التصريح الرسمي بالشيء

armB.definition: To grant an official license to permit the use of something or allow an activity.
armB.arabic: إنك تدي إذن رسمي لحد عشان يعمل نشاط معين أو يستخدم حاجة ملكك.
examples: They license the car.
The shop is licensed to sell food.
The doctor is licensed to practice medicine.
The company licensed its technology to a foreign partner.
The new drug has not yet been licensed for human use.
The university licensed the patent to a pharmaceutical giant for development.
armB.mnemonic: الفعل من 'ليسانس'.. يعني يدي 'License' لحد.

armA.definition: Completely correct in every single detail, with no mistakes.
armA.arabic: يصف الشيء الدقيق والمضبوط بالتمام دون أي خطأ أو زيادة أو نقصان، مثل الوقت أو الأرقام.
examples: Do you know the exact time the train arrives?
The exact cost of the trip is still unknown.
She gave an exact copy of the contract to her lawyer.
armA.mnemonic: تذكر كلمة "exit" وتعني مخرج، تخيل انك تحتاج الى الحساب الـ "exact" اي الدقيق تماما للوصول الى المخرج الصحيح دون ان تضل الطريق.

armB.definition: Not approximated in any way; precise and accurate.
armB.arabic: يعني دقيق جداً أو مضبوط بالمللي. حاجة مفيهاش أي غلطة أو تقريب.
examples: What is the exact time?
We need the exact amount of money.
I can't remember his exact words.
The exact cause of the fire is unknown.
She gave an exact description of the attacker.
Scientific experiments require exact measurements and conditions.
armB.mnemonic: عشان تنجح في الـ 'Exam' 'الامتحان'، لازم إجابتك تكون 'Exact' 'دقيقة' وصح.

armA.definition: The act of allowing someone to do something.
armA.arabic: الإذن أو السماح.. لما تطلب من حد يوافق إنك تعمل حاجة
examples: Can I have permission to leave?
You need permission to park here.
She gave me permission to use her car.
He entered the building without permission.
Planning permission was granted for the new extension.
The usage of copyright material requires explicit written permission.
armA.mnemonic: جاية من 'Permit' يسمح.. أو افتكر إن أي 'Mission' 'مهمة' محتاجة 'Permission' 'إذن' عشان تبدأ

armB.definition: The act of allowing someone to do something, or an official document that allows it.
armB.arabic: الموافقة الرسمية أو السماح لشخص ما بالقيام بأمر معين.
examples: You need permission from the teacher to leave the classroom.
He took the car without his father's permission.
The city granted them permission to build a new hospital.
armB.mnemonic: تذكر الفعل الشائع "permit" بمعنى يسمح، واللاحقة "-mission" تحول الفعل إلى اسم يعني إذن أو تصريح رسمي.

armA.definition: The sport or activity of competing in races.
armA.arabic: رياضة السباق، زي سباق العربيات أو الخيل.
examples: I like car racing.
Racing is dangerous.
Horse racing is popular here.
She bought a racing bike.
His mind was racing with possibilities.
The competitive world of Formula 1 racing requires immense funding.
armA.mnemonic: جاية من 'Race' سباق.

armB.definition: The sport or activity of competing in contests of speed using vehicles, animals, or on foot.
armB.arabic: رياضة أو نشاط خوض مسابقات السرعة، سواء بالسيارات أو الدراجات أو الخيول أو الجري.
examples: He has had a lifelong passion for horse racing.
Motor racing attracts millions of enthusiastic spectators worldwide.
Safety regulations in modern car racing have significantly reduced serious injuries.
armB.mnemonic: تذكر كلمة "race" التي تعني سباق بإضافة "ing" لتصبح رياضة السباقات السريعة

armA.definition: To hold or have something inside itself.
armA.arabic: يعني أن يشتمل الشيء على شيء آخر بداخله، مثل صندوق يحوي أغراضا أو كتاب يضم معلومات.
examples: These boxes contain old family photographs.
Does this soup contain any nuts or dairy?
Firefighters worked through the night to contain the forest fire.
armA.mnemonic: تذكر كلمة "container" وهي الحاوية الضخمة التي تحفظ البضائع، فالفعل "contain" يعني يحوي أو يتسع لشيء بداخله.

armB.definition: To have or hold something within.
armB.arabic: يحتوي على، يعني حاجة تكون جوا حاجة تانية، زي الصندوق لما يكون جواه أغراض.
examples: This box contains toys.
Does this food contain nuts?
The letter contained good news.
They tried to contain the spread of the virus.
The document contains sensitive information regarding national security.
She could barely contain her anger when she heard the insult.
armB.mnemonic: الـ 'Container' 'الحاوية' وظيفتها إنها 'Contain' البضائع جواها.

armA.definition: The property possessed by an object of producing different sensations on the eye as a result of the way it reflects light.
armA.arabic: اللون، زي الأحمر والأزرق، اللي بنشوفه بعيننا لما الضوء ينعكس على الأشياء.
examples: What is your favorite colour?
The sky is a beautiful blue colour.
She added some colour to the drawing.
The leaves change colour in autumn.
The festival was a riot of colour and sound.
His writing lacks colour and imagination.

armB.definition: The visual appearance of things resulting from light reflection, such as red, blue, green, or yellow.
armB.arabic: اللون أو المظهر المرئي للأشياء مثل الأحمر أو الأزرق أو الأخضر الناتج عن انعكاس الضوء.
examples: What is your favourite colour?
Red is a very bright colour.
The dress changed colour after washing.
armB.mnemonic: تذكر كلمة "colour" بربطها بعلب الألوان المائية الزاهية في حصة الرسم المدرسية

armA.definition: An arrangement to meet someone at a particular time and place.
armA.arabic: ميعاد محدد أو اتفاق إنك تقابل حد في وقت ومكان معينين، زي ميعاد الدكتور أو الشغل.
examples: I have an appointment.
She has a dentist appointment.
I made an appointment to see the doctor.
His appointment as chairman was unexpected.
The appointment of the new judges caused controversy.
He keeps his appointments with punctuality and precision.
armA.mnemonic: فيها 'Point' 'نقطة'.. الـ 'Appointment' هو تحديد 'Point' معينة في الزمن عشان تتقابلوا فيها.

armB.definition: An arrangement to meet someone or visit a place at a specific time.
armB.arabic: اتفاق مسبق لمقابلة شخص ما أو زيارة مكان في وقت وتاريخ محددين، مثل موعد الطبيب أو اجتماع عمل.
examples: I have a dental appointment tomorrow morning at nine o'clock.
She called the office to reschedule her appointment with the director.
Visitors must make an appointment before arriving at the embassy.
armB.mnemonic: تذكر كلمة "point" اي نقطة او تحديد نقطة زمنية، فالكلمة تعني الذهاب الى نقطة زمنية محددة متفق عليها للقاء.

armA.definition: Extremely big in size, area, amount, or degree.
armA.arabic: صفة تصف شيئا هائلا أو شاسع المساحة أو عظيم الحجم والكمية، مثل الصحراء الواسعة أو الفروق الضخمة.
examples: The Sahara is a vast desert covering much of North Africa.
The vast majority of employees supported the proposed schedule changes.
Space exploration reveals a vast universe beyond our current comprehension.
armA.mnemonic: تذكر كلمة "vast" بتخيل سفينة ضخمة تبحر في بحر واسع مثل سفينة "fast" سريعة تعبر محيطا لا نهاية له.

armB.definition: Of very great extent or quantity; immense.
armB.arabic: حاجة ضخمة جداً وواسعة، سواء في المساحة أو العدد.
examples: The sea is vast.
A vast number of people attended.
The vast majority of students passed.
They crossed a vast desert.
The universe is vast and mysterious.
His knowledge of the subject is vast.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'Vast' شبه 'Fast' 'سريع'.. عشان تقطع مسافة 'Vast' 'واسعة' لازم تمشي 'Fast'.

armA.definition: One of the five long separate parts at the end of each human hand.
armA.arabic: أحد الأجزاء الخمسة البارزة والمتحركة في طرف يد الإنسان.
examples: He pointed his finger toward the tall building across the street.
She wore an elegant silver ring on her middle finger.
Be careful with that sharp knife or you might cut a finger.
armA.mnemonic: تذكر كلمة "finger" بالربط بين صوتها وحركة إصبعك وهو يضغط على زر الفنجان في ماكينة القهوة.

armB.definition: One of the five digits on the hand.
armB.arabic: صباع الإيد.
examples: I have ten fingers.
She pointed a finger at the door.
He cut his finger while cooking.
Don't lift a finger to help.
They keep their fingers on the pulse of the market.
Accusations were flying and everyone was pointing the finger.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'Finger'.. زي 'Chicken Fingers' أصابع الفراخ.
