examples: Stress was identified as the underlying cause of his frequent headaches.
The report fails to address the underlying problems facing the local economy.
An underlying sadness was evident in all of the author's later novels.
armB.mnemonic: تذكر الكلمتين تحت و مستلقي: شيء يستلقي تحته under lying ليكون الأساس المخفي الذي يقوم عليه كل شيء.

armA.definition: The sister of your father or mother, or the wife of your uncle.
armA.arabic: أخت الأب 'عمة' أو أخت الأم 'خالة'، أو مرات عمك أو خالك.
examples: My aunt lives in London.
I visited my aunt yesterday.
My aunt and uncle are coming for dinner.
She is a favorite aunt to her nieces.
He inherited the estate from a wealthy maiden aunt.
She played the role of the agony aunt for the community.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Aunt' قريبة من 'أنتِ'.. هي زي أمك الثانية وبنقولها يا 'طنط'.

armB.definition: The sister of your father or mother, or the wife of your uncle.
armB.arabic: أخت الأب (العمة) أو أخت الأم (الخالة)، أو زوجة العم أو الخال.
examples: My aunt lives in London and visits us every summer.
I received a lovely birthday gift from my favorite aunt.
She stayed with her aunt while studying at university.
armB.mnemonic: تذكر نطق كلمة "aunt" في الإنجليزية البريطانية مثل كلمة "انت" في العربية، وتخيل أنك تخاطب عمتك أو خالتك قائلا: أنت يا عمتي الأفضل.

armA.definition: Coming before a more important action or event; preparatory.
armA.arabic: حاجة تمهيدية أو مبدئية بتتعمل قبل الحدث الأساسي أو المهم.
examples: This is just the start.
We did a quick check first.
These are preliminary results.
The team passed the preliminary round.
Preliminary discussions were held yesterday.
The preliminary findings suggest a significant correlation.
armA.mnemonic: فيها 'Pre' يعني قبل.. 'Preliminary' يعني التحضير اللي قبل البداية.

armB.definition: Happening before a more important action or event, often in preparation for it.
armB.arabic: يصف ما يحدث في البداية تمهيدا لحدث رئيسي أو إجراء أكثر أهمية، كالمراحل والنتائج الأولية.
examples: The preliminary results of the study indicate a significant improvement in patient health.
Both sides held preliminary talks before the official peace summit began.
After a preliminary investigation, the police decided to inspect the building further.
armB.mnemonic: تذكر ان البادئة pre تعني قبل وكلمة limit تعني حد او عتبة، والمقصود خطوة تمهيدية قبل الدخول في الموضوع الاساسي.

armA.definition: Originating or occurring naturally in a particular place; native.
armA.arabic: أصلي أو بلدي. بتتقال على السكان الأصليين لبلد، أو النباتات والحيوانات اللي نشأت في مكان معين طبيعياً.
examples: Indigenous people live here.
This plant is indigenous to Mexico.
We learned about the indigenous culture.
The government protected the rights of indigenous tribes.
The kangaroo is indigenous to Australia.
Globalization poses a threat to many indigenous languages and traditions.
armA.mnemonic: أولها 'Indi'.. فكر في 'Indian' 'الهنود الحمر' هما الـ 'Indigenous' 'السكان الأصليين' لأمريكا.

armB.definition: Naturally living, growing, or originating in a particular place rather than arriving from somewhere else.
armB.arabic: يصف النباتات أو الحيوانات أو الشعوب الأصلية التي نشأت وعاشت طبيعيا في بيئة أو منطقة معينة ولم تجلب إليها من الخارج.
examples: The kangaroo is indigenous to the Australian continent.
Many indigenous communities struggle to preserve their ancestral languages and customs.
The botanist documented several indigenous plant species that exist only in this valley.
armB.mnemonic: تذكر البداية indi التي تشبه كلمة inside والجذر gen المرتبط بالولادة والجينات فالمعنى يشير إلى من ولد ونشأ داخل المكان أي اصلي

armA.definition: In addition to what has already been said, introducing an extra supporting fact.
armA.arabic: تُستخدم للربط بين جملتين بهدف إضافة معلومة جديدة ومهمة تدعم ما قيل سابقاً، وتأتي بمعنى علاوة على ذلك أو فضلاً عن ذلك في السياقات الرسمية أو الأكاديمية.
examples: The rent is reasonable; moreover, the location is ideal for public transport.
The project is over budget and, moreover, it will not be finished on time.
Smoking is harmful to health; moreover, it poses serious risks to those nearby.
armA.translations: علاوة على ذلك / فضلاً عن ذلك
armA.mnemonic: تتكون الكلمة بوضوح من جزأين هما "more" أي المزيد و "over" أي فوق ذلك فكأنك تقول فوق كل هذا أضف المزيد

armB.definition: As a further matter; besides; in addition.
armB.arabic: علاوة على ذلك، أو بالإضافة للي فات.. بتستخدمها لما تكون عايز تزود معلومة تأكد كلامك.
examples: It is cheap; moreover, it is good.
He is smart; moreover, he is kind.
The rent is reasonable, and moreover the location is perfect.
Texting is dangerous while driving; moreover, it is illegal.
The report is incomplete; moreover, it contains factual errors.
The proposal lacks detail; moreover, its feasibility is questionable.
armB.mnemonic: مركبة من 'More' 'أكتر' و 'Over' 'فوق'.. يعني 'فوق كدة وكمان' أو 'علاوة على ذلك'.

armA.definition: To make a determined effort to deal with a problem or difficult task.
armA.arabic: يعني تبدأ تتعامل مع مشكلة صعبة أو موقف معقد وتحاول تحله. زي لما نقول 'هنعالج الموضوع ده' بجدية.
examples: I tackle the ball in the game.
We need to tackle this problem soon.
The government is trying to tackle unemployment.
She decided to tackle the difficult project herself.
They failed to tackle the underlying causes of the crisis.
The philosopher attempted to tackle the epistemological questions of his time.
armA.mnemonic: اربطها بكلمة 'Take all'.. لما تعمل 'Tackle' لمشكلة، إنت بتـ 'Take all' المسؤولية وبتحلها.

armB.definition: To make an active effort to deal with a difficult problem or situation.
armB.arabic: التصدي لمشكلة أو معالجة موقف صعب بحزم وعزيمة لإيجاد حل له.
examples: The government needs to tackle youth unemployment before it gets worse.
We decided to tackle the hardest part of the project first.
City officials met today to tackle the issue of rising crime rates.
armB.mnemonic: تخيل لاعب كرة قدم يقطع الكرة بقوة وحزم مثل تصديك لمشكلة صعبة والتغلب عليها بكلمة "tackle"

armA.definition: To arrange people or things into a row, or to stand in a row.
armA.arabic: الاصطفاف في طابور أو تنظيم الأشخاص والأشياء في صف منتظم أو الترتيب المسبق لحدث معين.
examples: The organizers will line-up the participants before the parade begins.
We need to line-up several experts to speak at next month's international conference.
Security guards asked the passengers to line-up quietly along the corridor.
armA.mnemonic: تخيل كلمة "line" بمعنى خط وكلمة "up" للاكتمال، كأنك تأمر الجميع بالوقوف على خط مستقيم واحد

armB.definition: To arrange people or things in a row; to organize or prepare.
armB.arabic: يصطف أو يوقف ناس في طابور. وممكن تيجي بمعنى يجهز أو يرتب لحاجة.
examples: Please line up here.
The teacher told the kids to line up.
Cars lined up for the ferry.
We managed to line up some great speakers for the event.
He lined up his shots carefully.
They have lined up considerable support for the proposal.
armB.mnemonic: 'Line' 'خط' + 'Up'.. يعني اعملوا 'Line' 'خط' واقفين 'Up'.

armA.definition: A hard, smooth, shiny white or bluish-grey round mass formed inside the shell of an oyster.
armA.arabic: حجر كريم لامع كروي الشكل غالبا، يتكون داخل صدفة بعض الرخويات كالمحار، ويستخدم في صناعة المجوهرات.
examples: She wore an elegant necklace made of a single freshwater pearl.
The diver searched the seabed hoping to find a rare natural pearl.
His grandfather shared a valuable pearl of wisdom before the journey.
armA.mnemonic: تذكر نطق بيرل القريب من بريق، فاللؤلؤ يتميز ببريقه اللامع داخل المحار.

armB.definition: A hard, lustrous spherical mass, typically white, formed within the shell of an oyster.
armB.arabic: حجر كريم لونه أبيض وبيلمع بيطلع من المحار في البحر، وغالي جداً.
examples: She has a pearl ring.
Pearls come from the sea.
The necklace was made of real pearls.
He gave her a string of pearls for her birthday.
The diver found a rare black pearl.
Her wisdom was a pearl of great price in our troubled times.
armB.mnemonic: افتكر 'Pearl Harbor'.. الميناء اللي فيه 'Pearl' لؤلؤ.

armA.definition: To produce liquid through the skin because of heat, physical exercise, illness, or nervousness.
armA.arabic: إفراز قطرات من السائل الشفاف عبر الجلد عند الشعور بالحرارة أو بعد ممارسة الرياضة أو بسبب القلق.
examples: I usually sweat a lot during an intense gym workout.
Hot spicy food often makes some people sweat profusely.
Do not sweat the small problems when managing a large project.
armA.mnemonic: تذكر ان كلمة "sweat" تبدا بنفس نطق كلمة سويت اي حلو لكن العرق مالح وعكس الحلو تماما

armB.definition: To excrete moisture through the pores of the skin, typically due to heat or exertion.
armB.arabic: إن جسمك يفرز ميه 'عرق' لما الجو يكون حر أو تعمل مجهود.
examples: I sweat when it is hot.
He began to sweat after running.
The athletes sweat a lot during training.
Don't sweat the small stuff; focus on the big picture.
The cheese began to sweat at room temperature.
She was sweating profusely as the fever broke.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'Sweet' 'حلو'.. بس الـ 'Sweat' 'العرق' مش حلو خالص! فرق حرف واحد يقلب المعنى.

armA.definition: Doing an activity for enjoyment and interest rather than as a job, or lacking professional skill.
armA.arabic: يصف النشاط أو الشخص غير المحترف، والذي يمارس عملا أو هواية بدافع المتعة والشغف وليس كمهنة رسمية، وقد يحمل دلالة سلبية تعني قلة الإتقان والخبرة.
examples: She decided to enter an amateur photography contest to showcase her landscape pictures.
The local theatre group is entirely amateur, yet their performances are remarkably moving.
The investigative report criticized the amateur handling of evidence at the crime scene.
armA.mnemonic: الكلمة مشتقة من الجذر اللاتيني لكلمة حب مثل كلمة aimer بالفرنسية، وتذكر ان الشخص يفعل هذا الشيء حبا فيه وليس كمهنة

armB.definition: Engaging in a pursuit, especially a sport, on an unpaid rather than a professional basis.
armB.arabic: شخص بيعمل حاجة هواية ومش واخدها شغلانة، أو شغله مش احترافي.
examples: It was an amateur game.
He is an amateur photographer.
The competition is open to amateur cooks.
The play was performed by an amateur dramatic society.
His attempt to fix the sink was very amateur.
Despite being an amateur, his knowledge of astronomy rivaled that of professionals.
armB.mnemonic: عكس 'Pro'.. الـ 'Amateur' هو الهاوي اللي لسه بيتعلم ومش بياخد فلوس.

armA.definition: Soft, wet earth.
armA.arabic: التراب لما يختلط بالمية ويبقى طين أو وحل.
examples: My shoes are covered in mud.
Pigs like to roll in the mud.
The car got stuck in the mud.
Heavy rain turned the field into a sea of mud.
His name is mud around here after what he did.
The political campaign descended into mere mud-slinging.

armB.definition: Wet, soft, sticky earth formed by water mixing with soil.
armB.arabic: تراب رطب وناعم يختلط بالماء ليصبح مادة لزجة، وهو ما يعرف بالطين أو الوحل.
examples: Heavy rain turned the garden path into thick mud.
The car got stuck in deep mud after leaving the road.
He wiped the dried mud off his walking boots before entering.
armB.mnemonic: تخيل شخصا يمد يده في الطين فتتسخ، تذكر كلمة "mud" بصوت "مَد".

armA.definition: A person who campaigns to bring about political or social change.
armA.arabic: شخص ناشط بيتحرك وبيطالب بحقوق أو تغيير في المجتمع، مش بيسكت على الغلط.
examples: He is an activist.
She met a peace activist.
Activists marched in the street.
He is a well-known human rights activist.
Environmental activists protested against the new factory.
The government cracked down on political activists.
armA.mnemonic: جاية من 'Active' 'نشيط'.. هو شخص 'Active' في السياسة والمجتمع.

armB.definition: A person who campaigns vigorously to bring about political or social change.
armB.arabic: شخص يشارك بفاعلية في الدفاع عن قضية اجتماعية أو سياسية ويسعى لإحداث تغيير في المجتمع.
examples: She became a prominent environmental activist after the river near her town was polluted.
The human rights activist delivered a powerful speech at the international conference.
Every young activist in the group worked hard to organize the peaceful demonstration.
armB.mnemonic: تذكر كلمة "active" اي نشيط، فالشخص هو شخص نشيط جدا في خدمة قضيته والتغيير.

armA.definition: To join two or more things together.
armA.arabic: إنك تخلط أو تدمج حاجتين أو أكتر مع بعض عشان يبقوا حاجة واحدة.
examples: Combine milk and eggs.
We can combine our money.
The hotel combines luxury with comfort.
Hydrogen and oxygen combine to form water.
They decided to combine forces to defeat the enemy.
His style combines elements of jazz and classical music.
armA.mnemonic: لما تعمل 'Combine' بتخلي الحاجات 'Combo' واحد.

armB.definition: To join two or more things together to form a single unit or whole.
armB.arabic: يجمع أو يخلط شيئين أو أكثر معاً ليصبحا شيئاً واحداً أو لتحقيق نتيجة مشتركة.
examples: You can combine these two ingredients to make a delicious sauce.
Many students try to combine part-time work with their university studies.
The new design will combine comfort with high performance.
armB.mnemonic: تذكر بداية الكلمة com وتعني معاً، مثل كلمة company التي تعني صحبة، فالكلمة تعني جمع الأشياء معاً.

armA.definition: Required by law or rules; compulsory.
armA.arabic: إلزامي أو إجباري. حاجة لازم تعملها غصب عنك عشان القانون أو القواعد بتقول كده.
examples: School is mandatory.
Is the meeting mandatory?
Wearing a seatbelt is mandatory in this country.
The company made overtime mandatory for all staff.
A mandatory life sentence was imposed for the crime.
The legislation includes a mandatory provision for environmental impact assessments.
armA.mnemonic: شبه كلمة 'Mandate' 'أمر رسمي'. أو افتكرها بـ 'Man' و 'Date'.. الراجل لازم يروح الـ 'Date' ده 'Mandatory'.

armB.definition: Required by a law, rule, or authority; not optional.
armB.arabic: يصف شيئا مفروضا بحكم القانون أو اللوائح الرسمية، بحيث لا خيار للشخص في تركه، وهو مرادف للإلزامي أو الإجباري.
examples: Wearing a seatbelt is mandatory for all passengers in the vehicle.
The company introduced a mandatory training program on workplace safety.
Judges are bound to impose the mandatory minimum sentence under the new law.
armB.mnemonic: تذكر كلمة "mandate" بمعنى تفويض أو أمر رسمي، فالشيء الذي تحته أمر قانوني يكون إجباريا ومفروضا.

armA.definition: To begin to do or pursue something again after a pause or interruption.
armA.arabic: يستأنف أو يكمل حاجة بعد ما وقف شوية. زي لما تكمل الفيلم بعد الفاصل.
examples: Let's resume.
We will resume after lunch.
The meeting resumed at 2 PM.
They resumed their journey the next day.
Peace talks resumed after a week of silence.
Normal services will be resumed as soon as possible.
armA.mnemonic: زي 'Zoom'.. ارجع اعمل 'Zoom' وكمل شغل 'Resume'.

armB.definition: To begin again or continue after a pause or interruption.
armB.arabic: استئناف نشاط أو حديث بعد توقف مؤقت.
examples: We will resume the meeting after a short lunch break.
Normal train services are expected to resume tomorrow morning.
Both sides agreed to resume peace talks without preconditions.
armB.mnemonic: تذكر ان البادئة "re" تعني اعادة، فالفعل يعني اعادة البدء او الاستئناف بعد التوقف، ولا تخلط بينه وبين السيرة الذاتية التي تنطق بشكل مختلف.

armA.definition: To hold something firmly, or to deeply capture someone's attention or emotion.
armA.arabic: يمسك بالشيء بإحكام وقوة، أو يستحوذ على انتباه الشخص ومشاعره بالكامل.
examples: You must grip the steering wheel firmly with both hands while driving on icy roads.
Intense fear can completely grip a person during an unexpected crisis.
Novelists often strive to grip the reader from the very first paragraph.
armA.mnemonic: تذكر كلمة "grip" بأن صوتها يشبه كلمة قَرَّب، فعندما تريد أن تمسك شيئا بإحكام تقربه إليك بقوة.

armB.definition: To take and keep a firm hold of; grasp tightly.
armB.arabic: يمسك حاجة جامد، أو يسيطر على انتباه حد.
examples: Grip the handle tightly.
She gripped my hand in fear.
The tires gripped the wet road well.
Panic gripped the crowd when the fire started.
I was gripped by the exciting plot of the movie.
The nation was gripped by a sense of impending crisis.
armB.mnemonic: زي الاسم بالظبط، 'Grip' يعني يكلبش في الحاجة.

armA.definition: To cause a problem, danger, or difficulty, or to ask a formal question.
armA.arabic: يشكل تهديدا أو خطرا أو يطرح مشكلة أو سؤالا رسميا للنقاش.
examples: Pollution from older cars can pose a major threat to public health.
The unexpected budget cuts pose serious challenges for the research team.
Allow me to pose a direct question regarding the project deadline.
armA.mnemonic: تذكر ان الكلمة مرتبطة بوضعية الوقوف امام الكاميرا pose لكن في السياق الرسمي تستعمل بمعنى وضع او تقديم مشكلة او سؤال امام الاخرين

armB.definition: To present a problem or question; to assume a position for a photo.
armB.arabic: معنيين: يا إما تاخد وضعية للتصوير، يا إما تشكل 'خطر أو سؤال' وتطرحه.
examples: Can you pose for a picture?
The models posed for the camera.
Pollution poses a threat to wildlife.
This new evidence poses a difficult question for the jury.
The sheer size of the project poses a challenge.
He posed as a doctor to enter the hospital unnoticed.
armB.mnemonic: نفس الاسم، بس هنا فعل: ياخد وضعية أو يطرح مشكلة.

armA.definition: To bring goods or services into a country from abroad to sell them.
armA.arabic: جلب بضائع أو خدمات من دولة أخرى بهدف بيعها أو استخدامها محليا.
examples: Many countries import oil to meet their energy needs.
We import fresh fruit directly from farms in Spain.
Small businesses often find it expensive to import raw materials.
armA.mnemonic: تذكر ان البادئة im تعني إلى الداخل و port تعني الميناء، أي إدخال البضائع إلى الميناء عبر الشحن

armB.definition: To bring goods or services into a country from abroad for sale.
armB.arabic: يستورد، يعني يشتري بضاعة من دولة تانية ويدخلها بلده.
examples: We import tea from China.
They import cars from Germany.
The country has to import most of its oil.
It is cheaper to import these parts than to make them.
The software allows you to import data from other files.
They were accused of illegally importing endangered species.
armB.mnemonic: نفس فكرة الاسم: 'In' + 'Port'.. يدخل البضاعة الميناء.

armA.definition: The act of finding things that belong together or look good together.
armA.arabic: عملية التوفيق أو المطابقة.. إنك تلاقي حاجتين شبه بعض أو لايقين على بعض
examples: The matching of the socks took time.
We are working on the matching of colors for the room.
The computer is good at data matching.
DNA matching proved he was the father.
The precise matching of candidates to jobs is crucial.
Spectral matching allows us to identify the chemical composition.
armA.mnemonic: جاية من 'Match'.. زي الـ 'Match' 'المباراة' بين فريقين.. هنا بنعمل 'Matching' بين حاجتين عشان نشوفهم لايقين ولا لأ

armB.definition: The process of putting people, things, or data together based on shared features, suitability, or similarity.
armB.arabic: عملية التوفيق أو المقارنة بين شيئين أو أكثر للتحقق من توافقهما أو تطابقهما.
examples: The computer program performs automatic pattern matching on large sets of images.
Careful job matching ensures that candidates are placed in roles suitable for their skills.
The forensic laboratory specializes in DNA matching for criminal investigations.
armB.mnemonic: تخيل كلمة match كانها مباراة تجمع بين فريقين متكافئين فعملية matching تعني التوفيق والجمع بين ما يناسب بعضه

armA.definition: The legal status and rights of belonging to a particular country, or good community participation.
armA.arabic: الصفة القانونية التي تجعل الشخص فردا معترفا به في دولة معينة، وتشمل أيضا أداء الواجبات والمشاركة الإيجابية في المجتمع.
examples: After living abroad for ten years, she decided to apply for dual citizenship.
Active citizenship requires individuals to participate in democratic decisions and local governance.
The school presented an award to honor her outstanding citizenship and service to others.
armA.mnemonic: تخيل كلمة "city" اي مدينة ومعها سفينة "ship"، والركاب الذين يحملون صفة الانتماء القانوني للمدينة يملكون هذه التذكرة.

armB.definition: The position or status of being a citizen of a particular country.
armB.arabic: الجنسية أو المواطنة.. إنك تكون مواطن قانوني في بلد وليك حقوق وعليك واجبات.
examples: He wants US citizenship.
She applied for citizenship last year.
Dual citizenship allows you to hold two passports.
Schools should teach good citizenship to children.
The refugees were finally granted full citizenship.
Global citizenship implies a responsibility beyond one's own borders.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'Citizen' 'مواطن' + 'Ship'.. كأن المواطنين كلهم راكبين 'Ship' 'سفينة' واحدة هي الوطن.

armA.definition: To allow liquid or gas to escape; to disclose secret information.
armA.arabic: يسرب مية أو غاز.. أو يسرب أخبار ومعلومات مش المفروض حد يعرفها.
examples: The tap leaks.
The bottle is leaking water.
The roof leaks when it rains.
Someone leaked the news to the press.
The committee leaked the report to influence public opinion.
Chemicals leached from the soil and leaked into the groundwater.
armA.mnemonic: نفس الاسم.. 'Leak' يعني يسرب.

armB.definition: To intentionally or accidentally allow secret or confidential information to become public.
armB.arabic: أن يقوم شخص بنشر أو تمرير معلومات سرية أو حساسة إلى العلن أو لوسائل الإعلام دون إذن رسمي.
examples: An anonymous official decided to leak the classified report to the press.
If you leak sensitive financial details, you will face severe legal consequences.
Defective pipes can leak hazardous chemicals directly into the groundwater.
armB.mnemonic: تذكر كلمة "leak" عبر تذكر موقع ويكيليكس الشهير بنشر الوثائق السرية المسربة

armA.definition: A person or company involved in trade, especially with foreign countries.
armA.arabic: التاجر الكبير اللي بيبيع ويشتري بضايع، خصوصاً اللي بيتاجر مع بلاد تانية.
examples: The merchant sells tea.
He is a rich merchant.
The merchant ships crossed the ocean.
Local merchants are complaining about the new tax.
Venice was famous for its wealthy merchant class.
The merchant bank facilitated the complex merger.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Merchant' قريبة من 'Merchandise' 'بضاعة'.. فالـ 'Merchant' هو صاحب البضاعة.

armB.definition: A person or business that buys and sells goods, especially in large quantities or with foreign countries.
armB.arabic: شخص او شركة تعمل في تجارة البضائع وبيعها وشراءها، خاصة بكميات كبيرة او على نطاق دولي.
examples: The local wine merchant recommended an excellent bottle for the dinner party.
In the fourteenth century, a wealthy merchant could hold significant political influence in Venice.
Before accepting online payments, the digital merchant must comply with strict international security standards.
armB.mnemonic: تذكر كلمة "merchandise" بضائع فكلمة "merchant" هو التاجر الذي يبيع هذه البضائع ويعرضها في المتجر

armA.definition: A person who teaches people or animals specific skills, fitness, or good behavior.
armA.arabic: شخص متخصص يقوم بتعليم وتوجيه الآخرين لاكتساب مهارات معينة، أو إعداد الرياضيين بدنيا، أو تدريب الحيوانات.
examples: She hired a personal trainer to help her prepare for the race.
The company invited an expert trainer to teach staff how to use the software.
A good dog trainer needs patience, consistency, and clear communication.
armA.mnemonic: تذكر ان كلمة "trainer" تنتهي بـ er مثل teacher للدلالة على الشخص، وهي تدل على من يقودك في مسار تدريب منظم كما يسير القطار train على مساره المحدد.

armB.definition: A person who trains people or animals.
armB.arabic: المدرب اللي بيعلمك مهارة جديدة أو بيساعدك تتمرن في الجيم، أو بيدرب حيوانات.
examples: He is my trainer.
I need a personal trainer.
The dog trainer is very good.
She works as a corporate trainer.
The horse trainer prepared for the race.
Experienced trainers know how to motivate athletes.
armB.mnemonic: من 'Train' يدرب.. الـ 'Trainer' هو المدرب اللي بيعلمك تعمل التمرين صح.

armA.definition: Frequently; many times; on many occasions.
armA.arabic: كتير، أو في أوقات كتير. عكسها نادراً.
examples: I often go to the park.
How often do you brush your teeth?
We visit them as often as possible.
He often works late at night.
Old houses often need repairs.
It is often said that time heals all wounds.
armA.mnemonic: شبه 'Off' و 'On'.. النور بيقطع عندنا 'Often' كتير

armB.definition: Many times or on many occasions.
armB.arabic: يُستخدم للتعبير عن تكرار حدوث الشيء مرات عديدة أو بشكل معتاد.
examples: I often read books before going to sleep.
How often do you visit your grandparents?
It does not often rain in the desert during summer.
armB.mnemonic: تذكر كلمة "often" بربطها بكلمة "soften"، فالأمور تلين وتصبح أسهل عندما تمارسها مرات كثيرة وغالبا.

armA.definition: To give all your attention or mental effort to a specific task or subject.
armA.arabic: ان توجه كامل انتباهك وتفكيرك نحو امر محدد دون التشتت بما حوله.
examples: I cannot concentrate when the television is playing so loudly.
You need to concentrate on finishing this report before the deadline.
The company decided to concentrate its marketing efforts on digital platforms.
armA.mnemonic: تذكر كلمة "center" اي المركز فمعنى "concentrate" ان تجمع تفكيرك في نقطة مركزية واحدة دون تشتت

armB.definition: To focus all one's attention on a particular object or activity.
armB.arabic: يركز انتباهه كله في حاجة واحدة.
examples: I cannot concentrate.
Please concentrate on your work.
The noise makes it hard to concentrate.
We need to concentrate our efforts on sales.
Power is concentrated in the hands of a few.
He concentrated his mind on the problem at hand.
armB.mnemonic: شبه كلمة 'Centre' 'مركز'.. يعني تخلي تفكيرك كله في 'المركز' ونقطة واحدة.

armA.definition: A hot glowing body of ignited gas that is generated by something on fire.
armA.arabic: لسان النار أو اللهب اللي بيطلع لما حاجة تتحرق.
examples: The candle has a small flame.
Don't touch the flame.
The car burst into flames.
The flames spread quickly through the forest.
He tried to keep the flame of hope alive.
The speech fanned the flames of racial tension.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Flamingo' 'طائر الفلامنجو' اسمه كده عشان لونه أحمر زي الـ 'Flame' 'اللهب'.

armB.definition: A glowing body of hot, burning gas produced by something that is on fire.
armB.arabic: اللسان المضيء والساخن من الغاز المحترق الناتج عن النار، وهو ما يعرف باللهب.
examples: A tiny candle flame flickered in the drafty corridor.
The dry grass caught fire, producing a sudden bright flame.
Firefighters worked through the night to keep the flame away from nearby homes.
armB.mnemonic: تذكر كلمة "flame" بربطها بكلمة فلامنغو وهو الطائر ذو اللون الناري الوردي او بكلمة الفلم الذي تشتعل احداثه مثل لهب النار.

armA.definition: A coin or monetary unit of small value in the United Kingdom and the United States.
armA.arabic: عملة معدنية ذات قيمة منخفضة جدا تستخدم في بريطانيا والولايات المتحدة وتعادل جزءا صغيرا من العملة الأساسية.
examples: He found a shiny penny on the sidewalk.
The small toy did not cost a single penny.
She saved every penny she earned from her summer job.
armA.mnemonic: تذكر ان كلمة "penny" تشبه في بدايتها كلمة بنس وهو الاسم المعرب لنفس العملة المعدنية الصغيرة في بريطانيا

armB.definition: A small copper coin worth one cent; a very small amount of money.
armB.arabic: عملة صغيرة جداً قيمتها قليلة، بنستخدم الكلمة دي عشان نقول إن معانا فلوس قليلة أو مفيش خالص.
examples: I found a penny on the floor.
This candy costs only a penny.
He saves every penny he earns.
It didn't cost us a penny to enter the museum.
She watched her pennies carefully during the recession.
The project was worth every penny of the investment.
armB.mnemonic: اربطها بكلمة 'Pen' قلم.. الـ 'Penny' عملة صغيرة يادوب تشتري بيها 'Pen' رخيص.

armA.definition: A round open container with a handle, used for carrying liquids.
armA.arabic: الجردل اللي بنملاه مية ونشيله من الإيد بتاعته.
examples: Fill the bucket with water.
We need a bucket and sponge to wash the car.
He carried a heavy bucket of sand.
The rain came down in buckets.
They are just a drop in the bucket compared to what we need.
The data is sorted into different storage buckets.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Bucket' شبه 'Pocket'.. بس الـ 'Bucket' بنشيل فيه ميه مش فلوس.

armB.definition: An open container with a handle, mainly used for holding or carrying liquids or loose materials.
armB.arabic: وعاء مفتوح من الأعلى وله مقبض يدوي، يُستخدم عادة لنقل أو حفظ السوائل كالمياه أو المواد السائبة كالحصى والرمل.
examples: He filled the plastic bucket with soapy water to wash the floor.
The little girl took a red bucket to the beach to build sandcastles.
A wooden bucket was left beside the well in the courtyard.
armB.mnemonic: تذكر عبارة bucket list اي قائمة الامنيات قبل ان يركل الانسان الدلو ويفارق الحياة كما في التعبير الشائع kick the bucket

armA.definition: A person's general attitude toward life, or the likely future situation regarding something.
armA.arabic: المنظور أو النظرة العامة لشخص تجاه الحياة والأمور، أو التوقعات والآفاق المستقبلية لوضع ما.
examples: Traveling abroad gave her a much more open and positive outlook on life.
Economists warned that the economic outlook for the next quarter remains uncertain.
Despite the severe difficulties, he maintained a remarkably calm outlook throughout the crisis.
armA.mnemonic: تخيل انك تنظر للخارج عبر نافذة لترى الافق وما يخبئه المستقبل او لتحدد نظرتك لما حولك من الكلمتين "out" اي خارج و "look" اي نظرة

armB.definition: A person's point of view or general attitude to life; future expectations.
armB.arabic: نظرتك للحياة 'متفائل/متشائم'، أو التوقعات للمستقبل 'زي الطقس أو الاقتصاد'.
examples: The outlook is good.
She has a positive outlook.
The weather outlook for tomorrow is sunny.
The economic outlook remains uncertain.
Travel broadens your outlook on life.
His pessimistic outlook hinders his success.
armB.mnemonic: إنك تبص 'Look' لبرة 'Out' وتشوف المستقبل.

armA.definition: The smallest possible discrete unit of any physical property, such as energy.
armA.arabic: اصطلاح علمي فيزيائي يشير إلى أصغر مقدار أو وحدة محددة لا يمكن تقسيمها من الطاقة أو المادة، وتسمى الكم.
examples: A photon is considered a single quantum of light energy.
The discovery that energy exists as a discrete quantum transformed modern physics.
Scientists measured the exact quantum of radiation released during the reaction.
armA.mnemonic: تذكر ان الكلمة مشتقة من اللاتينية وتعني كمية محددة تماما كما في كلمة quantity

armB.definition: A discrete quantity of energy; a significant amount.
armB.arabic: أقل كمية من الطاقة، أو بتستخدم لوصف قفزة كبيرة في التطور.
examples: Quantum physics is hard.
He read a book about quantum theory.
Computers have made a quantum leap in speed.
The theory explains energy at a quantum level.
We need a quantum shift in our thinking to solve this.
The research focuses on quantum entanglement and its applications.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'Quantum' قريبة من السؤال العربي 'كم؟'.. علم الـ 'Quantum' بيحسب 'كم' الطاقة بدقة.

armA.definition: To rule as a monarch, or to predominate as a dominant quality or condition.
armA.arabic: يحكم كملك أو قائد أعلى، أو يسود وينتشر كشعور أو حالة غالبة في مكان ما.
examples: The young monarch was destined to reign over a vast and divided kingdom.
After months of civil unrest, peace and order finally began to reign across the province.
Ancient traditions still reign supreme in the everyday culture of this remote valley.
armA.mnemonic: تذكر ان كلمة "reign" تنطق تماما مثل "rain" اي المطر فتخيل الملك يحكم البلاد بينما تمطر السماء تيجانا

armB.definition: To rule as a king or queen; to be the best or most important.
armB.arabic: يحكم ويسيطر كملك، أو لما حاجة معينة هي اللي تسود وتنتشر.
examples: The King reigns.
She reigned for 50 years.
Chaos reigned in the streets.
He reigns supreme in the boxing world.
Silence reigned after the announcement.
The champion still reigns over the division.

armA.definition: The legal proceedings against someone in respect of a criminal charge.
armA.arabic: الادعاء أو المقاضاة.. الجهة في المحكمة اللي بتحاول تثبت إن المتهم مذنب، عكس الدفاع.
examples: The prosecution spoke first.
He faced prosecution for stealing.
The prosecution called their main witness.
She works for the prosecution service.
The evidence provided by the prosecution was weak.
He escaped prosecution due to a lack of concrete evidence.
armA.mnemonic: قريبة من 'Persecute' 'يضطهد' بس بالقانون.. الـ 'Prosecution' هي الجهة اللي بتلاحق المجرمين قانونياً

armB.definition: The legal process of putting someone on trial for a crime, or the lawyers conducting it.
armB.arabic: المحاكمة القانونية أو رفع دعوى قضائية جنائية ضد شخص ما، ويُطلق المصطلح أيضًا على هيئة الادعاء أو النيابة العامة في المحكمة.
examples: The company faced prosecution for violating federal safety regulations.
The prosecution presented several credible witnesses to support the criminal charge.
He was granted immunity from prosecution in exchange for his full cooperation with investigators.
armB.mnemonic: تذكر ان الجزء الاول يشبه كلمة "pursue" اي يلاحق والمحامون في النيابة يلاحقون المتهم قانونيا حتى النهاية

armA.definition: To shout loudly to show support, praise, or enthusiasm for someone.
armA.arabic: أن يهتف الشخص أو يصرخ بصوت عال لإظهار الدعم والتشجيع أو الإعجاب بشخص ما.
examples: Thousands of fans gathered to cheer their team during the final match.
We stood by the finish line ready to cheer each runner as they arrived.
A hot cup of tea will certainly cheer you up on a gloomy day.
armA.mnemonic: تذكر نداء التشجيع الشهير "cheers" عند الاحتفال فالكلمة تعبر عن الهتاف وبث البهجة

armB.definition: To shout for joy or in praise of someone; to comfort or encourage.
armB.arabic: إنك تهتف وتشجع حد بصوت عالي، أو تحاول تبسط حد وتفرحه.
examples: We cheer for our team.
Cheer up! It's not that bad.
The crowd cheered loudly when he scored.
I tried to cheer him up with a joke.
They cheered the soldiers as they marched by.
The unexpected victory cheered the nation immensely.
armB.mnemonic: لما الـ 'Cheerleaders' بيشجعوا الفريق، بيعملوا 'Cheer'.

armA.definition: Very exciting, unusual, or impressive to see.
armA.arabic: يصف شيئا مذهلا او لافتا للنظر بشكل استثنائي بحيث يجذب الانتباه ويثير الاعجاب الشديد.
examples: The mountaintop hotel offers a spectacular view of the entire valley.
The fireworks display on New Year's Eve was truly spectacular.
The young company achieved a spectacular success in its first year of operation.
armA.mnemonic: تذكر الكلمة من بدايتها التي تشبه كلمة نظارات "spectacles" لان كليهما يرتبط بالنظر والرؤية بشيء مبهر يستحق المشاهدة.

armB.definition: Beautiful in a dramatic and eye-catching way.
armB.arabic: حاجة مبهرة جداً وشكلها يجنن، تخطف العين من جمالها.
examples: The view is spectacular.
We saw a spectacular show.
The fireworks were spectacular.
She looked spectacular in that dress.
The team suffered a spectacular failure.
The mountain range offers spectacular scenery for hikers.
armB.mnemonic: جاية من 'Spectacles' 'نظارة'.. حاجة محتاجة تلبس 'Spectacles' عشان تشوف حلاوتها كويس.

armA.definition: To begin to be something; to turn into something.
armA.arabic: يعني تتحول لحاجة تانية أو تبدأ تكون في حالة جديدة.
examples: He wants to become a doctor.
It has become very cold.
They became good friends.
The situation has become complicated.
It does not become you to speak like that.
He became increasingly disillusioned with politics.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Become' فيها 'Be' 'يكون' و 'Come' 'ييجي'.. يعني لما الحالة 'Come' وتخليك 'Be' حاجة تانية، يبقى إنت 'Become' 'أصبحت'.

armB.definition: To begin to be something, or to turn into a different state.
armB.arabic: أن يتحول الشيء أو الشخص إلى حالة جديدة أو يبدأ في اتخاذ صفة أو مهنة معينة.
examples: I want to become a teacher in the future.
The days become shorter during the winter months.
Caterpillars eventually become butterflies.
armB.mnemonic: تخيل انك تقول لشخص "come" اي تعال الى هنا لتتحول وتصير شخصا ناجحا مع كلمة "become".

armA.definition: Agreeing with facts or reality, not false or made up.
armA.arabic: يصف الشيء بأنه حقيقي أو صحيح ومطابق للواقع، وليس كاذبا أو مصطنعا.
examples: Is it true that you are moving to London?
The movie is based on a true story.
Her dream finally came true after years of hard work.
armA.mnemonic: تذكر كلمة "true" بأن إشارتها في الاختبارات هي إشارة الصح مقابل الخطأ.

armB.definition: In accordance with fact or reality; not false or erroneous.
armB.arabic: حاجة صح وحقيقية، مش كذب ولا تأليف، ومطابقة للواقع.
examples: Is this story true?
It is true that he likes pizza.
A true friend helps you when you are in trouble.
The movie is based on a true story.
Her predictions came true exactly as she said.
He remained true to his principles despite the pressure.
armB.mnemonic: عكس 'False'.. يعني حاجة 'True' ومؤكدة.

armA.definition: Impressive beauty, dignity, or royal grandeur that commands deep respect and admiration.
armA.arabic: الهيبة، الجلال، أو الفخامة العظيمة التي تثير الإعجاب والاحترام، وتستخدم كثيرا لوصف الطبيعة الخلابة أو الملوك.
examples: We stood in silence, overwhelmed by the majesty of the snowy mountains.
The ancient cathedral was designed to display the eternal majesty of the divine.
His speech captured the solemn majesty of the historical occasion.
armA.mnemonic: تذكر الكلمة من مظهر الملك الحاكم، فالجذر اللاتيني يرتبط بالعظمة والفخامة كما في كلمة "major".

armB.definition: Impressive beauty, dignity, or power; also a title for a king or queen.
armB.arabic: العظمة والفخامة، وكمان لقب بنقوله للملوك 'جلالة الملك'.
examples: The Queen is Her Majesty.
We bowed to His Majesty.
The majesty of the castle amazed us.
You can feel the majesty of the mountains here.
The music captured the sheer majesty of the occasion.
The cathedral stands in all its Gothic majesty.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'Magic' 'سحر' قريبة منها.. الـ 'Majesty' فيها سحر وعظمة وهيبة الملوك.

armA.definition: Relating to the Middle Ages (roughly 500–1500 AD).
armA.arabic: حاجة ليها علاقة بالعصور الوسطى، زمن القلاع والفرسان.
examples: An old castle.
Knights lived in medieval times.
We visited a medieval town in France.
The museum has a collection of medieval art.
The legal system was described as positively medieval.
Medieval philosophy attempted to reconcile faith with reason.
armA.mnemonic: فيها 'Mid' يعني وسط.. 'Medieval' يعني العصور الوسطى.

armB.definition: Connected with the Middle Ages, the historical period in Europe between roughly 500 and 1500 AD.
armB.arabic: صفة تشير الى كل ما يتعلق بفترة القرون الوسطى في التاريخ الاوروبي، الممتدة تقريبا من القرن الخامس الى الخامس عشر الميلادي.
examples: The museum exhibits a stunning collection of medieval armor and weapons.
Scholars gathered to examine the rare medieval manuscript preserved in the vault.
Many European towns still preserve their medieval street layouts and stone walls.
armB.mnemonic: تذكر الكلمة من جزايين لاتينيين med بمعنى وسط مثل middle و ev بمعنى عصر او زمن مثل era لتعني حرفيا العصور الوسطى

armA.definition: The state of being unsure or not knowing what will happen.
armA.arabic: حالة عدم التأكد أو الشك في حاجة معينة وإنك مش عارف إيه اللي هيحصل.
examples: There is uncertainty about the weather.
The uncertainty made him nervous.
Economic uncertainty affects everyone.
There is still some uncertainty regarding the date.
The project was plagued by scientific uncertainty.
He faced the uncertainty of his future with stoic calm.
armA.mnemonic: عكس 'Certainty' 'يقين'.. الـ 'Uncertainty' هي 'الحيرة' وعدم التأكد.

armB.definition: A state of doubt, hesitation, or lack of sure knowledge about something.
armB.arabic: حالة من الشك أو الحيرة وعدم التأكد والاطمئنان بشأن ما قد يحدث مستقبلا أو بشأن حقيقة أمر ما.
examples: Economic uncertainty caused many companies to delay their hiring plans.
There is considerable uncertainty about the final outcome of the election.
She faced the future with a mixture of hope and uncertainty.
armB.mnemonic: تذكر ان كلمة "certain" تعني اكيد او واثق، والبادئة "un-" تنفي المعنى فتصبح غير اكيد، واللاحقة "-ty" تحولها لاسم بمعنى حالة عدم التأكد والشك.

armA.definition: The floor of an entrance; or the level at which something starts to happen.
armA.arabic: العتبة بتاعة الباب، أو الحد الفاصل. يعني النقطة اللي لو عديتها بتدخل في مرحلة جديدة 'زي عتبة الألم'.
examples: He stood on the threshold.
She crossed the threshold into the house.
I have a low threshold for boredom.
If income rises above this threshold, you pay tax.
We are on the threshold of a new era in medicine.
The stimulus failed to reach the threshold required for neural activation.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Hold' يعني يمسك.. الـ 'Threshold' هو 'العتبة' اللي بتمسك الباب، أو الحد اللي لو عديته الدنيا تتغير.

armB.definition: The level, point, or value at which something begins, changes, or takes effect.
armB.arabic: نقطة البداية أو الحد الأدنى الذي يبدأ عنده شيء ما في الحدوث أو التأثير، كعتبة الألم أو الحد الأدنى للدخل.
examples: He has a remarkably high pain threshold and rarely complains.
If inflation crosses that threshold, the central bank will raise interest rates.
Scientists believe the ecosystem is nearing a critical threshold of irreversible damage.
armB.mnemonic: تخيل كلمة "hold" بمعنى يمسك عند العتبة او المدخل لتقف قبل ان تعبر الى نقطة البداية الجديدة

armA.definition: A thick rubber ring fitted around a wheel to provide grip and cushion movement.
armA.arabic: إطار مطاطي دائري يحيط بعجلة السيارة أو الدراجة ليمنحها الثبات ويساعدها على الحركة بسلاسة.
examples: I had to stop the car because the front tire was losing air.
Always keep a spare tire in your car in case of an emergency.
He checked the tire pressure before setting out on the long drive.
armA.mnemonic: تخيل كلمة "tire" كأنها قريبة في الصوت من طائر يطير بسرعة، وتذكر أن السيارة تطير على الطريق بفضل كل "tire" سليم في عجلاتها

armB.definition: A rubber covering placed around a wheel to protect it and grip the road.
armB.arabic: الإطار المطاط اللي بيتحط حولين عجل العربية عشان تمشي عليه.
examples: My car has a flat tire.
We need to change the tire.
The mechanic checked the tire pressure.
Winter tires are essential for driving in snow.
The friction of the tire on the road generates heat.
He scrutinized the tire tread for signs of uneven wear.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'Tire' قريبة من 'Ta-yer'.. زي ما بنقول 'طَايِر' بالعربية، والعربية بتمشي على الـ 'Tire'.

armA.definition: The measurement or extent of something from side to side.
armA.arabic: العرض بتاع أي حاجة، يعني المسافة من الجنب ده للجنب ده.
examples: What is the width of the box?
Measure the width of the room.
The road varies in width.
The fabric is available in different widths.
The width of his knowledge is impressive.
They swam the entire width of the river against the current.
armA.mnemonic: جاية من 'Wide' 'واسع'.. الـ 'Width' هو قديش الحاجة واسعة.

armB.definition: The measurement or distance of something from side to side.
armB.arabic: المسافة المقاسة عبر شيء ما من جانب إلى جانب آخر، أي العرض أو الاتساع.
examples: The width of the doorway was too narrow for the wheelchair.
Measure the length and width of the room before buying furniture.
The research covers a remarkable width of historical topics.
armB.mnemonic: تذكر الصفة "wide" بمعنى عريض؛ كلمة "width" هي الاسم منها باضافة حرفي th مثل "deep" و "depth".

armA.definition: Extremely strange, unusual, or unconventional in appearance, style, or character.
armA.arabic: يصف شيئا غريبا جدا وغير مألوف بشكل يثير الدهشة أو الاستغراب.
examples: She wore a bizarre costume covered in bright feathers and clock parts.
The detective uncovered a series of bizarre coincidences surrounding the case.
It felt bizarre to see my quiet hometown featured on international news.
armA.mnemonic: تذكر كلمة بازار حيث تعرض في بعض الاسواق اشياء قديمة وغريبة جدا لتتذكر ان كلمه "bizarre" تعني غريب وشاذ

armB.definition: Very strange and unusual, often in a surprising way.
armB.arabic: حاجة غريبة جداً وغير مألوفة، بتخليك تستغرب لما تشوفها لأنها مش طبيعية.
examples: That is a bizarre hat.
He wore a bizarre costume to the party.
It was a bizarre situation.
The movie had a bizarre ending.
She witnessed a bizarre sequence of events.
His behavior became increasingly bizarre and unpredictable.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'Bizarre' بتفكرنا بـ 'Bazaar' 'سوق'.. والسوق بيبقى فيه حاجات 'غريبة' وعجيبة.

armA.definition: In a way that is suitable or appropriate for the situation.
armA.arabic: يعني تتصرف بناءً على الموقف، أو تعمل اللي يناسب الظروف اللي إنت فيها.
examples: Act well.
Check the rules and act accordingly.
She was an expert, and they paid her accordingly.
The cost of materials rose, and we adjusted our prices accordingly.
Please inform us of your decision so we can proceed accordingly.
The circumstances have changed; accordingly, we must revise our strategy.
armA.mnemonic: جاية من 'Accord' يعني اتفاق.. 'Accordingly' يعني طبقاً للاتفاق ده أو بناءً عليه.

armB.definition: In a way that is appropriate to the particular circumstances, or as a direct result.
armB.arabic: بناء على ما سبق أو تبعا لذلك؛ التصرف بطريقة ملائمة للموقف أو كنتيجة طبيعية له.
examples: The rules have changed, and you must act accordingly.
Costs have risen sharply, and accordingly, prices must increase.
We identified several risks early on and planned our strategy accordingly.
armB.translations: بناءً على ذلك / تبعاً لذلك / وِفْقاً لذلك
armB.mnemonic: تذكر عبارة according to التي تعني بحسب، واضافة ly تجعلها ظرفا يعني بناء على ذلك او تبعا لذلك.

armA.definition: A large group of musicians who play many different instruments together.
armA.arabic: فرقة موسيقية كبيرة فيها آلات كتير زي الكمان والطبول وآلات النفخ بيعزفوا مع بعض.
examples: The orchestra plays music.
I play violin in the school orchestra.
The orchestra gave a wonderful concert.
He conducts the London Symphony Orchestra.
The composer wrote this piece specifically for a chamber orchestra.
The rich texture of the orchestra brought the symphony to life.
armA.mnemonic: نفس الكلمة بالعربي 'أوركسترا'، فرقة موسيقية كبيرة.

armB.definition: A large group of musicians playing different instruments together, usually led by a conductor.
armB.arabic: مجموعة كبيرة من العازفين الذين يؤدون مقطوعات موسيقية معا باستخدام آلات متنوعة تحت قيادة قائد الفرقة.
examples: She plays the violin in a famous symphony orchestra.
The orchestra rehearsed for hours before the opening night.
Tickets for the front rows of the orchestra were completely sold out.
armB.mnemonic: الكلمة مستخدمة في العربية بنفس اللفظ تقريبا أوركسترا مما يسهل تذكرها كفرقة موسيقية ضخمة

armA.definition: Any person at all; used in questions and negative sentences.
armA.arabic: أي شخص مهما كان، بتستخدم عادة في الأسئلة والنفي زي 'محدش جه' أو 'هل فيه حد هنا؟'.
examples: Can anyone help me?
I don't know anyone here.
If anyone calls, take a message.
Has anyone seen my keys?
It was a feat that anyone would be proud of.
He is more qualified than anyone to lead the team.
armA.mnemonic: 'Any' 'أي' + 'One' 'واحد'.. يعني أي واحد.

armB.definition: Any person, used mainly in questions and negative statements or to mean no matter who.
armB.arabic: يُستخدم للإشارة إلى أي شخص دون تحديد، ويكثر استعماله في صيغ الاستفهام والنفي أو للتعبير عن التعميم.
examples: Is anyone at home right now?
I did not see anyone in the room.
Anyone can learn English with regular practice.
armB.mnemonic: تتكون الكلمة بوضوح من "any" بمعنى أي و "one" بمعنى شخص أو واحد، وتدل على أي شخص على الإطلاق دون تخصيص

armA.definition: The protruding part of the face below the mouth.
armA.arabic: منطقة الدقن اللي في وشك تحت بوقك.
examples: He has a small chin.
She rested her chin on her hand.
He rubbed the stubble on his chin.
Keep your chin up, things will get better.
The boxer took a heavy blow to the chin.
He has a prominent, cleft chin.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Chin' قريبة من 'Cheek'.. الاتنين في الوش.

armB.definition: The bottom part of the human face located directly below the mouth.
armB.arabic: الجزء السفلي من وجه الانسان الواقع تحت الفم مباشرة.
examples: He rubbed his chin thoughtfully while reading the message.
She fell off her bicycle and cut her chin.
Water was up to my chin as I stepped into the deep pool.
armB.mnemonic: تخيل شخصا يضع يده على اسفل وجهه وهو يفكر بعمق ويقول بصوت خافت تشين في اشارة الى كلمة "chin".

armA.definition: A specific type of animal or plant within a species.
armA.arabic: نوع معين أو فصيلة من الحيوانات، زي أنواع الكلاب أو القطط المختلفة.
examples: What breed is your dog?
This is a rare breed of cat.
Farmers choose the best breed for milk production.
German Shepherds are a popular breed for police work.
He represents a dying breed of old-school journalists.
The sheer diversity within the canine breed is genetically fascinating.
armA.mnemonic: اربطها بكلمة 'Brother'.. الـ 'Breed' هم الأخوة من نفس الفصيلة والنوع.

armB.definition: A specific type of domesticated animal having a distinctive appearance and developed by deliberate selection.
armB.arabic: سلالة معينة من الحيوانات المستأنسة تتميز بصفات ومظهر محدد نتج عن التزاوج المنظم، وتستخدم أحيانا مجازيا لوصف صنف أو طراز من البشر.
examples: The golden retriever is an exceptionally friendly and intelligent dog breed.
Independent journalists of her investigative calibre represent a dying breed today.
Farmers introduced a hardy sheep breed to withstand the severe mountain winters.
armB.mnemonic: تذكر كلمة "breed" بربطها بكلمة بريد، فتخيل ساعي بريد يحمل رسائل خاصة بنسب سلالة نادرة من الكلاب.

armA.definition: To measure how heavy someone or something is, or to have a particular heaviness.
armA.arabic: يقيس ثقل أو وزن شيء ما أو شخص، أو يمتلك وزنا معينا.
examples: Please weigh the apples before putting them in your bag.
How much does the package weigh?
You should weigh the advantages and disadvantages carefully before making a choice.
armA.mnemonic: تذكر ان كلمة "weigh" تشبه في النطق كلمة "way" اي طريق، تخيل انك تقف على ميزان في منتصف الطريق لتقيس وزنك.

armB.definition: To measure how heavy someone or something is.
armB.arabic: توزن حاجة عشان تعرف هي كام كيلو، أو تفكر في قرار وتقارن بين الاختيارات.
examples: I weigh 70 kilos.
Please weigh the fruit.
He weighed himself on the scales.
You need to weigh the pros and cons.
The evidence weighed heavily against him.
She had to weigh her words carefully before speaking.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'Way' 'طريق'.. وانت في الـ 'Way' للمطار لازم تعمل 'Weigh' 'وزن' للشنط بتاعتك.

armA.definition: A sudden start or occurrence of disease, violence, or war.
armA.arabic: ظهور مفاجئ وسريع لشيء غير مرغوب فيه، وغالبا ما يستخدم لوصف تفشي الأمراض أو اندلاع الحروب والعنف.
examples: Health officials quickly moved to contain the sudden outbreak before it spread to neighboring towns.
Tensions in the region led to a violent outbreak that lasted several days.
The hospital prepared extra isolation beds in anticipation of a winter outbreak.
armA.mnemonic: تخيل شيئا ضارا كان محبوسا بالداخل وفجأة كسر الباب وخرج "out" + "break" ليتفشى بسرعة في كل مكان.

armB.definition: A sudden occurrence of something unwelcome, such as war or disease.
armB.arabic: تفشي أو اندلاع. لما حاجة وحشة زي مرض أو حرب تبدأ فجأة وتنتشر.
examples: The war started.
Everyone got sick suddenly.
Doctors are fighting the outbreak of the flu.
The outbreak of war changed everything.
The government tried to contain the cholera outbreak.
Epidemiologists traced the source of the viral outbreak to a local market.
armB.mnemonic: 'Out' 'بره' + 'Break' 'كسر'.. المرض كسر الحواجز وخرج 'Out' وانتشر في كل مكان

armA.definition: To counteract something by having an opposing force or effect.
armA.arabic: إنك تعوض تأثير حاجة بحاجة تانية عكسها عشان تعمل توازن.
examples: The costs offset the profit.
One mistake can offset all the good work.
We need to offset the carbon emissions.
The gains in sales were offset by the rising costs.
Donations helped to offset the budget deficit.
The drug's benefits are offset by its severe side effects.
armA.mnemonic: عشان تظبط الـ 'Set'، لازم تعمل 'Offset' 'توازن' للخسارة بمكسب من ناحية تانية.

armB.definition: To balance, counteract, or compensate for something by producing an opposing effect.
armB.arabic: يعوض أو يوازن أثرا سلبيا بأثر إيجابي معاكس، بحيث يقلل من الضرر أو التكلفة.
examples: The company hopes that strong international sales will offset declining domestic revenue.
They decided to plant trees to help offset their carbon emissions from travel.
Extra tax credits can sometimes offset the higher cost of living in large cities.
armB.mnemonic: تخيل انك تضع شيئا بعيدا عن الميزان off لتثبت set الكفة الاخرى وتحدث التوازن والتعويض.

armA.definition: Easy to see, notice, or understand from facts or circumstances.
armA.arabic: صفة تدل على ان الامر واضح وجلي ولا يحتاج الى جهد لادراكه او فهمه، غالبا لوجود دلائل مباشرة.
examples: It soon became evident that the two companies could not agree on the deal.
His tiredness was evident from the dark circles under his eyes.
There was no evident reason for the sudden change in policy.
armA.mnemonic: تذكر كلمة "evidence" التي تعني دليل، فالامر الذي يحتوي على دليل يكون "evident" اي واضح وظاهر للجميع.

armB.definition: Plain or obvious; clearly seen or understood.
armB.arabic: واضح جداً وظاهر للكل، ومش محتاج تفكير كتير عشان تفهمه.
examples: It is evident to me.
His sadness was evident.
It became evident that he was lost.
Her talent was evident from a young age.
The success of the policy is evident in the statistics.
It is self-evident that all men are created equal.
armB.mnemonic: جاية من 'Evidence' 'دليل'.. لما الدليل يكون موجود، الحقيقة بتبقى 'Evident' 'واضحة'.

armA.definition: In a good, satisfactory, or skillful way.
armA.arabic: يستخدم لوصف أداء عمل ما بطريقة جيدة أو صحيحة أو بإتقان.
examples: She speaks English very well.
Did you sleep well last night?
The team played well and won the match.
armA.mnemonic: تذكر ان كلمة "well" تبدا بحرف W مثل كلمة "wonderful" وكلاهما يعبران عن الجودة والشيء الجيد

armB.definition: In a good or satisfactory way.
armB.arabic: بشكل كويس أو جيد. عكس 'Badly'.
examples: She cooks very well.
I know him well.
The team played well today.
You did well to tell the truth.
This implies that the system works well.
The policy was well received by the public.
armB.mnemonic: عكس 'Ill'.. 'Well' يعني كويس.

armA.definition: A general vote by the electorate on a single political question.
armA.arabic: استفتاء شعبي، يعني لما الحكومة تسأل الشعب كله عن رأيهم في موضوع مهم ويصوتوا بنعم أو لا.
examples: People voted in the referendum.
The referendum is next week.
They held a referendum on independence.
The results of the referendum were surprising.
The government promised a referendum on the new constitution.
Critics argued the referendum was merely a political maneuver.
armA.mnemonic: فيها كلمة 'Refer' 'يرجع'.. الحكومة بترجع للشعب تاخد رأيه في الـ 'Referendum'.

armB.definition: A direct vote by the whole electorate on a single specific political question.
armB.arabic: تصويت شعبي عام ومباشر يشارك فيه المواطنون للموافقة على قرار سياسي محدد أو رفضه.
examples: The government decided to hold a national referendum on the proposed constitution.
Voters rejected the treaty by a narrow margin in the recent referendum.
A referendum is considered a key instrument of direct democracy.
armB.mnemonic: الكلمة اللاتينية الأصلية تعني الشيء الذي يجب إحالته للشعب، تذكر احالة الامر او الرجوع اليه من الفعل refer ليقرر الجميع.

armA.definition: A line or border separating two countries; the extreme limit of understanding or achievement.
armA.arabic: الحدود الفاصلة بين بلدين، أو آخر مكان وصله الناس قبل المجهول، سواء في الأرض أو العلم.
examples: They crossed the frontier.
Soldiers guard the frontier.
Space is the final frontier.
We lived near the frontier with Canada.
Researchers are pushing back the frontiers of science.
The novel explores the harsh life on the American frontier.
armA.mnemonic: 'Front' 'أمام'.. الـ 'Frontier' هو الخط اللي في الـ 'Front' بينك وبين العالم الجديد.

armB.definition: A border separating two countries, or the extreme limit of settled land or knowledge.
armB.arabic: الحد الفاصل بين دولتين، أو أقصى نقطة وصل إليها الاستيطان البشري، وتستخدم مجازيا للإشارة إلى حدود المعرفة والاكتشاف.
examples: Security was tightened along the international frontier to prevent illegal crossings.
Space exploration represents the final frontier of modern human adventure.
Gene editing has pushed back the frontier of biological medicine.
armB.mnemonic: تذكر كلمة "front" وتعني الواجهة أو المقدمة، فالكلمة تشير إلى أقصى حد أو واجهة البلاد وأطرافها المتقدمة.

armA.definition: Complete lack of inhibition or restraint.
armA.arabic: الانطلاق بحرية تامة من غير أي قيود أو كسوف.. زي لما ترقص بجنون.
examples: (Noun usage rare at A1)
(Noun usage rare at A2)
He drove with reckless abandon.
She danced with total abandon.
They spent money with wild abandon.
He threw himself into the project with characteristic abandon.
armA.mnemonic: اربطها بـ 'Band' 'فرقة موسيقية'.. لما تسمع الـ 'Band' بترقص بـ 'Abandon' 'انطلاق وحرية'.

armB.definition: A state of complete freedom from care, self-control, or social rules.
armB.arabic: حالة من الاندفاع أو التصرف بحرية تامة دون قلق، أو مبالاة، أو كبح للذات، وتظهر غالبا في التعبير الفني أو المرح الصاخب.
examples: They danced with reckless abandon until the early hours of the morning.
She sang with such joyous abandon that the entire audience stood up.
The team attacked with complete abandon, ignoring defensive precautions.
armB.mnemonic: تخيل شخصا قرر ان يرمي خلفه كل القيود في فرقة موسيقية "a band on" ويعزف بحرية وانطلاق كامل دون اي كبح لنفسه

armA.definition: Clothing worn next to the skin underneath other clothes.
armA.arabic: الملابس التي تُلبس مباشرة على الجسم تحت الثياب الخارجية للحماية والنظافة.
examples: He packed clean socks and underwear for the weekend trip.
Always choose cotton underwear because it is breathable and comfortable.
Thermal underwear is essential when working outside in freezing temperatures.
armA.mnemonic: تتكون الكلمة من "under" أي تحت و"wear" أي ملابس، فهي تعني حرفيا ما ترتديه تحت ملابسك العادية.

armB.definition: Clothing worn under other clothes, next to the skin.
armB.arabic: الهدوم اللي بتتلبس تحت اللبس الخارجي وملاصقة للجسم.
examples: I bought new underwear.
Put on clean underwear every day.
He packed socks and underwear for the trip.
Thermal underwear is essential for skiing.
The brand launched a new line of luxury underwear.
Historical analysis of underwear reveals changes in social norms.
armB.mnemonic: هي 'Under' يعني 'تحت' و 'Wear' يعني 'لبس'.. يبقى 'Underwear' هو 'اللبس اللي تحت'.

armA.definition: able to be done or achieved, or able to happen.
armA.arabic: يصف شيئا يمكن حدوثه أو تحقيقه، أي أنه غير مستحيل ويمكن تنفيذه.
examples: Is it possible to buy tickets online?
Please call me back as soon as possible.
We need to consider every possible solution to this problem.
armA.mnemonic: تذكر ان كلمة "possible" تبدأ بنفس بداية فيلم المهمة المستحيلة "Mission Impossible" لكن بدون أداة النفي im فيكون معناها ممكن وقابل للتحقيق

armB.definition: Able to be done or achieved; that may exist or happen.
armB.arabic: يعني حاجة ممكن تحصل أو تقدر تعملها، مش مستحيلة.
examples: Is it possible to walk there?
Please come as soon as possible.
It is possible that it will rain tomorrow.
We are looking for a possible solution to the problem.
Space travel made the impossible possible.
They discussed all possible contingencies before starting the project.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'Possible' فيها 'Pass'.. يعني الامتحان ده ممكن تنجح وتعمل فيه 'Pass' لأنه 'Possible'.

armA.definition: Gently, delicately, or with little force.
armA.arabic: بخفة وبساطة، من غير قوة أو عنف. ممكن تيجي بمعنى عدم الاهتمام كفاية 'استخفاف'.
examples: It is raining lightly.
She knocked lightly on the door.
Season the food lightly with salt.
Don't take this warning lightly.
He was let off lightly by the judge.
She stepped lightly across the fragile ice.
armA.mnemonic: من 'Light' 'خفيف'.. 'Lightly' يعني بتعمل الحاجة وإيدك خفيفة

armB.definition: With very little force, pressure, or weight, or without taking something seriously.
armB.arabic: بخفة أو برفق دون استخدام قوة أو ضغط كبير، وتستخدم مجازيا بمعنى عدم أخذ الأمر بجدية أو استخفاف به.
examples: She tapped him lightly on the shoulder to get his attention.
Season the grilled fish lightly with salt and black pepper.
This serious warning should not be taken lightly by anyone.
armB.mnemonic: تذكر كلمة "light" بمعنى خفيف، فإضافة "ly" تحولها إلى حال يعني بخفة أو دون ثقل.

armA.definition: Having an empty space inside; not solid.
armA.arabic: مجوَّف.. يعني فاضي من جوا مش مصمت، زي الماسورة أو جذع شجرة فاضي
examples: The ball is hollow inside.
Owls often live in hollow trees.
His voice sounded hollow in the empty room.
It was a hollow victory because nobody celebrated.
She felt a hollow emptiness in her chest after he left.
The politician's promises turned out to be hollow.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Hollow' أولها 'Hole'.. يعني جواها خرم أو فراغ كبير

armB.definition: Having an empty space or cavity inside rather than being solid throughout.
armB.arabic: يصف الشيء المجوف أو الفارغ من الداخل وليس مصمتا، كما يستعمل مجازيا لوصف الوعود أو المشاعر الزائفة التي لا معنى حقيقيا لها.
examples: The owls made their nest inside a hollow tree trunk.
His hollow promises failed to convince anyone on the team.
A hollow sound echoed when he knocked against the wooden wall.
armB.mnemonic: تذكر كلمة "hole" اي حفرة او ثقب، فالشيء الذي به ثقوب وفراغ واسع بالداخل هو "hollow" اي مجوف وفارغ.

armA.definition: Nervous, stressed, and unable to relax; causing anxiety or strain.
armA.arabic: وصف للشخص القلق العاجز عن الاسترخاء، أو للموقف المليء بالضغط والترقب العصبي.
examples: He felt very tense before stepping onto the stage for his presentation.
There was a tense silence in the meeting room after the bad news.
The border dispute created a tense situation between both nations.
armA.mnemonic: تذكر كلمة "tension" أي التوتر فالصفة "tense" تصف الشخص أو الموقف المتوتر المشدود مثل وتر الآلة الموسيقية

armB.definition: Stretched tight or rigid; unable to relax due to nervousness.
armB.arabic: لما تكون مشدود وقلقان وأعصابك تعبانة، أو وصف للعضلة لما تكون مشدودة.
examples: He looks tense.
My muscles are tense after the gym.
The atmosphere in the room was very tense.
She gets tense before exams.
There was a tense silence before the verdict was read.
Diplomatic relations between the two countries remain tense.
armB.mnemonic: شبه 'Ten' 'عشرة'.. كأنك شايل 'Ten' كيلو على كتافك فبقيت 'Tense'.

armA.definition: The money a passenger must pay for a journey on public transport.
armA.arabic: الفلوس اللي بتدفعها عشان تركب مواصلة زي التاكسي أو القطر أو الأتوبيس.
examples: How much is the bus fare?
I paid the taxi fare.
Train fares have increased this year.
Children travel for half fare.
The airline introduced a new range of low-cost fares.
Fare evasion is a serious offense on the subway system.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Fare' قريبة من 'Fair' 'عادل'.. لازم تدفع 'Fare' 'أجرة' تكون 'Fair' عشان السواق ميزعلش.

armB.definition: The money a passenger pays to travel on public transport such as a bus, train, or taxi.
armB.arabic: المبلغ المالي أو الأجرة التي يدفعها الراكب للتنقل بوسائل المواصلات كالحافلة أو القطار أو سيارة الأجرة.
examples: Bus fare has increased twice already this year.
He did not have enough cash to pay the taxi fare home.
Airlines often reduce the standard fare during the winter months.
armB.mnemonic: تذكر ان كلمة fare تشبه كلمة fair العادل فتخيل انك تدفع سعر عادل كاجرة ركوب

armA.definition: To express the sense of words or text in another language.
armA.arabic: يترجم، يعني يحول الكلام من لغة للغة تانية.
examples: Can you translate this?
He translates from English to Arabic.
I used an app to translate the menu.
His books have been translated into many languages.
It is difficult to translate poetry.
The idea doesn't translate well to the screen.
armA.mnemonic: 'Trans' 'نقل' + 'Late' 'متأخر'.. المترجم بينقل المعنى من غير ما يكون 'Late'.

armB.definition: To express words or text in another language while preserving the original meaning.
armB.arabic: تحويل الكلمات أو النصوص المكتوبة أو المنطوقة من لغة إلى لغة أخرى مع الحفاظ على المعنى الأصلي.
examples: Can you translate this document from French into English?
Online software can quickly translate simple phrases for travelers.
The company hired a specialist to translate their legal contracts.
armB.mnemonic: تذكر البادئة اللاتينية "trans" التي تعني عبر أو نقل، فالفعل يعني حرفيا نقل الكلمات عبر اللغات.

armA.definition: A picture, drawing, or diagram in a book or magazine that explains or decorates text.
armA.arabic: صورة أو رسم توضيحي يوضع في كتاب أو مجلة للشرح أو التزيين، وتأتي أيضا بمعنى مثال واضح يفسر فكرة معينة.
examples: The children's book contains a colorful illustration on every page.
He provided a clear illustration of how the new software functions.
This case serves as a perfect illustration of why safety rules matter.
armA.mnemonic: تذكر كلمة "illustrate" التي تشبه "lustre" أو البريق والضوء اللاتيني، فالكلمة تعني تسليط الضوء على المعنى بالرسم أو المثال.

armB.definition: A picture illustrating a book or newspaper, or an example that clarifies something.
armB.arabic: صورة بتترسم عشان توضح فكرة في كتاب أو مجلة، أو مثال بيتشرح عشان يسهل الفهم.
examples: This book has a nice illustration.
The illustration shows how the machine works.
She is studying fashion illustration at college.
Let me give you an illustration of what I mean.
The incident serves as a graphic illustration of the dangers involved.
His argument was supported by the illustration of several historical precedents.
armB.mnemonic: جاية من 'Illustrate' يعني يوضح.. الـ 'Illustration' هي الصورة اللي بتوضح المعنى.

armA.definition: To teach someone, especially over a period of time at a school, college, or university.
armA.arabic: أن تعلم شخصا وتزوده بالمعرفة والمهارات، خاصة من خلال الدراسة المنتظمة في مدرسة أو جامعة.
examples: The charity aims to educate children in poor communities.
Schools should educate students about healthy eating habits.
They want to educate the public on the dangers of climate change.
armA.mnemonic: تذكر أن أصل الكلمة اللاتيني يعني أن تقود الشخص وتخرجه نحو النور والمعرفة والتعليم.

armB.definition: To give intellectual, moral, and social instruction to someone.
armB.arabic: تعلم حد وتديله معلومات وثقافة، مش بس دراسة في المدرسة، تربية كمان.
examples: Schools educate children.
He wants to educate himself about art.
Parents must educate their kids on safety.
The program aims to educate the public about health risks.
It is difficult to educate people who do not want to learn.
We must educate the next generation to be responsible citizens.
armB.mnemonic: قريبة من 'Cat'.. تخيل إنك بتحاول 'Educate' 'تعلّم' الـ 'Cat' بتاعتك تقرأ.

armA.definition: Having or showing good manners and respect for the feelings of others.
armA.arabic: صفة تصف الشخص المهذب أو التصرف الذي يظهر احتراما ومراعاة لمشاعر الآخرين وقواعد اللباقة.
examples: The waiter was very polite and helpful.
It is not polite to speak with food in your mouth.
She wrote a polite letter thanking them for the invitation.
armA.mnemonic: تذكر كلمة "polite" بربطها بكلمة "polish" أي صقل وتلميع؛ فالشخص المهذب يبدو كلامه مصقولا ولبقا أمام الناس.

armB.definition: Having or showing behavior that is respectful and considerate of other people.
armB.arabic: مؤدب أو مهذب. الشخص اللي بيحترم الناس وبيتعامل بذوق.
examples: He is a polite boy.
It is polite to say thank you.
Please be polite to the guests.
She gave a polite smile but didn't say anything.
They maintained a polite distance from each other.
Under the veneer of polite society, fierce rivalries existed.
armB.mnemonic: الـ 'Police' بيحفظ النظام.. والـ 'Polite' بيحفظ الأدب والذوق في التعامل

armA.definition: A solemn promise or undertaking.
armA.arabic: وعد رسمي أو عهد قاطع بإنك تعمل حاجة.
examples: It is a pledge.
He made a pledge to help.
They fulfilled their pledge to cut taxes.
The government gave a pledge to improve schools.
He took a solemn pledge of secrecy.
The donor honored his pledge of one million dollars to the charity.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Pledge' قريبة من 'Please'.. كأنك بتقول 'Please believe me' أنا بوعدك.

armB.definition: A formal, serious promise or agreement to do something, especially publicly or officially.
armB.arabic: تعهد او وعد رسمي قاطع يلتزم به شخص او جهة للقيام بعمل ما او تقديم دعم معين.
examples: The government honored its pledge to invest heavily in public healthcare.
She made a substantial financial pledge to help rebuild the historic library.
The candidate signed a formal pledge promising not to raise taxes.
armB.mnemonic: تخيل شخصا يضع يده على قلبه ليقدم تعهدا جادا بالالتزام؛ كلمة "pledge" تشبه نطق كلمة تدل على حافة الالتزام والجدية.

armA.definition: To dismiss someone from employment; also to plunder and destroy a captured place.
armA.arabic: يطرد حد من الشغل 'يرفده'، أو ينهب مدينة ويسرقها 'في الحروب'.
examples: They sack bad workers.
Don't sack him, please.
The manager threatened to sack anyone who was late.
She was sacked for stealing money.
The invading army proceeded to sack the town.
The quarterback was sacked three times in the first quarter.
armA.mnemonic: زمان كانوا بيدوا العامل 'Sack' 'شوال' يلم فيه حاجته وهو ماشي، فبقت 'Sack' يعني يطرد.

armB.definition: To dismiss someone from their employment, especially because of poor performance or misconduct.
armB.arabic: طرد شخص من وظيفته أو إنهاء خدمته، وغالبا ما يستخدم الفعل في سياق غير رسمي في الإنجليزية البريطانية والمهنية.
examples: The board decided to sack the manager after another disappointing quarter.
They cannot sack a worker without following proper disciplinary procedures.
Failing to meet security standards could cause the firm to sack key staff members.
armB.mnemonic: تخيل موظفا مطرودا يضع كل أغراض مكتبه في كيس خيش sack ويغادر العمل بعد أن تم فصله

armA.definition: To throw something lightly, casually, or carelessly through the air.
armA.arabic: يرمي شيئا بخفة أو إهمال ودون بذل جهد كبير، مثل قذف عملة معدنية أو كرة لشخص قريب.
examples: Please toss me the car keys before you leave.
They decided to toss a coin to settle who would speak first.
When making decisions under pressure, leaders cannot simply toss critical issues aside.
armA.mnemonic: تذكر صوت العملة المعدنية عندما ترتطم بالصحن بعد رميها، فاربط كلمة "toss" برمي شيء بخفة مثل رمي قطعة نقدية في الهواء.

armB.definition: To throw something lightly or casually.
armB.arabic: يرمي حاجة بخفة أو من غير اهتمام، زي لما ترمي المفاتيح على الترابيزة.
examples: Toss the ball to me.
Please toss the salad.
Don't just toss your clothes on the floor.
He tossed the keys to his brother.
She tossed and turned all night, unable to sleep.
They tossed around a few ideas for the new project.
armB.mnemonic: زي 'طز'.. لما تقول لحد 'طز' ممكن تعمل 'Toss' 'ترمي' حاجة بإيدك.

armA.definition: To come or bring together for a common purpose or action.
armA.arabic: يعني يتحدوا أو يتجمعوا عشان هدف واحد. زي لما الناس تتحد عشان تعمل تغيير أو الدول تتحد في حلف.
examples: We must unite now.
The team united to win the game.
Music can unite people from different cultures.
The two companies decided to unite to increase profits.
The tragedy served to unite the community in grief.
Various factions attempted to unite under a single banner of revolution.
armA.mnemonic: جاية من 'Unit' يعني وحدة.. لما الناس تعمل 'Unite' بيتحولوا لـ 'Unit' 'وحدة' واحدة قوية.

armB.definition: To join together with others to achieve a common purpose or form a single group.
armB.arabic: أن يتحد شخصان أو أكثر أو مجموعات للعمل معاً من أجل تحقيق هدف مشترك، أو الاندماج ليصبحوا كياناً واحداً.
examples: Community leaders hope this project will unite people from different backgrounds.
The two political parties decided to unite against the proposed tax increase.
A shared vision can unite even the most divided nations.
armB.mnemonic: تذكر كلمة "unit" التي تعني وحدة واحدة، فالفعل "unite" يعني جعل الأشخاص أو الأشياء كتلة واحدة متحدة.

armA.definition: To construct something again after it has been damaged, destroyed, or neglected.
armA.arabic: إعادة تشييد أو بناء شيء بعد هدمه أو تضرره، وتُستخدم أيضاً مجازياً لإصلاح العلاقات أو استعادة الثقة.
examples: The government promised to help citizens rebuild their homes after the earthquake.
It took several years to rebuild trust between the two business partners.
The community united to rebuild the local library following the fire.
armA.mnemonic: تذكر البادئة "re" التي تعني إعادة، مع الفعل البسيط "build" الذي يعني يبني، ليكون المعنى الحرفي والمباشر هو إعادة البناء.

armB.definition: To build something again after it has been damaged or destroyed.
armB.arabic: إنك تبني حاجة تاني من الأول بعد ما اتكسرت أو اتهدمت، سواء بيت أو حتى حياتك.
examples: They rebuild the house.
We must rebuild the wall.
The city had to rebuild after the fire.
It takes time to rebuild trust in a relationship.
The government promised to rebuild the shattered economy.
They sought to rebuild the philosophical foundations of the movement.
armB.mnemonic: المقطع 'Re' يعني تاني، و 'Build' يعني يبني.. يبقى المعنى يبني تاني.

armA.definition: Having an affection or liking for someone or something.
armA.arabic: لما تكون بتحب حد أو حاجة ومعتز بيها، أو عندك ذكريات حلوة معاها.
examples: I am fond of cats.
She is fond of her grandmother.
He has fond memories of his childhood.
We bade each other a fond farewell.
She is overly fond of giving advice.
He harbored a fond hope that they would meet again.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Fond' قريبة من 'Found' 'وجد'.. لما تلاقي حد بتحبه بتقول I found someone I am fond of.

armB.definition: Having a strong liking, affection, or love for someone or something.
armB.arabic: يصف الشعور بالمودة والمحبة تجاه شخص ما، أو الميل الشديد والاستمتاع بالقيام بشيء معين.
examples: Over the years, she grew remarkably fond of her quiet rural neighbors.
He has always been fond of classical music and spends hours listening to concerts.
She shared a fond memory of the summers they spent together by the sea.
armB.mnemonic: تذكر كلمة "fond" بالربط مع حلوى الشوكولاتة الذائبة فوندو "fondue" لأن كلاهما يعبر عن حب الشيء والولع الشديد به

armA.definition: A firm hold or grip; mental understanding of something.
armA.arabic: يا إما مسكة قوية بالإيد، يا إما استيعاب وفهم كامل لموضوع معين.
examples: He has a strong grasp.
The baby's grasp is tight.
Success is within our grasp.
She has a good grasp of French.
He failed to loosen his grasp on reality.
Her grasp of quantum physics implies years of study.
armA.mnemonic: افتكر 'Grab' 'يمسك'.. الـ 'Grasp' هي المسكة القوية أو إنك تمسك الفكرة بعقلك وتفهمها.

armB.definition: A firm understanding of a concept, subject, or situation.
armB.arabic: الفهم العميق والشامل لموضوع أو فكرة، أو القدرة على الإحاطة بالأمور وإدراكها بوضوح.
examples: She has an excellent grasp of international finance.
The basic principles of physics are well within his grasp.
A comprehensive grasp of the language requires years of dedicated practice.
armB.mnemonic: تخيل انك تمسك الفكرة بيدك بقوة حتى لا تفلت، فكلمة "grasp" تعني القبضة والامساك بالشيء حسيا وكذلك ادراكه وفهمه ذهنيا تماما كقولنا ممسك بزمام الموضوع.

armA.definition: A long passage in a building with doors leading into rooms on either side.
armA.arabic: ممر طويل جوا مبنى، بيبقى فيه أبواب بتوصل للأوض على الجنبين، زي اللي في المدارس أو المستشفيات.
examples: The bathroom is down the corridor.
Students waited in the corridor for the class to start.
Her office is at the end of the long corridor.
The hotel corridor was lined with beautiful paintings.
They established a humanitarian corridor to aid the civilians.
The bureaucratic corridor of power can be difficult to navigate.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Corridor' شبه 'Car' 'عربية' و 'Door' 'باب'.. تخيل إنك ماشي بـ 'Car' جوه 'Corridor' طويل مليان 'Doors'.

armB.definition: A long, narrow passage inside a building with doors opening into rooms on either side.
armB.arabic: ممر طويل وضيق داخل مبنى يربط بين الغرف المختلفة وتفتح عليه أبوابها.
examples: His office is located at the far end of the corridor.
Students were talking loudly along the corridor between classes.
The government agreed to create a safe humanitarian corridor for civilians.
armB.mnemonic: الكلمة مستخدمة بنفس اللفظ تقريبا في كثير من اللهجات العربية كـ كوليدور أو كوريدور وهي مشتقة من فعل الجري باللاتينية اي الممر الذي يجري فيه الشخص

armA.definition: A flat, paved outdoor area next to a building, used for relaxing, eating, or entertaining.
armA.arabic: مساحة خارجية مسطحة ومبلطة ملحقة بمبنى، مثل الشرفة الكبيرة أو الفناء المرتفع، تُستخدم للجلوس وتناول الطعام في الهواء الطلق.
examples: We enjoyed having breakfast outside on the terrace of the hotel.
The apartment features a wide terrace that overlooks the city park.
They sat on the terrace drinking coffee as the sun began to set.
armA.mnemonic: تذكر ان كلمة "terrace" مشتقة من الكلمة اللاتينية terra التي تعني الارض او اليابسة وتطلق على مكان مبلط ملحق بالارض للجلوس في الهواء الطلق

armB.definition: A level paved area or platform next to a building; a patio or balcony.
armB.arabic: شرفة واسعة أو مساحة مبلطة قدام البيت 'تراس'.
examples: We sat on the terrace.
The hotel has a nice terrace.
They ate lunch on the sunny terrace.
The garden is built on several terraces.
Rice is grown on terraces in the mountains.
The penthouse features a wrap-around terrace with city views.
armB.mnemonic: نفس الكلمة بنستخدمها 'تراس'.

armA.definition: The quality of being trusted and believed in.
armA.arabic: المصداقية.. يعني الناس تصدقك وتثق في كلامك.
examples: He has no credibility.
Lying hurts your credibility.
The scandal damaged the company's credibility.
She built her credibility through years of hard work.
The report lacks scientific credibility.
The witness's credibility was undermined by the cross-examination.
armA.mnemonic: جاية من 'Credit'.. لما يكون عندك 'Credit' عند الناس يعني بيثقوا فيك وعندك 'Credibility'.

armB.definition: The quality of being trusted, believed, or accepted as true and reliable.
armB.arabic: المصداقية أو الجدارة بالثقة، وهي الصفة التي تجعل كلام الشخص أو المصدر قابلا للتصديق والاعتماد عليه.
examples: The witness lost all credibility after contradicting her earlier statements in court.
Repeated policy shifts have damaged the government's credibility among international investors.
Citing reliable scientific research gave greater credibility to his controversial argument.
armB.mnemonic: تذكر كلمة credit التي تعني رصيد او ائتمان فكلمة credibility هي الرصيد المعنوي من الثقة الذي يجعلك تصدق الشخص

armA.definition: A member of the people and cultural community whose traditional religion is Judaism.
armA.arabic: شخص بيتبع الديانة اليهودية أو بينتمي للشعب اليهودي.
examples: He is a Jew.
Jews celebrate Hanukkah.
She learned about the history of the Jews.
The museum honors Jews who fought in the war.
Orthodox Jews follow strict dietary laws.
The diaspora of the Jews is a major historical subject.

armB.definition: A person who belongs to the Jewish people or practices the religion of Judaism.
armB.arabic: الشخص الذي ينتمي إلى الديانة اليهودية أو الشعب اليهودي تاريخيا وثقافيا.
examples: He identified as a secular jew with deep respect for his family heritage.
In ancient history, a jew might have traced their lineage back to the kingdom of Judah.
The author wrote about growing up as a jew in twentieth-century Europe.
armB.mnemonic: تذكر نطق كلمة "jew" الذي يشبه بداية كلمة جودا التاريخية التي ارتبط بها اصل الكلمة.

armA.definition: The natural light that comes directly from the sun during the day.
armA.arabic: الضوء الطبيعي المنبعث من الشمس والذي ينير الأرض خلال النهار.
examples: The room was filled with warm sunlight streaming through the window.
Many plants need direct sunlight for several hours each day to grow properly.
She wore dark glasses to protect her sensitive eyes from the bright sunlight.
armA.mnemonic: تتكون الكلمة بوضوح من "sun" اي شمس و "light" اي ضوء مما يعطيك ضوء الشمس مباشرة وبسهولة.

armB.definition: The light that comes from the sun.
armB.arabic: النور اللي بيجي من الشمس.
examples: The sunlight is warm.
Plants need sunlight to grow.
Bright sunlight filled the room.
Avoid direct sunlight on your skin at noon.
The painting captures the dappled sunlight on the leaves.
Prolonged exposure to intense sunlight can degrade certain materials.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة مركبة من 'Sun' شمس و 'Light' ضوء.. يعني ضوء الشمس.

armA.definition: Able to cause death; extremely dangerous or harmful.
armA.arabic: يصف شيئا مميتا وقادرا على التسبب في الموت أو إلحاق ضرر مدمر للغاية.
examples: The snake venom carries a lethal dose of toxin that acts within minutes.
Police officers were trained to avoid the use of lethal force whenever possible.
Combining alcohol with these prescription sleeping pills can prove lethal.
