armA.mnemonic: تذكر ان الكلمة تبدأ بصوت يشبه ليل في الظلام الدامس الذي يرمز للنهاية والموت فكلمة "lethal" تعني مميت

armB.definition: Sufficient to cause death; very harmful or destructive.
armB.arabic: قاتل أو مميت. حاجة خطيرة جداً لدرجة إنها ممكن تسبب الوفاة.
examples: The snake bite is lethal.
That poison is lethal to rats.
Driving fast can be lethal.
The chemical is lethal in small doses.
The government approved the use of lethal force.
A lethal combination of drugs was found in his system.
armB.mnemonic: شبه كلمة 'Last' 'أخير'.. الجرعة الـ 'Lethal' هي الـ 'Last' 'آخر' حاجة هتاخدها في حياتك.

armA.definition: Refined petroleum used as fuel for internal combustion engines.
armA.arabic: الوقود السائل 'البنزين' اللي بنحطه في العربيات عشان الموتور يشتغل.
examples: The car needs gasoline.
Gasoline is expensive today.
He filled the tank with gasoline.
The engine runs on unleaded gasoline.
Gasoline prices fluctuate with the oil market.
The combustion of gasoline releases carbon dioxide.
armA.mnemonic: هي كلمة 'Gas'.. السائل اللي بيتحول لطاقة.

armB.definition: A clear liquid fuel made from petroleum, used mainly to power car and motor vehicle engines.
armB.arabic: سائل سريع الاشتعال يستخرج من النفط، ويستخدم وقودا لتشغيل محركات السيارات والمركبات.
examples: The car stopped on the highway because it ran out of gasoline.
Rising gasoline prices have forced many commuters to use public transit.
Store gasoline in an approved safety container far away from heat sources.
armB.mnemonic: تذكر بداية الكلمة gas اي غاز مع لاين line، تخيل انبوبا او خطا ينقل وقود السيارات

armA.definition: To take action to solve a problem (deal with) or to distribute cards in a game.
armA.arabic: إنك تتعامل مع مشكلة أو شخص، أو توزع الكوتشينة في اللعب.
examples: I deal the cards now.
I have to deal with this problem immediately.
The book deals with the history of Egypt.
We only deal with reputable companies.
She is used to dealing with difficult customers.
The sanctions were designed to deal a blow to the regime.
armA.mnemonic: لما تقول 'Deal with it' يعني 'اتعامل' مع الموضوع وحله.

armB.definition: To take action to handle a problem or task, usually followed by with.
armB.arabic: يتعامل مع موقف أو مشكلة أو شخص لإيجاد حل أو تنظيم الأمر.
examples: I have to deal with many customers every day.
How do you deal with stress at work?
Teachers often deal with difficult situations in class.
armB.mnemonic: تذكر كلمة "deal" بمعنى صفقة تجارية، فالتاجر الناجح يجب ان يتعامل مع الناس والزبائن بذكاء ليعقد هذه الصفقة.

armA.definition: Complete, total, or absolute, used especially to emphasize negative or extreme states.
armA.arabic: صفة تعني تام أو مطلق أو كامل، وتُستخدم عادة للتوكيد والتشديد على شدة أمر ما، وغالبا في سياقات سلبية أو مفاجئة مثل الفوضى أو الصدمة.
examples: The meeting descended into utter chaos within minutes.
To my utter amazement, they agreed to all our terms.
What he told the police turned out to be utter nonsense.
armA.mnemonic: تذكر كلمة "outer" اي خارجي في الانجليزية القديمة، فالمعنى تطور من الشيء الاقصى في الخارج الى الاقصى والمطلق في الشدة.

armB.definition: Complete; absolute.
armB.arabic: يعني كامل أو مُطلق، زي لما تقول 'فوضى عارمة' أو 'ظلام دامس'.
examples: It was utter silence.
The room was in utter darkness.
That is utter nonsense.
The party was an utter failure.
He looked at me in utter amazement.
The situation descended into utter chaos after the announcement.
armB.mnemonic: شبه 'Outer'.. حاجة واصلة للحد الأقصى 'Utter'.

armA.definition: A big jump or a sudden large change/increase.
armA.arabic: قفزة كبيرة، سواء قفزة حقيقية برجلك أو قفزة وتطور كبير في مستوى حاجة.
examples: The cat made a big leap.
With one leap, he crossed the stream.
It was a leap year with 366 days.
The price of oil took a sudden leap.
Taking that job was a leap in the dark for him.
Technological progress often happens in giant leaps.
armA.mnemonic: قريبة من كلمة 'Lip' شِفّة.. تخيل نملة بتعمل 'Leap' قفزة كبيرة من فوق الـ 'Lip'.

armB.definition: A sudden large jump, or a sudden and important increase or improvement in something.
armB.arabic: قفزة كبيرة ومفاجئة سواء بالحركة الجسدية أو مجازيا كطفرة وتقدم كبير ومفاجئ في مجال ما.
examples: The discovery represents a major leap in modern cancer research.
With one sudden leap, the cat cleared the garden fence.
Accepting the new position abroad felt like a terrifying leap into the unknown.
armB.mnemonic: تذكر عبارة نيل أرمسترونغ الشهيرة حين هبط على القمر one giant leap for mankind اي قفزة واحدة عملاقة للبشرية لربط كلمة "leap" بمعنى القفزة العظيمة او الطفرة.

armA.definition: An act of pressing something firmly; a situation of financial restriction.
armA.arabic: ضغطة قوية بالإيد، أو زنقة في الفلوس أو المكان.
examples: Give the lemon a squeeze.
She gave his hand a gentle squeeze.
It was a tight squeeze to get everyone in the car.
The company is feeling the squeeze from rising costs.
The credit squeeze has affected small businesses.
The government put a squeeze on public spending to curb inflation.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Squeeze' فيها صوت الكاف والزاي زي كأنك بتعصر حاجة 'سكوييز'.

armB.definition: A difficult period when money, resources, or profits are severely reduced or restricted.
armB.arabic: ضائقة مالية أو ضغط اقتصادي حاد يحد من توفر الأموال أو الموارد المتاحة.
examples: Rising inflation has put a severe squeeze on household budgets across the country.
Small businesses are facing a tight credit squeeze as banks raise interest rates.
The government announced spending cuts to survive the current financial squeeze.
armB.mnemonic: تخيل يد تضغط بقوة على محفظتك حتى لا يخرج منها اي مال لتتذكر ان كلمة "squeeze" تعني ضائقة او ازمة مالية خانقة

armA.definition: The joint connecting the upper and lower parts of the human arm.
armA.arabic: المفصل الذي يربط بين الجزء العلوي والسفلي من ذراع الإنسان ويسمح بثنيها، والمعروف بالكوع أو المرفق.
examples: He rested his elbow on the table while listening to the lecture.
She suffered a painful injury to her right elbow during the tennis match.
The plumber replaced a curved pipe elbow under the kitchen sink.
armA.mnemonic: تخيل انك تثني ذراعك لترسم زاوية تشبه حرف L فتربط بين صوت "el" وشكل اليد عند مفصل المرفق

armB.definition: The joint between the forearm and the upper arm.
armB.arabic: الكوع، المفصل اللي بيربط بين دراعك من فوق ومن تحت.
examples: My elbow hurts.
He rested his elbows on the table.
She nudged him with her elbow.
The room was so crowded we were standing elbow to elbow.
He used some elbow grease to clean the floor.
She accidentally banged her funny bone, which is actually the nerve in the elbow.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'Elbow' .. شكل الكوع عامل زي حرف 'L' .. 'L-bow'.

armA.definition: The act of extending or starting an official agreement, process, or relationship again.
armA.arabic: عملية إعادة تمديد أو تجديد شيء رسمي أو سارٍ مثل عقد أو اشتراك أو وثيقة، أو استعادة النشاط والقوة من جديد.
examples: The contract is up for renewal at the end of this month.
Urban renewal projects have revitalized the downtown district.
The spring season brings a sense of renewal and fresh beginnings.
armA.mnemonic: تذكر كلمة "new" في المنتصف، فالمقطع "re" يعني إعادة و"al" للاسم، فتصبح الكلمة ببساطة جعل الشيء جديدا مرة أخرى.

armB.definition: The act of starting something again or extending the validity of an official document.
armB.arabic: إنك تجدد حاجة خلصت مدتها زي اشتراك أو رخصة، أو إنك تبدأ نشاط من تاني بعد وقفة.
examples: The renewal is next month.
I need a passport renewal.
The contract is up for renewal.
Spring is a time of renewal for nature.
Urban renewal projects have transformed the city center.
The spiritual renewal of the community was his main goal.
armB.mnemonic: جاية من 'New' 'جديد'.. 'Re-new' يعني يجدد.. والـ 'Renewal' هو التجديد نفسه زي تجديد الرخصة.

armA.definition: Visually descriptive or figurative language, especially in a literary work.
armA.arabic: الصور البلاغية أو التشبيهات اللي الكاتب بيستخدمها عشان يخليك تتخيل المشهد كأنك شايفه بعينك.
examples: The book has nice imagery.
The poet uses imagery of nature.
Her writing is full of colorful imagery.
The movie uses computer imagery to create monsters.
The poem's dark imagery reflects the author's sadness.
Religious imagery is pervasive throughout Renaissance art.
armA.mnemonic: جاية من 'Image' 'صورة'.. الـ 'Imagery' هو استخدام الكلام لرسم 'Images' في خيالك.

armB.definition: Words or pictures that produce clear mental pictures or evoke sensory feelings, especially in literature or art.
armB.arabic: الصور البيانية أو التشبيهات الفنية في الأدب، أو مجموعة الصور والرموز البصرية التي تنقل معنى معينا أو تثير المشاعر.
examples: The poet uses vivid natural imagery to reflect the character's inner sadness.
Satellite imagery revealed significant changes in the landscape over the past decade.
Religious imagery is central to understanding the painter's later works.

armA.definition: A chief bishop responsible for an archdiocese.
armA.arabic: رتبة دينية كبيرة في المسيحية، بيكون رئيس الأساقفة.
examples: The archbishop prayed.
We saw the archbishop at the church.
The Archbishop of Canterbury is a famous figure.
He was appointed as the new archbishop.
The archbishop delivered a sermon on peace.
Ecclesiastical laws are interpreted by the archbishop.
armA.mnemonic: 'Arch' يعني رئيسي 'زي Arch-enemy' + 'Bishop' أسقف.. يبقى 'رئيس الأساقفة'.

armB.definition: A senior Christian bishop in charge of a large administrative area or several dioceses.
armB.arabic: رئيس أساقفة، وهو رجل دين مسيحي ذو رتبة عالية يشرف على منطقة كنسية كبرى تضم عدة أسقفيات.
examples: The archbishop delivered a solemn sermon during the national ceremony.
Representatives met with the archbishop to discuss community aid programs.
Historically, an archbishop could exert considerable influence over secular rulers.
armB.mnemonic: تتكون الكلمة من "arch" وتعني رئيس أو أعلى رتبة مثل "arch-enemy"، متبوعة بكلمة "bishop" أي أسقف، فتصبح حرفيا رئيس الأساقفة.

armA.definition: A structure leading out from the shore into a body of water, used as a landing stage.
armA.arabic: رصيف خشبي أو حجري ممدود جوه البحر عشان الناس تمشي عليه أو المراكب تقف عنده.
examples: We walked on the pier.
The boat is at the pier.
People were fishing off the end of the pier.
The storm damaged the wooden pier.
The pier features an amusement park and restaurants.
The bridge is supported by concrete piers sunk into the riverbed.
armA.mnemonic: شبه كلمة 'Peer' 'يبحلق'.. بنقف على الـ 'Pier' ونبص على البحر.

armB.definition: A long structure built out from land over water, used as a boat landing or walking area.
armB.arabic: رصيف بحري أو جسر خشبي أو خرساني يمتد من الشاطئ فوق سطح الماء، يُستخدم لرسو القوارب أو للمشي والتنزه.
examples: We took a peaceful evening stroll along the wooden pier.
The ferry docked at the central pier to unload cargo and passengers.
Severe coastal storms caused extensive structural damage to the Victorian pier.
armB.mnemonic: تذكر كلمة "pier" بنطقها القريب من كلمة بير اي بئر في العامية لكنه رصيف يمتد وسط الماء

armA.definition: To suffer something painful or difficult patiently; to remain in existence.
armA.arabic: يتحمل أو يطيق حاجة صعبة زي الألم أو المعاناة. وكمان بتيجي بمعنى يستمر ويبقى.
examples: I cannot endure this noise.
She had to endure a long flight.
They endured many hardships during the war.
His fame endured for centuries.
The company endured despite the economic crisis.
Humanity has the capacity to endure even the most catastrophic events.
armA.mnemonic: لازم تتحمل للآخر 'End' لحد ما نلاقي 'Cure' 'علاج'.. 'Endure'

armB.definition: To suffer something difficult, painful, or unpleasant patiently or without giving up.
armB.arabic: أن يتحمل الشخص أو يصمد أمام صعوبة أو ألم شديد لفترة طويلة دون استسلام.
examples: Many families had to endure extreme cold during the harsh winter.
Athletes must train hard to endure the physical strain of a marathon.
Her classic novels will endure for generations to come.
armB.mnemonic: تذكر كلمة "durable" التي تعني متين ويدوم طويلا، فالفعل "endure" يعني ان يصمد او يتحمل البقاء في وجه الصعاب.

armA.definition: The state of needing someone or something for help, support, or to function properly.
armA.arabic: الاعتماد أو الاتكال على شخص أو شيء معين للحصول على الدعم والمساعدة أو للاستمرار في العمل.
examples: The country wants to reduce its heavy reliance on imported energy.
Her reliance on public transport made moving to the countryside difficult.
Over time, his growing reliance on technology weakened his problem-solving skills.
armA.mnemonic: تذكر الفعل الشهير "rely" ويعني يعتمد، بإضافة اللاحقة "ance" التي تصنع الأسماء، تصبح الكلمة تعني الاعتماد نفسه.

armB.definition: The state of depending on or trusting in something or someone.
armB.arabic: الاعتماد الكلي على حد أو حاجة، وإنك تكون واثق إنهم هيساعدوك.
examples: His reliance on his mom is clear.
We place reliance on good friends.
The country's reliance on oil imports is risky.
Heavy reliance on technology can be a problem.
The company needs to reduce its reliance on a single supplier.
Her self-reliance was forged during years of living alone in the wilderness.
armB.mnemonic: جاية من 'Rely' يعني يعتمد.. الـ 'Reliance' هي الثقة والاعتماد ده.

armA.definition: To explain the meaning of something or translate speech orally.
armA.arabic: لما تترجم كلام حد فوري، أو تشرح وتفسر معنى حاجة غامضة للناس.
examples: Can you interpret this sign?
He interprets for the tourists.
How do you interpret this poem?
Data can be interpreted in many ways.
I interpreted his silence as agreement.
The law was interpreted strictly by the judge.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Enter' 'يدخل'.. المترجم بيدخل 'In' بين الطرفين عشان يعمل 'Interpret' 'يفسر' ويوصل المعنى.

armB.definition: To explain or understand the meaning of something, such as data, art, or actions.
armB.arabic: أن تشرح معنى شيء ما أو تفهمه بطريقة معينة، مثل تفسير البيانات أو تصرفات الآخرين أو الأعمال الفنية.
examples: Scientists must carefully interpret the results before drawing conclusions.
Different people may interpret the same poem in completely different ways.
She was hired to interpret spoken speech during the international conference.
armB.mnemonic: تذكر البادئة اللاتينية inter وتعني بين، فالشخص الذي يقوم بـ interpret يقف وسيطا بين المعنى الغامض والشخص ليوضحه.

armA.definition: Not wanting to do something, often showing hesitation or unwillingness.
armA.arabic: يصف شخصا مترددا أو غير راغب في فعل شيء ما، وغالبا ما يقوم به ببطء أو بعد إلحاح.
examples: He was reluctant to discuss his personal finances with coworkers.
The committee gave its reluctant approval after hours of intense debate.
She was reluctant to leave her hometown, but the new job was too promising to refuse.
armA.mnemonic: تذكر ان الكلمة تتضمن مقطع luct المشتق من اللاتينية بمعنى الصراع فتخيل شخصا في صراع داخلي ومتردد قبل ان يخطو خطوة

armB.definition: Unwilling and hesitant to do something.
armB.arabic: متردد أو مش عايز يعمل حاجة. بيعملها وهو مش راضي.
examples: He was reluctant to go.
She gave a reluctant smile.
I am reluctant to spend so much money.
The government was reluctant to intervene.
He was initially reluctant but eventually agreed.
There is a reluctant acceptance of the new policy.
armB.mnemonic: ممكن تربطها بـ 'Luck'.. هو 'Reluctant' 'متردد' إنه يجرب حظه.

armA.definition: Covered with a lot of fine strands growing from the skin.
armA.arabic: صفة تعني كثير الشعر أو مغطى بالشعر سواء للإنسان أو الحيوان أو حتى النباتات.
examples: He rolled up his sleeves to reveal his hairy arms.
The caterpillar has a soft and hairy body.
Driving on the icy mountain road was a hairy experience.
armA.mnemonic: تذكر كلمة "hair" بمعنى شعر مع إضافة حرف الياء لتصبح "hairy" أي كثير الشعر

armB.definition: Covered with a lot of hair.
armB.arabic: جسمه مليان شعر، أو وصف لحاجة فيها شعر كتير.
examples: The dog is very hairy.
He has a hairy chest.
Spiders have hairy legs.
It was a hairy drive down the mountain.
The caterpillar is small and hairy.
The pilot managed to land the plane after a hairy descent.
armB.mnemonic: جاية من 'Hair' 'شعر'.. واضحة جداً

armA.definition: A small bird with pointed wings OR an act of swallowing food/drink.
armA.arabic: ليها معنيين: يا إما عصفور السنونو الصغير، يا إما بلعة مية أو أكل.
examples: Look at that little swallow flying.
He took a swallow of water.
The swallows migrate south in winter.
She took a deep swallow of her coffee.
One swallow does not make a summer.
With a nervous swallow, he began his speech.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Swallow' قريبة من 'Swollen' 'متورم'.. لو زورك متورم مش هتعرف تعمل 'Swallow' 'تبلع'.

armB.definition: An act of passing food, drink, or saliva down the throat, or a single mouthful taken.
armB.arabic: عملية بلع الطعام أو الشراب وتمريره عبر الحلق، أو المقدار الذي يتم ابتلاعه في رشفة واحدة كجرعة ماء.
examples: He took a quick swallow of water before continuing his presentation.
With one nervous swallow, she stepped onto the stage to address the crowd.
A single swallow of the bitter medicine made him shudder.
armB.mnemonic: تخيل شخصا يتناول رشفة ماء بصوت واضح يشبه كلمة "swallow" ليتذكر انها تعني جرعة او بلعة واحدة

armA.definition: To make a telephone call to someone.
armA.arabic: يتصل بحد في التليفون.
examples: Phone me later.
I will phone a taxi.
She phoned to say she was late.
He phoned in sick today.
I phoned around to find the best price.
The reporter phoned in the story from the scene.
armA.mnemonic: الفعل من 'Phone'.. يعني يستخدم الـ 'Phone' عشان يكلم حد.

armB.definition: To speak to someone by making a telephone call.
armB.arabic: الاتصال بشخص ما والتحدث إليه عبر الهاتف.
examples: I will phone you when I arrive at the station.
Please phone the office if you need help.
Can I use your mobile to phone my mother?
armB.mnemonic: تذكر ان كلمة "phone" تعني جهاز الهاتف ذاته واستخدامها كفعل يعني ببساطة إجراء مكالمة هاتفية

armA.definition: Careful to avoid potential problems, danger, or mistakes.
armA.arabic: وصف للشخص أو التصرف الذي يتسم بالحذر واليقظة لتجنب المخاطر أو الأخطاء المحتملة.
examples: He took a cautious approach when investing in the stock market.
Scientists remain cautious about the long-term effectiveness of the new treatment.
The central bank issued a cautious statement regarding future interest rate hikes.
armA.mnemonic: تذكر كلمة caution التي تعني تحذير أو حذر فكلمة cautious هي الصفة منها وتعني حذر وحريص

armB.definition: Careful to avoid potential problems or dangers.
armB.arabic: حذر جداً وبياخد باله عشان مايغلطش أو يتأذي.
examples: Be cautious.
He is a cautious driver.
She was cautious about spending money.
The doctor gave a cautious prognosis.
They adopted a cautious approach to the problem.
Investors remain cautious despite the market rally.
armB.mnemonic: جاية من 'Caution' 'تحذير'.. خليك 'Cautious' عشان متقعش.

armA.definition: Pleasure, enjoyment, or lighthearted entertainment experienced during an activity.
armA.arabic: المتعة والتسلية والمرح الذي يشعر به الإنسان عند ممارسة نشاط سار.
examples: We had a lot of fun at the beach yesterday.
Playing board games with family is great fun.
She joined the drama club just for fun, but ended up loving it.
armA.mnemonic: تذكر كلمة "fun" بالربط مع صوت الفرح والضحك العالي عندما يقضي الناس وقتا ممتعا معا.

armB.definition: Enjoyment, amusement, or lighthearted pleasure.
armB.arabic: المرح والمتعة، إنك تتبسط وتضحك.
examples: We had fun at the park.
Swimming is great fun.
It's no fun waiting for the bus in the rain.
She's full of fun and energy.
They poked fun at his strange hat.
The satire was all in good fun, meant to entertain rather than offend.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'Fun' قريبة من 'فَن'.. الفنون دايماً فيها 'Fun' ومتعة.

armA.definition: A system in which people or things are arranged in levels of importance or power.
armA.arabic: نظام ترتيب متسلسل يتم فيه تصنيف الأشخاص أو الأشياء إلى درجات ومستويات حسب الأهمية أو السلطة، من الأعلى إلى الأسفل.
examples: She slowly worked her way up through the corporate hierarchy to become director.
The military relies on a rigid hierarchy to maintain order and discipline.
There is a clear hierarchy among the birds feeding in the garden.
armA.mnemonic: تذكر ان كلمة "hierarchy" تنتهي بالمقطع archy مثل monarchy الملكية التي تعني الحكم والنظام، وبدايتها تشبه higher اي الاعلى، فتخيل نظاما مبنيا من الاعلى الى الاسفل.

armB.definition: A system where members are ranked according to relative status or authority.
armB.arabic: التسلسل الهرمي، نظام بيرتب الناس أو الحاجات فوق بعض حسب الأهمية أو السلطة 'مدير، مشرف، موظف'.
examples: The boss is top of the hierarchy.
Every army has a hierarchy.
He is low in the company hierarchy.
The social hierarchy was very strict.
Maslow's hierarchy of needs explains human motivation.
They challenged the established political hierarchy.
armB.mnemonic: أولها 'High' 'عالي'.. الـ 'Hierarchy' هو النظام اللي فيه ناس 'Higher' من ناس

armA.definition: A powerful motor vehicle with large rear tires, used on farms to pull heavy equipment.
armA.arabic: مركبة قوية ذات عجلات ضخمة تستخدم في المزارع لجر الآلات الثقيلة وحراثة الأرض.
examples: The farmer used a tractor to pull the heavy plow across the field.
We were stuck on the narrow road behind a slow tractor.
He learned how to drive a tractor when he was just twelve years old.
armA.mnemonic: تذكر كلمة "traction" التي تعني قوة الجر فكلمة "tractor" مشتقة من نفس الأصل اللاتيني الذي يعني الجر والسحب في الحقول

armB.definition: A powerful motor vehicle with large rear wheels, used chiefly on farms for hauling equipment.
armB.arabic: جرار زراعي قوي بيمشي في الأرض الطينة عشان يحرثها أو يشد حاجات تقيلة.
examples: The farmer drives a tractor.
A red tractor is in the field.
He used a tractor to pull the heavy trailer.
Modern tractors are equipped with GPS technology.
The agricultural sector relies heavily on tractor maintenance.
The mechanization of farming began with the introduction of the steam tractor.
armB.mnemonic: جاية من 'Traction' يعني جرّ.. الـ 'Tractor' هو اللي بيعمل الجرّ ده في المزرعة.

armA.definition: To push a sharp pointed object, such as a knife, into someone or something.
armA.arabic: أن يغرس أداة حادة ومدببة كالسكين بعنف داخل جسم شخص أو شيء ما، بقصد الإيذاء أو الاختراق.
examples: He tried to stab the attacker with a broken bottle to defend himself.
The killer attempted to stab him during the sudden confrontation.
Desperate to escape, the hostage managed to grab the knife and stab the guard.
armA.mnemonic: تذكر كلمة "stab" وتخيل شخصا يغرس سكينه فجأة بصوت خاطف وحاد مثل نطق الكلمة السريع.

armB.definition: To thrust a knife or other pointed weapon into someone or something.
armB.arabic: يضرب حد بسكينة أو آلة حادة.
examples: Do not stab.
He was stabbed in the leg.
Don't stab the meat with your fork.
The killer stabbed his victim three times.
I felt like I had been stabbed in the back by my best friend.
The pain stabbed through his chest like a needle.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'Stab' نطقها حاد وقوي زي 'الطعنة' بالظبط.

armA.definition: A feeling of shame, awkwardness, or self-consciousness.
armA.arabic: شعور بالخجل أو الكسوف لما يحصل موقف محرج أو سخيف قدام الناس.
examples: His face was red with embarrassment.
She felt embarrassment when she fell.
To my embarrassment, I forgot his name.
He is an embarrassment to his family.
The scandal caused significant embarrassment to the government.
She covered her face to hide the acute embarrassment she felt.
armA.mnemonic: 'Embarrassment' فيها 'Bar'.. لو دخلت 'Bar' غلط ممكن تحس بـ 'Embarrassment'.

armB.definition: A feeling of shame, self-consciousness, or awkwardness caused by a foolish act or uncomfortable situation.
armB.arabic: شعور بعدم الارتياح أو الخجل الشديد ينتج عن ارتكاب هفوة أو التعرض لموقف سخيف أمام الآخرين.
examples: His face turned red with embarrassment after tripping on stage.
To avoid further embarrassment, she decided to leave the party early.
The diplomatic leak caused considerable embarrassment to the prime minister and his cabinet.
armB.mnemonic: تذكر ان الكلمة تبدأ بالمقطع باراس كما في حاجز بارير، وكأن الحرج يضع حاجزا يمنعك من التصرف بطلاقة.

armA.definition: To cut something into pieces with a sharp tool like a knife or axe.
armA.arabic: يقطع أو يفرم. تقطع حاجة حتت صغيرة بالسكينة أو الفاس.
examples: Please chop the onions.
He chopped wood for the fire.
Chop the carrots into small cubes.
They chopped down the old tree in the garden.
The budget was chopped by fifty percent.
The helicopter blades chopped through the heavy air.
armA.mnemonic: تخيل الشيف بيعمل 'Chop chop' بسرعة وهو بيقطع الخضار

armB.definition: To cut something into pieces using repeated sharp blows with a knife, axe, or other sharp tool.
armB.arabic: أن تقطع شيئا ما إلى أجزاء أو قطع صغيرة باستخدام أداة حادة مثل السكين أو الفأس بحركات سريعة وقوية.
examples: Please chop the onions into small pieces before frying them.
We had to chop down the old tree because it was dangerously close to the house.
He used a sharp axe to chop firewood for the cold winter evening.
armB.mnemonic: تذكر صوت الضربة السريعة للسكين على لوح التقطيع تشوب تشوب لتربط الكلمة chop بمعنى يقطع بحركات سريعة

armA.definition: A person's child or children; the young of an animal.
armA.arabic: يعني الذرية أو النسل 'الأولاد'، سواء للبشر أو الحيوانات. كلمة رسمية شوية عن 'Children'.
examples: Parents love their offspring.
Animals protect their offspring.
She is the only offspring of a wealthy family.
The disease can be passed from parents to their offspring.
Conflict between parents and offspring is common in many species.
Genetic traits are transmitted to offspring through DNA.
armA.mnemonic: الـ 'Offspring' هما الأطفال اللي 'Spring' 'بينبعوا' أو بييجوا من أهلهم.

armB.definition: The young of an animal, or a person's child or children.
armB.arabic: الذرية أو النسل، وتطلق على صغار الحيوانات أو أبناء الإنسان.
examples: Female tigers fiercely protect their offspring from any potential predators.
Parents naturally hope that their offspring will enjoy a healthy and prosperous life.
Genetic traits are passed down directly from parent organisms to their offspring.
armB.mnemonic: تخيل شيئا ينبثق مثل الربيع "spring" منطلقا بعيدا "off" عن أصله، تماما مثل خروج النسل والذرية من الآباء.

armA.definition: A track that constitutes a path, or a course of action to achieve something.
armA.arabic: طريق صغير للمشي، أو مسار وخطوات بتمشي عليها عشان توصل لهدف معين.
examples: This is a pathway to the park.
We walked along a narrow pathway.
Education is a pathway to a better job.
The garden has a stone pathway leading to the fountain.
Scientists are studying the neural pathways in the brain.
Rigorous negotiation is the only viable pathway to resolving this diplomatic crisis.
armA.mnemonic: هي كلمتين: 'Path' 'طريق' + 'Way' 'طريقة'.. يعني المسار اللي بيوصلك.

armB.definition: A track for walking, or a series of actions leading to a specific result.
armB.arabic: مسار أو ممر مادي مخصص للمشي، أو تسلسل من الخطوات والإجراءات المحددة للوصول إلى هدف أو نتيجة معينة.
examples: Education offers a reliable pathway out of poverty for disadvantaged youth.
We followed a narrow pathway through the woods until we reached the lake.
Scientists investigated the biological pathway responsible for cellular repair.
armB.mnemonic: تذكر ان كلمة "pathway" تتكون من "path" اي طريق و "way" اي اتجاه او مسار، كلاهما يؤكدان معنى السير نحو وجهة او هدف

armA.definition: An object used by actors in a play or film, or an item used to support something.
armA.arabic: أداة مسرحية أو سينمائية يستخدمها الممثل أثناء الأداء، أو دعامة وسند مادي يُستخدم لتثبيت شيء ومنعه من السقوط.
examples: He used a wooden prop to keep the heavy cellar door open.
The vintage telephone on the desk was just a stage prop.
Without an external prop, the old fence will collapse in strong winds.
armA.mnemonic: تذكر كلمة "property" في المسرح؛ حيث أن كلمة "prop" اختصار لها وتعني الأغراض والأدوات التي يمسكها الممثل لدعم المشهد.

armB.definition: A pole or beam used for support, or an object used in a play.
armB.arabic: حاجة بتسند عليها حاجة تانية عشان ما تقعش، أو الأغراض والإكسسوارات اللي بيستخدموها الممثلين في المسرح.
examples: He used a stick as a prop.
The actors gathered their props for the show.
Use a book as a prop to keep the window open.
The roof needs a strong prop to hold it up.
The government refused to be a financial prop for failing industries.
In the play, the most important prop was a vintage telephone that rang at crucial moments.
armB.mnemonic: الـ 'Prop' هو الحاجة اللي بتعمل 'Prop up' 'بتسند' بيها السقف. أو الأغراض اللي بيستخدموها في التمثيل.

armA.definition: Causing laughter or lighthearted pleasure; funny or entertaining.
armA.arabic: يصف الشيء أو الموقف أو الشخص الذي يبعث على الضحك الخفيف أو التسلية والمرح اللطيف.
examples: He told an amusing story about his first day at work.
I found the movie mildly amusing, but not particularly memorable.
She raised an eyebrow with an amusing look of disbelief.
armA.mnemonic: تذكر كلمة "music" الموسيقى المبهجة التي تجلب التسلية والمرح مثل الشيء المسلي "amusing".

armB.definition: Causing laughter and providing entertainment.
armB.arabic: مُسلي أو دمه خفيف.. حاجة بتضحكك أو بتبسطك
examples: The cat is amusing.
It is an amusing book.
He told us an amusing story about his trip.
I didn't find his jokes very amusing.
She has an amusing way of describing people.
The play provides an amusing commentary on modern politics.
armB.mnemonic: من 'Amusement Park' 'مدينة الملاهي'.. المكان اللي كله حاجات 'Amusing' ومسلية

armA.definition: The study of numbers, shapes, and quantities (short for mathematics).
armA.arabic: مادة الرياضيات أو الحساب، اللي بنتعلم فيها الجمع والطرح والأرقام والأشكال الهندسية.
examples: I like maths.
Maths is hard for me.
My maths homework is difficult.
She is studying applied maths at university.
His ability in mental maths is impressive.
Theoretical maths deals with abstract concepts.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Maths' اختصار لـ 'Mathematics'.. افتكرها بكلمة 'Mass' 'كتلة'.. لأننا بنحسب كتلة وحجم الأشياء بالرياضيات.

armB.definition: The study of numbers, shapes, calculations, and measurements.
armB.arabic: مادة الرياضيات او علم دراسة الارقام والاشكال والعمليات الحسابية، وهو الاختصار الشائع للكلمة في الانجليزية البريطانية.
examples: She helps her younger brother with his maths homework every evening.
Maths is my favourite subject at school because I love solving puzzles.
Good skills in maths are essential for studying engineering at university.
armB.mnemonic: تذكر ان كلمة "maths" هي ببساطة اختصار لكلمة "mathematics" البريطانية، وتنتهي بحرف s تماما مثل الكلمة الاصلية.

armA.definition: An optical instrument used to make distant objects appear nearer.
armA.arabic: جهاز بيقرب البعيد، بنستخدمه عشان نشوف النجوم والكواكب في السما.
examples: I see the moon with a telescope.
He has a small telescope in his room.
We looked at the stars through a telescope.
The Hubble Space Telescope takes amazing pictures.
The invention of the telescope changed our view of the universe.
Radio telescopes detect signals from deep space.
armA.mnemonic: 'Tele' يعني بعيد 'زي Telephone'، و 'Scope' يعني رؤية.. يبقى جهاز رؤية البعيد.

armB.definition: An optical instrument designed with curved mirrors or lenses to make distant objects appear closer and larger.
armB.arabic: جهاز بصري يستخدم عدسات أو مرايا لرؤية الأجسام البعيدة مثل النجوم والكواكب بوضوح وحجم أكبر.
examples: He bought a powerful telescope to observe the craters on the moon.
Astronomers use a space telescope to capture high-resolution images of distant galaxies.
Through the small telescope, she could clearly distinguish the rings of Saturn.
armB.mnemonic: تذكر ان الجزء الاول "tele" يعني بعيد مثل التلفاز والجزء الثاني "scope" يعني رؤية او فحص مثل المجهر فالمعنى رؤية الاشياء البعيدة

armA.definition: Magnificent; very impressive; excellent.
armA.arabic: رائع أو عظيم. كلمة بتوصف الجمال والفخامة.
examples: The house is splendid.
We had a splendid time.
What a splendid idea!
The view from the top was splendid.
He made a splendid effort to win.
The king wore splendid robes for the ceremony.
armA.mnemonic: قريبة من 'Splenda' السكر.. حاجة 'Splendid' يعني حلوة زي السكر.

armB.definition: Extremely good, impressive, or beautiful in appearance or quality.
armB.arabic: تصف شيئا رائعا للغاية، أو باهر الجمال، أو ممتاز الجودة ويبعث على الإعجاب الكبير.
examples: We had a splendid view of the mountains from our hotel balcony.
The orchestra gave a splendid performance that earned a standing ovation.
She came up with a splendid idea to solve our scheduling problem.
armB.mnemonic: تذكر كلمة "splendid" بربطها بالكلمة اللاتينية التي تعني يلمع أو يسطع مثل "splendor"، فتخيل شيئا شديد اللمعان والبهاء من روعته.

armA.definition: The state or feeling of being jealous.
armA.arabic: الغيرة، لما تحس بضيق عشان حد عنده حاجة مش عندك أو خايف حد ياخد مكانك.
examples: He felt jealousy.
Her jealousy caused problems.
Jealousy can destroy a relationship.
She tried to hide her jealousy when he talked to other girls.
His professional jealousy prevented him from praising his colleague.
Othello is a classic tragedy about the destructive power of jealousy.
armA.mnemonic: جاية من 'Jealous'.. ممكن نقول 'Jealousy' زي 'Jail'.. الغيرة بتحطك في سجن أفكارك.

armB.definition: An unhappy feeling caused by wanting what someone else has or fearing loss of affection.
armB.arabic: شعور بعدم الارتياح أو الضيق ينشأ عن الرغبة في امتلاك ما يملكه شخص آخر، أو الخوف من فقدان محبة واهتمام شخص ما لصالح منافس.
examples: His sudden success provoked intense jealousy among his former colleagues.
Unreasonable jealousy can quickly destroy trust within a relationship.
She felt a pang of jealousy when her friend bought a new car.
armB.mnemonic: تذكر نطق الكلمة الشبيه بعبارة "جلس يغار"؛ حيث يقود شعور "jealousy" صاحبه إلى الحزن والغيرة من نجاح الآخرين.

armA.definition: A wooden musical instrument with four strings, held under the chin and played with a bow.
armA.arabic: آلة موسيقية وترية خشبية ذات أربعة أوتار، تعزف بوضعها تحت الذقن وتحريك قوس خاص فوق أوتارها، وتعرف بالكمان.
examples: She started taking lessons to play the violin when she was six.
He took his violin out of its case and began to practice.
The sweet sound of the violin filled the concert hall.
armA.mnemonic: تذكر نطق الكلمة فايولين، الصوت يبدأ مثل فايل، تخيل عازفا يحفظ نوتاته الموسيقية في ملف خاص وهو يعزف على الكمان

armB.definition: A musical instrument with four strings held against the neck and played with a bow.
armB.arabic: آلة موسيقية وترية بتتلعب بقوس، صوتها ناعم ومشهورة جداً في الموسيقى الكلاسيكية والأوركسترا.
examples: She plays the violin very well.
I want to buy a new violin for my lesson.
The sound of a violin can be very sad.
He is the lead violin in the school orchestra.
The concerto was written specifically for the violin.
The luthier spent months crafting the exquisite violin.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'Violin' قريبة من 'Violent' 'عنيف'.. بس العكس، صوتها حنين مش عنيف.

armA.definition: To speak very quietly using breath rather than the vocal cords so others cannot hear.
armA.arabic: التحدث بصوت منخفض وخافت جدا بالاعتماد على النفس حتى لا يسمع الآخرون ما يقال.
examples: You must whisper while the baby is sleeping in the next room.
She leaned over to whisper a secret into his ear.
Employees often whisper about company changes before any official announcement.
armA.mnemonic: تذكر صوت حرف السين المتكرر في "whisper" الذي يشبه صوت الهمس والوشوشة الخافتة

armB.definition: To speak very softly using one's breath without one's vocal cords.
armB.arabic: إنك تتكلم بصوت واطي جداً 'تهس' عشان محدش يسمعك.
examples: Please whisper in the library.
He whispered his name to me.
She whispered something in his ear.
The wind whispered through the tall grass.
It is whispered that the company is going bankrupt.
He whispered a prayer of gratitude as the plane landed safely.
armB.mnemonic: زي ما بنقول بالمصري 'وسوسة'.. 'Whisper' قريبة في النطق والمعنى 'كلام واطي'.

armA.definition: Remarkable, extraordinary, or exceptional in quality, character, or form.
armA.arabic: تصف شيئا استثنائيا او فريدا من نوعه وغير مألوف، كما تستخدم قواعديا لوصف صيغة المفرد.
examples: She displayed a singular dedication to finishing her scientific research.
The artist had a singular vision that set him apart from his contemporaries.
Make sure you use a singular verb with this subject.
armA.mnemonic: تذكر كلمة "single" التي تعني منفرد؛ شيء "singular" هو فريد ومتميز كانه لا مثيل له بين اقرانه.

armB.definition: Referring to just one person or thing; exceptionally good or remarkable.
armB.arabic: المفرد 'عكس الجمع'، أو وصف لحاجة فريدة ومتميزة جداً.
examples: Cat is a singular noun.
Use the singular form here.
The word has a singular meaning.
He showed singular courage.
It was an event of singular importance.
Her voice had a singular quality that captivated everyone.
armB.mnemonic: جاية من 'Single'.. في الجرامر يعني 'مفرد'، وفي الوصف يعني حاجة 'Unique' وملهاش زي.

armA.definition: Used to introduce the first point in a list or sequence.
armA.arabic: كلمة بنستخدمها لما نبدأ نعدد حاجات أو نقط، معناها 'أولاً'.
examples: Firstly, wash your hands.
Firstly, we need to buy tickets.
Firstly, I want to thank everyone for coming.
There are two reasons: firstly, cost, and secondly, time.
Firstly, the proposal is too expensive to implement.
We must consider, firstly, the economic impact of the decision.
armA.mnemonic: جاية من 'First' يعني الأول.. فـ 'Firstly' يعني أولاً.

armB.definition: Used to introduce the opening point or item in a list or argument.
armB.arabic: تُستخدم لتقديم النقطة الأولى أو البداية في قائمة أو حديث أو نص مكتوب، بمعنى أولاً.
examples: Firstly, we need to decide where we want to go.
Firstly, I would like to thank everyone for coming today.
There are two main issues: firstly, the budget is too small.
armB.mnemonic: تذكر كلمة "first" التي تعني الأول، واللاحقة "ly" تحولها لظرف لتبدأ به تعداد نقاطك: أولاً.

armA.definition: In the open air outside rather than inside a building.
armA.arabic: في الهواء الطلق أو خارج المباني والمنازل.
examples: The children love playing outdoors when the weather is warm.
We decided to eat outdoors on the terrace to enjoy the fresh breeze.
Working outdoors during the winter requires heavy protective clothing.
armA.mnemonic: تذكر الكلمتين out اي في الخارج و doors اي الابواب فالمعنى خارج الابواب اي في الهواء الطلق

armB.definition: In or into the open air; outside a building.
armB.arabic: بره البيت، في الهواء الطلق أو الشارع.
examples: We played outdoors.
It is cold outdoors.
They enjoy eating outdoors in summer.
You should spend more time outdoors.
The wedding was held outdoors despite the risk of rain.
Working outdoors requires protection from the elements.
armB.mnemonic: 'Out' بره.. 'Doors' البيبان.. يعني بره بيبان البيت.

armA.definition: Unable to defend oneself or to act without help.
armA.arabic: عاجز ومش قادر يساعد نفسه، محتاج حد يقف جنبه.
examples: The baby is helpless.
I felt helpless without my phone.
She gave a helpless shrug.
The injured animal lay helpless on the road.
He was helpless against the overwhelming force of the storm.
The bureaucracy made us feel utterly helpless and frustrated.
armA.mnemonic: 'Help' 'مساعدة' + '-less' 'بدون'.. يعني بدون مساعدة، مش قادر يساعد نفسه.

armB.definition: Unable to defend, protect, or take care of oneself without assistance.
armB.arabic: تصف الشخص العاجز أو قليل الحيلة الذي لا يستطيع حماية نفسه أو التصرف بمفرده في موقف صعب.
examples: The small bird fell from its nest and lay helpless on the ground.
He felt completely helpless as he watched the floodwaters rise around his house.
Without legal advice, many tenants feel helpless against unfair eviction notices.

armA.definition: A thing characteristic of its kind or illustrating a general rule.
armA.arabic: مثال.. نموذج بيوضحلك الفكرة عشان تفهمها أحسن.
examples: This is a good example.
Can you give me an example?
For example, you can eat fruit.
She sets a good example for her sister.
This case is a classic example of the problem.
He was punished to make an example of him.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Exam' 'امتحان' جزء منها.. والامتحان عبارة عن 'Examples' 'أمثلة' بنحلها.

armB.definition: Something that shows what other things in the same group are like or how a rule works.
armB.arabic: نموذج أو حالة توضيحية تُذكر لشرح فكرة، أو قاعدة، أو لإظهار ما يشبهها من أشياء.
examples: Can you give me an example of this rule?
This painting is a good example of modern art.
She wanted to set a good example for her younger brother.
armB.mnemonic: تذكر عبارة "for example" الشهيرة التي تعني على سبيل المثال، فالكلمة تعبر عن نموذج يوضح الفكرة.

armA.definition: Able to last a long time without breaking or becoming damaged.
armA.arabic: يصف الشيء القوي القادر على البقاء صالحا للاستخدام لفترة طويلة ومقاومة التلف أو التآكل.
examples: These hiking boots are made from durable leather.
Plastic is a durable material that takes centuries to break down.
The negotiators aimed to establish a durable peace in the region.
armA.mnemonic: تذكر كلمة "duration" التي تعني المدة فالشيء durable يدوم لمدة طويلة دون أن يتلف

armB.definition: Able to withstand wear, pressure, or damage; long-lasting.
armB.arabic: حاجة قوية وبتستحمل وتعيش وقت طويل من غير ما تبوظ.
examples: This toy is very durable.
We need durable shoes for hiking.
Plastic is a durable material.
The company produces durable goods like fridges.
They are looking for a durable peace agreement.
The machine is made of highly durable titanium alloy.
armB.mnemonic: جاية من 'Duration' 'مدة'.. الـ 'Durable' هو اللي مدته طويلة وبيعيش.

armA.definition: A highly intelligent sea animal that looks like a large fish with a beak-like snout.
armA.arabic: حيوان بحري ذكي جداً وصديق للإنسان، بيحب يلعب ونشوفه في العروض.
examples: The dolphin swims fast.
I saw a dolphin in the sea.
Dolphins are known for their intelligence.
We went on a boat trip to watch the dolphins.
The dolphin's sonar capabilities are fascinating to scientists.
Conservationists are worried about the declining dolphin population.
armA.mnemonic: نفس النطق بالعربي 'دُلفين'.. ممكن تربطها بـ 'Doll' 'لعبة' لأنه بيحب يلعب.

armB.definition: An intelligent sea animal with a smooth grey body and a curved snout that breathes air.
armB.arabic: حيوان بحري ذكي وودود من الثدييات، رمادي اللون وله خطم مميز، يعيش في مجموعات ويقفز فوق الماء.
examples: We were lucky to see a friendly dolphin swimming near our boat.
The trainer tossed a small fish to the dolphin after the jump.
Marine biologists rescued an injured dolphin stranded along the shallow shore.
armB.mnemonic: الكلمة قريبة جدا من اللفظ العربي المتداول دلفين، فقط تذكر ان ph تلفظ مثل حرف الفاء في كلمة "dolphin".

armA.definition: To cut with a violent sweeping movement or reduce greatly.
armA.arabic: يقطع حاجة بقوة وعنف، أو يقلل الأسعار بشكل كبير جداً.
examples: Do not slash the seat.
He slashed the tall grass.
The company decided to slash the prices.
Someone slashed his car tires last night.
The new policy aims to slash unemployment rates.
Critics slashed the author's new novel with harsh reviews.
armA.mnemonic: زي لما المحلات تعمل 'Sale'.. بتعمل 'Slash' للأسعار يعني بتقصها للنص.

armB.definition: To drastically reduce something such as prices, costs, or jobs, or to cut with a sweeping stroke.
armB.arabic: يخفض شيئا مثل الأسعار أو التكاليف أو الوظائف بشكل حاد وكبير، أو يشق ويقطع بعنف وبحركة سريعة.
examples: The company decided to slash prices to attract more budget-conscious buyers.
Airlines often slash fares during the low season to fill empty seats.
Faced with a massive deficit, the government had to slash public spending.
armB.mnemonic: تذكر صوت السيف السريع وهو يقطع الهواء ليشطر الشيء نصفين، تماما كما تقوم الشركات بخفض أو قطع الأسعار بشدة وسرعة.

armA.definition: To go for and then bring back someone or something.
armA.arabic: تروح تجيب حاجة وترجع بيها. مشهورة جداً في اللعب مع الكلاب 'Go fetch'.
examples: Fetch the ball.
Can you fetch me a glass of water?
I have to go and fetch the kids from school.
The painting is expected to fetch a high price at auction.
This argument is a bit far-fetched (difficult to believe).
She sent him to fetch the doctor immediately.
armA.mnemonic: ارمي الكورة للكلب وقوله 'Fetch'.. يعني 'هاتها'.

armB.definition: To go to a place, get someone or something, and bring them back.
armB.arabic: الذهاب الى مكان ما لاحضار شخص او شيء والعودة به مجددا.
examples: Could you please fetch some clean glasses from the kitchen?
I throw the small ball and train my dog to fetch it.
The rare painting is expected to fetch a high price at the auction.
armB.mnemonic: تذكر صوت الكلمة القريب من كلمة فتش في العربية لكن تخيل انك تبحث وتفتش عن شيء لتأتي به وترجع به معك

armA.definition: Close to an exact number, amount, or time, but not completely accurate.
armA.arabic: يصف شيئا قريبا جدا من الرقم أو المقدار الصحيح لكن دون دقة تامة، بمعنى تقريبي.
examples: Can you give me an approximate cost for the repairs?
The approximate time of arrival is four in the afternoon.
These numbers are only an approximate guide, so verify the final total.
armA.mnemonic: تذكر كلمة "proximity" وتعني القرب؛ فالأمر الـ "approximate" قريب جدا من الحقيقة ولكنه ليس دقيقا تماما.

armB.definition: Close to the actual, but not completely accurate or exact.
armB.arabic: يعني مش الرقم بالظبط، بس قريب منه جدًا، زي لما تقول 'حوالي' كذا.
examples: The time is approximate.
Can you give me the approximate cost?
The approximate distance is five miles.
These figures are only approximate and may change.
The colors in the photo only approximate the real painting.
His political views approximate those of the social democrats.
armB.mnemonic: فيها 'Proxy' يعني وكيل.. والبديل بيكون 'Approximate' للأصل بس مش هو بالضبط.

armA.definition: The words of a song, or a short poem expressing personal feelings.
armA.arabic: كلمات أغنية، أو قصيدة غنائية قصيرة تعبر عن مشاعر شخصية.
examples: She wrote every single lyric of the title track herself.
A thoughtful lyric can turn a simple melody into a classic.
The poet published a delicate lyric reflecting on lost youth.
armA.mnemonic: تذكر كلمة قيثارة بالإنجليزية "lyre" وهي آلة موسيقية قديمة، فكلمة "lyric" تعني أصلا كلمات تصاحب عزف الموسيقى

armB.definition: The words of a song (usually plural: lyrics).
armB.arabic: كلمات الأغنية 'وغالباً بتيجي بصيغة الجمع Lyrics'.
examples: I know the lyric to this song.
He wrote a beautiful lyric.
Can you print the lyrics for me?
The lyrics of this song are very meaningful.
She analyzed the lyric structure of the ballad.
The juxtaposition of the upbeat melody with the melancholic lyric is striking.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'Lyric' قريبة من 'Lyre' 'القيثارة'.. زمان كانوا بيغنوا الشعر على القيثارة.

armA.definition: To learn about a subject, usually at school or university.
armA.arabic: تخصص وقت ومجهود عشان تتعلم حاجة أو تفهم موضوع، زي المذاكرة.
examples: I study English every day.
She is studying to be a doctor.
He studied the map carefully.
Scientists are studying the effects of the virus.
We need to study the proposal in detail.
He studied his opponent's face for any sign of weakness.

armB.definition: To spend time learning about a subject by reading books or attending school.
armB.arabic: بذل الجهد والوقت في تعلم موضوع معين من خلال القراءة أو الالتحاق بالمدرسة أو الجامعة.
examples: I like to study English every day.
Many young people go to university to study medicine.
We need a quiet place where we can study for the exam.
armB.mnemonic: تذكر كلمة "student" اي طالب فالطالب يقوم بفعل "study" وهو المذاكرة والتعلم

armA.definition: In a way that is not firm or tight; not exact.
armA.arabic: لما تعمل حاجة من غير دقة أوي، أو تربط حاجة بس مش جامد، يعني سايبة شوية.
examples: Hold it loosely.
The shirt fits loosely.
The movie is loosely based on a true story.
The organizations are loosely connected.
The term is used very loosely in this context.
He held the reins loosely, allowing the horse to choose its path.
armA.mnemonic: جاية من 'Loose' 'واسع'.. لما تربط الحبل 'Loosely' بيبقى مهوي ومش ماسك جامد.

armB.definition: In a way that is not tight, firm, exact, or strictly controlled.
armB.arabic: تصف طريقة فعل الشيء دون إحكام أو دقة تامة، مثل ربط شيء بارتخاء أو استناد فكرة إلى مصدر بشكل غير حرفي.
examples: She tied her hair loosely with a silk ribbon.
The movie is loosely based on a true historical event.
The term is used loosely to describe any portable digital device.

armA.definition: Unfriendly or aggressive behavior or opposition.
armA.arabic: العداء أو الخصومة، لما حد يكون بيعامل حد تاني بطريقة وحشة وعدوانية.
examples: There is hostility between them.
She looked at him with hostility.
The hostility of the crowd was frightening.
They ceased hostilities after the peace treaty.
There is growing public hostility towards the new tax law.
The meeting was marred by open hostility between the two leaders.
armA.mnemonic: عكس كلمة 'Hospitality' 'كرم الضيافة'.. الـ 'Hostility' هي سوء المعاملة والعداء.

armB.definition: Unfriendly or aggressive feelings, behavior, or opposition toward someone or something.
armB.arabic: شعور قوي بالعداء أو الكراهية والمعارضة، يظهر غالبا في السلوك أو التعامل غير الودي مع الآخرين.
examples: There was noticeable hostility between the two rival politicians during the debate.
The committee met open hostility from residents when proposing the new tax.
Years of political tension eventually turned into open hostility and conflict.
armB.mnemonic: تذكر كلمة "hostile" أي عدائي، والمقطع "ity" يحول الصفة إلى اسم، فالكلمة تعني حالة العداء والكراهية.

armA.definition: Something that interrupts someone or makes them feel worried; a noisy commotion.
armA.arabic: أي حاجة بتعمل دوشة أو قلق وبتقطع الهدوء، زي صوت عالي أو مشكلة حصلت.
examples: Sorry for the disturbance.
The loud music caused a disturbance at night.
We reported a disturbance in the street to the police.
He was arrested for causing a public disturbance.
Atmospheric disturbances can affect radio signals.
The patient showed signs of severe emotional disturbance.
armA.mnemonic: 'Disturb' يزعج.. الـ 'Disturbance' هو الدوشة والإزعاج اللي بيحصل.

armB.definition: An event that interrupts peace, quiet, or normal order, often involving noise, confusion, or public unrest.
armB.arabic: حالة من الاضطراب أو التشويش تكسر الهدوء أو النظام العام، وتحدث غالبا بسبب ضوضاء أو شجار أو خلل مفاجئ.
examples: The neighbors called the police because of a loud disturbance in the apartment upstairs.
A sudden power outage caused a severe disturbance to the city's transport network.
The protest remained peaceful and ended without any violent disturbance.
armB.mnemonic: تذكر الفعل الشائع "disturb" بمعنى يزعج، واللاحقة "ance" تحوله إلى اسم، فالكلمة تعني ببساطة حالة الإزعاج أو الاضطراب.

armA.definition: Continuing forever or for a very long time without stopping.
armA.arabic: يصف شيئا مستمرا لا ينقطع أبدا أو يدوم لفترة طويلة جدا دون توقف، ويستخدم أيضا للمواقف المتكررة باستمرار لدرجة مزعجة.
examples: The high mountain peaks are covered in perpetual snow and ice.
He lived in a perpetual state of fear and anxiety.
Scientists have long proven that a perpetual motion machine is physically impossible.
armA.mnemonic: تذكر بداية الكلمة per التي تعني عبر او طوال مثل permanent، لتدل على الاستمرار الدائم عبر الزمن دون توقف

armB.definition: Never ending or changing; occurring repeatedly.
armB.arabic: حاجة مستمرة على طول ومش بتخلص ولا بتقف، أو بتتكرر كتير جداً لدرجة إنها كأنها دايمة.
examples: The noise was perpetual.
They lived in perpetual fear.
He seems to be in a perpetual bad mood.
The mountains are covered in perpetual snow.
She was tired of their perpetual arguments.
Scientists have long searched for a machine of perpetual motion.
armB.mnemonic: اربطها بـ 'Pet' 'حيوان أليف'.. الـ 'Pet' محتاج رعاية 'Per-pet-ual' 'دايمة ومستمرة'.

armA.definition: Formed into curves, rings, or spirals rather than being straight.
armA.arabic: يصف الشيء الملتوي أو المتموج في انحناءات وحلقات بدلا من أن يكون مستقيما، وغالبا ما يستخدم لوصف الشعر.
examples: She has naturally curly hair that is hard to brush.
The little girl wore a ribbon in her curly hair.
The pig had a short, curly tail.
armA.mnemonic: تذكر كلمة "curl" التي تعني يلتف أو يتجعد، فإذا أضفت لها حرف الواي تصبح الصفة التي تصف الشيء الملتف مثل الشعر المجعد.

armB.definition: Having curves or coils; not straight (usually hair).
armB.arabic: صفة للشعر اللي مش ناعم ومفرود، بيبقى ملفوف على بعضه.
examples: She has curly hair.
My dog has a curly tail.
I wish my hair was curly instead of straight.
The plant has unusual curly leaves.
He has a mop of thick, curly hair.
The antique table featured curly maple wood.
armB.mnemonic: زي الـ 'Curve' منحنى.. الشعر الـ 'Curly' مليان منحنيات ولفات

armA.definition: A soft, porous piece of material used for washing, cleaning, or absorbing liquids.
armA.arabic: قطعة خفيفة مليئة بالمسام تُصنع من مواد طبيعية أو صناعية، وتُستخدم في التنظيف والتنشيف لامتصاصها السريع للماء.
examples: She soaked the sponge in soapy water to clean the table.
Wipe up that spilled milk using a dry sponge.
He bought a soft sponge to wash his car without scratching the paint.
armA.mnemonic: تذكر شخصية الرسوم المتحركة الشهيرة سبونج بوب التي تمثل إسفنجة صفراء تمتص الماء.

armB.definition: A soft, porous material used for washing or cleaning.
armB.arabic: الإسفنجة اللي بنستخدمها في التنظيف أو الاستحمام عشان بتمتص المية.
examples: I use a sponge to wash the car.
The sponge is full of water.
She wiped the table with a damp sponge.
Sponge cake is very soft and light.
Natural sponges are harvested from the sea.
He was accused of being a sponge, always living off his friends' money.
armB.mnemonic: زي 'SpongeBob'.. هو أصلاً سفنجة.

armA.definition: A voting member of a community; a component part of something.
armA.arabic: ليها معنيين: الناخب اللي بيصوت في الدايرة الانتخابية، أو عنصر أساسي مكون لشيء.
examples: Parts of a whole. (Simplified)
Voters choose leaders. (Simplified)
Sugar is a constituent of candy.
The MP listened to his constituents.
Oxygen is a constituent of air.
The constituent assembly drafted the new laws.
armA.mnemonic: جاية من 'Constitution' 'دستور'.. الـ 'Constituent' هو اللي بيصوت للدستور أو بيمثله.

armB.definition: A person living in a particular area who is represented by an elected official.
armB.arabic: مواطن أو ناخب يقيم في دائرة انتخابية معينة ويمثله مسؤول منتخب في البرلمان أو الحكومة.
examples: The senator held a town hall meeting to hear from every local constituent.
As an active constituent, she regularly wrote letters to her member of parliament.
Elected officials must carefully balance national interests with the needs of a single constituent.
armB.translations: ناخب في دائرة انتخابية / عنصر مكوّن
armB.mnemonic: تذكر كلمة "constitution" اي الدستور فالناخب "constituent" هو الشخص الاساسي الذي يحميه الدستور ويمثله في البرلمان

armA.definition: A soft bag filled with comfortable material used on seats for resting or decoration.
armA.arabic: وسادة قماشية محشوة بمادة لينة توضع عادة على الأريكة أو الكرسي للجلوس المريح أو للزينة.
examples: She placed a soft cushion behind her back while sitting on the sofa.
He bought a colorful velvet cushion to decorate the armchair.
The savings account served as a cushion against unexpected medical expenses.
armA.mnemonic: تذكر ان كلمة "cushion" تشبه صوت جلوسك برفق على شيء مريح ولين يخفف عنك التعب مثل الوسادة

armB.definition: A soft bag of cloth filled with soft material, used for sitting on or leaning against.
armB.arabic: المخدة الصغيرة اللي بنحطها على الكنبة عشان نسند عليها ضهرنا أو نقعد عليها.
examples: I sit on a cushion.
The sofa has red cushions.
She put a cushion behind her back.
Airbags act as a cushion during a car crash.
Savings can provide a financial cushion against unemployment.
The soft moss acted as a cushion for his fall.
armB.mnemonic: شبه كلمة 'كوشة' اللي العرسان بيقعدوا فيها على 'Cushion' مريح.

armA.definition: A person who plans and coordinates an event, activity, or group of people.
armA.arabic: الشخص المسؤول عن ترتيب وتنسيق حدث أو نشاط أو عمل جماعي بدقة ونجاح.
examples: She spoke directly with the organizer to arrange seating for the guests.
As the lead organizer, he managed the budget and coordinated all the volunteers.
The main organizer of the conference thanked everyone for attending.
armA.mnemonic: تذكر كلمة "organize" التي تعني يرتب ويضع نظاما، وإضافة "er" تدل على الشخص الفاعل، تماما مثل "teacher" من "teach".

armB.definition: A person who plans an event; or a book/app for planning appointments.
armB.arabic: الشخص اللي بينظم الحفلات أو الأحداث، أو الأجندة اللي بتنظم فيها مواعيدك.
examples: He is the organizer.
I bought a desk organizer.
The event organizer was very helpful.
She uses a personal organizer for work.
He worked as a union organizer for years.
The organizers of the conference faced logistical challenges.
armB.mnemonic: جاية من 'Organize' ينظم.. ده الشخص أو الأداة اللي بتنظم.

armA.definition: The captain of a ship, boat, or sports team.
armA.arabic: القبطان اللي بيسوق السفينة، أو قائد الفريق الرياضي.
examples: The skipper steers the boat.
He is the skipper of our team.
The skipper told the crew to prepare for the storm.
You need a license to be a skipper of this vessel.
The experienced skipper navigated through the narrow channel.
As the team's skipper, he bore the responsibility for the defeat.
armA.mnemonic: الـ 'Skipper' هو اللي بيخلي السفينة تعمل 'Skip' للأمواج ويقودها بمهارة.

armB.definition: The captain or person in command of a ship, boat, or sports team.
armB.arabic: ربان السفينة أو قارب الصيد المسؤول عن توجيهه، وتستخدم أيضا للإشارة إلى قائد فريق رياضي.
examples: The experienced skipper navigated the small fishing boat safely through the rough storm.
After their recent defeat, the team skipper gave an inspiring speech to rally the players.
Maritime regulations state that the skipper holds ultimate legal responsibility for the vessel and crew.
armB.mnemonic: الكلمة تشبه كلمة ship اي سفينة وفي اللغة الهولندية تعني شاحن السفينة تذكر انه الشخص الذي يقود السفينة مثل القبطان

armA.definition: To manage and organize the affairs of a company or to give a treatment to a patient.
armA.arabic: يدير أو يعطي. ممكن تيجي بمعنى يدير شغل أو منظمة، وممكن تيجي بمعنى يعطي دواء لمريض.
examples: He administers the group.
The doctor administers the medicine.
She helps to administer the school's daily operations.
The fund is administered by a professional bank.
The nurse was trained to administer first aid in emergencies.
The court has the authority to administer justice in this region.
armA.mnemonic: جاية من 'Admin'.. الـ 'Admin' هو اللي بيعمل 'Administer' 'بيدير' الجروب أو الشغل.

armB.definition: To manage and organize the affairs, operations, or distribution of something formally.
armB.arabic: يتولى إدارة شؤون منظمة أو مشروع بصورة رسمية، أو يشرف على تقديم وتنظيم خدمة أو دواء أو اختبار.
examples: A qualified committee was appointed to administer the new financial fund.
Only trained healthcare professionals are authorized to administer this powerful medicine.
Teachers will administer the final examination under strictly standardized conditions.
armB.mnemonic: تذكر الكلمة من تشابهها مع "minister" وزير الذي يدير الشؤون، فالجزء "administer" يعني إدارة وتقديم الخدمات بمسؤولية رسمية.

armA.definition: To grow, develop, or be successful in a healthy and vigorous way.
armA.arabic: ينمو أو يزدهر ويتطور بنجاح وقوة في بيئة مناسبة، سواء كان ذلك لنبات أو شخص أو عمل تجاري.
examples: Few plants can flourish in such dry and rocky soil.
Local businesses continue to flourish despite the difficult economic climate.
Creative arts flourish when freedom of expression is protected.
armA.mnemonic: تذكر كلمة flower اي زهرة فكلمة "flourish" تعني ان تزهر وتتفتح وتزدهر بنجاح

armB.definition: To grow or develop in a healthy or vigorous way.
armB.arabic: يزدهر وينمو بقوة.. لما مشروع أو زرعة تكبر وتنجح.
examples: Flowers grow in the sun.
The plant grows well here.
Business is starting to flourish.
The arts flourished during that period.
Under her leadership, the company flourished.
Bacteria flourish in warm, damp environments.
armB.mnemonic: زي الـ 'Flower' 'الوردة' لما تفتح وتكبر.. المشروع بيـ 'Flourish'.

armA.definition: A person who pays regularly to receive a service, publication, or access to digital media.
armA.arabic: الشخص الذي يدفع مبلغا دوريا أو يسجل رسميا للاستفادة من خدمة مستمرة، كالمجلات أو منصات الإنترنت.
examples: Each new subscriber receives a discounted rate for the first three months of membership.
As a loyal subscriber to the magazine, she was invited to attend the annual literary gala.
The telecom company warned that any late subscriber could face a temporary interruption of service.
armA.mnemonic: تذكر ان كلمة "subscriber" تبدا بكلمة "sub" اي تحت و"scribe" اي يكتب فالمشترك كانه يوقع اسمه في اسفل العقد للحصول على الخدمة بانتظام

armB.definition: A person who pays to receive a service or publication regularly.
armB.arabic: الشخص اللي دافع اشتراك عشان توصله خدمة أو مجلة بانتظام، أو مشترك في قناة يوتيوب.
examples: I am a subscriber.
The magazine has many subscribers.
Subscribers get a discount on books.
The channel reached one million subscribers.
The service is only available to registered subscribers.
The decline in print subscribers forced the newspaper to go digital.
armB.mnemonic: جاية من 'Sub' 'تحت' و 'Scribe' 'يكتب'.. يعني كتبت اسمك تحت العقد واشتركت.

armA.definition: An opening into a building or room that is closed by a barrier.
armA.arabic: مدخل الغرفة أو المبنى، وهو الفتحة في الجدار التي يثبت فيها الباب وتسمح بالدخول أو الخروج.
examples: A tall man was standing silently in the doorway.
She paused in the doorway before stepping out into the heavy rain.
Please move your bicycle away from the doorway so people can pass.
armA.mnemonic: تتكون الكلمة ببساطة من "door" باب و "way" طريق أو ممر، وتذكرك بأنها الممر المخصص للمرور عبر الباب.

armB.definition: The opening where a door is, or the passage into a room.
armB.arabic: الفتحة اللي فيها الباب، أو المدخل اللي بتعدي منه عشان تدخل الأوضة.
examples: He stood in the doorway.
The cat sat in the doorway watching us.
Please don't block the doorway with your bags.
She paused in the doorway to look back at the room.
The beggar sought shelter in the doorway of the shop.
The magnificent arched doorway hinted at the grandeur inside.
armB.mnemonic: هي طريق 'Way' الباب 'Door'.. يعني الفتحة أو الـ 'Doorway' اللي بتدخل منها.

armA.definition: The way in which a word or language is spoken.
armA.arabic: طريقة نطق الكلمات أو إخراج أصوات الحروف في لغة معينة.
examples: Good pronunciation helps other people understand you easily.
Her English pronunciation improved after living in London.
Listen to the audio recording to check the correct pronunciation of the word.
armA.mnemonic: تذكر ان الفعل هو "pronounce" باضافة "ou" بينما الاسم يكتب "pronun" بدون حرف "o" في الوسط ليركز على طريقة الصوت

armB.definition: The way in which a word is spoken or sounded.
armB.arabic: طريقة نطق الكلمات.. إزاي تطلع صوت الكلمة صح.
examples: His pronunciation is good.
We practice pronunciation in class.
English pronunciation can be difficult.
She has a clear pronunciation of French words.
The standard pronunciation varies by region.
Phonetics is the scientific study of pronunciation.
armB.mnemonic: الاسم من 'Pronounce'.. ركّز في الـ 'Pronunciation' عشان الناس تفهمك صح.

armA.definition: The process of using your mind to consider ideas, solve problems, or form opinions.
armA.arabic: عملية التفكير واستخدام العقل لتحليل الأمور أو اتخاذ القرارات أو تكوين رأي معين.
examples: Critical thinking helps students make better decisions.
What is the thinking behind your new proposal?
His clear thinking impressed everyone in the meeting.

armB.definition: The process of using one's mind to consider or reason about something.
armB.arabic: التفكير. عملية تشغيل الدماغ عشان تفهم أو تحل حاجة.
examples: I am thinking.
What is your thinking on this?
We need some fresh thinking.
Critical thinking is an important skill.
His thinking was influenced by Greek philosophy.
Paradigm shifts often require a fundamental change in thinking.
armB.mnemonic: من 'Think' 'يفكر'.. الـ 'Thinking' هو التفكير نفسه

armA.definition: To stimulate or give rise to a reaction or emotion, typically a strong or unwelcome one.
armA.arabic: إنك تستفز حد وتخليه يتعصب أو تثير رد فعل معين منه، زي لما تضايق حد عشان يغلط.
examples: Do not provoke the dog.
He tried to provoke me into a fight.
The article was written to provoke discussion.
Her speech provoked a strong reaction from the crowd.
The new tax policy provoked widespread criticism.
Certain chemicals can provoke an allergic response in sensitive individuals.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Provoke' قريبة من 'Volcano' 'بركان'.. لما تعمل 'Provoke' لحد بتخليه ينفجر زي البركان.

armB.definition: To cause a particular reaction, emotion, or anger, often deliberately.
armB.arabic: يستفز شخصا لدفعه إلى الغضب، أو يثير رد فعل قوي أو مشاعر محددة.
examples: His sarcastic remarks were meant to provoke an angry reaction.
The proposed tax reform will likely provoke widespread protests across the country.
Be careful with your tone so you do not provoke an unnecessary argument.
armB.mnemonic: تذكر المقطع اللاتيني pro ويعني للأمام و voke من الصوت مثل voice فالمعنى إطلاق الصوت للأمام لاستفزاز الآخرين وإثارة غضبهم.

armA.definition: To increase greatly in number or quantity; to perform the mathematical operation of multiplication.
armA.arabic: يضاعف أو يضرب الأرقام. يعني يخلي الحاجة تزيد كتير، أو يعمل عملية الضرب في الحساب.
examples: Can you multiply five by two?
Rabbits multiply very quickly.
If you multiply the width by the length, you get the area.
Our profits have multiplied since we started the online store.
The risks multiply when you ignore safety regulations.
Bacteria can multiply exponentially under favorable conditions.
armA.mnemonic: كلمة 'Multi' يعني كتير.. فالـ 'Multiply' يعني بتخلي الحاجة تزيد وتبقى كتير

armB.definition: To increase greatly in number or amount, or to calculate the total of repeated additions.
armB.arabic: يعني أن يزيد الشيء ويتضاعف بشكل ملحوظ، أو يقوم بعملية الضرب الحسابية في الرياضيات.
examples: If you multiply four by five, the answer is twenty.
Bacteria can multiply rapidly in warm and moist environments.
Without clear regulations, minor administrative problems will quickly multiply across the company.
armB.mnemonic: تذكر الكلمة الشائعة "multi" التي تعني متعدد، فالفعل يعني أن تجعل الشيء متعددا وكثيرا.

armA.definition: A close-fitting piece of clothing that covers the foot and leg, usually worn by women.
armA.arabic: لباس ضيق يغطي القدم والساق وغالبا ما ترتديه النساء، أو جورب طويل يعلق للزينة في الأعياد لوضع الهدايا بداخله.
examples: She noticed a small tear running down her nylon stocking.
The child hung a large red stocking above the fireplace on Christmas Eve.
A silk stocking was traditionally a luxury item before modern synthetic fabrics.
armA.mnemonic: تخيل انك تخزن اشياء او تملأ مخزونك stock داخل جورب طويل معلق على الحائط مثل stocking المليء بالهدايا

armB.definition: A close-fitting covering for the foot and leg, usually for women.
armB.arabic: شراب طويل وحريمي، غالباً بيكون خفيف وشفاف، أو الشراب الكبير اللي بيتعلق في الكريسماس.
examples: She wears stockings.
I need a new pair of stockings.
He hung his Christmas stocking by the fire.
Nylon stockings became popular in the 1940s.
The bank robber wore a stocking over his face.
She adjusted the seam of her silk stocking.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'Stock' يعني مخزون.. زمان كانوا بيحوشوا الفلوس في الـ 'Stocking'.

armA.definition: The action of creating or expressing an idea, plan, or statement in a precise, systematic way.
armA.arabic: عملية صياغة أو إعداد فكرة أو خطة أو سياسة بأسلوب منظم ودقيق، أو التعبير عنها بكلمات محددة.
examples: The committee met to work on the formulation of a new foreign policy.
Clear formulation of your research questions will save valuable time later.
Scientists developed an improved formulation for the medical treatment.
armA.mnemonic: تذكر كلمة "formula" اي صيغة رياضية محددة واضف عليها اللاحقة "tion" لتدل على عملية بناء وصياغة الافكار بدقة

armB.definition: The act of creating or preparing something, or a mixture prepared according to a formula.
armB.arabic: صياغة فكرة أو تركيبة دواء أو منتج. الطريقة اللي بتركب بيها الحاجات مع بعض عشان تطلع نتيجة.
examples: This is a new soap formulation.
The formulation of the plan took two days.
Doctors are testing a new vaccine formulation.
The formulation of company policy requires careful thought.
His precise formulation of the argument impressed the judges.
Complex chemical formulations are protected by strict patents.
armB.mnemonic: جاية من 'Formula' يعني معادلة.. الـ 'Formulation' هي 'التركيبة' اللي بتعملها عشان تطلع دواء أو خطة.

armA.definition: A sudden, short intake of breath, as in shock or surprise.
armA.arabic: الشهقة اللي بتطلع منك فجأة لما تتخض أو تتفاجأ بحاجة.
examples: She gave a loud gasp.
He let out a gasp of surprise.
There was a collective gasp from the audience.
She took a sharp gasp of air.
His last gasp was one of relief.
The dying industry is on its last gasp.
armA.mnemonic: افتكر 'Gas' 'غاز'.. لما تشم ريحة غاز قوية بتعمل 'Gasp' وتكتم نفسك.

armB.definition: A short, sudden intake of breath, often caused by surprise, shock, pain, or physical exhaustion.
armB.arabic: شهقة مفاجئة وسريعة لسحب الهواء إلى الرئتين، تحدث غالبا بسبب الصدمة أو المفاجأة أو الألم الشديد.
examples: A sharp gasp of surprise echoed through the room when the lights went out.
The injured runner took a painful gasp of air before continuing the race.
She drew a sudden gasp when she heard the unexpected announcement.
armB.mnemonic: تخيل شخصا انقطع نفسه فجأة ونطق صوت "gasp" وهو يشهق بشدة من المفاجأة.

armA.definition: In an unwilling and hesitant way.
armA.arabic: لما تعمل حاجة وإنت مش عايز تعملها، بتعملها بتقل وبدون نفس.
examples: He went reluctantly.
She reluctantly said yes.
I reluctantly agreed to help him.
They reluctantly accepted the offer.
The government reluctantly admitted its mistake.
He reluctantly relinquished control of the company he founded.
armA.mnemonic: 'Reluctant' قريبة من 'Lock'.. كأنك 'Locked' ومجبر تعمل الحاجة فبتعملها 'Reluctantly'.

armB.definition: In an unwilling or hesitant manner.
armB.arabic: بشكل يعكس عدم الرغبة أو التردد في فعل شيء ما، مع القيام به في النهاية على مضض.
examples: He reluctantly agreed to sign the revised contract.
She reluctantly packed her bags and prepared to leave.
The committee reluctantly accepted the chairman's resignation after a heated debate.
armB.mnemonic: تذكر ان الجذر اللاتيني في "reluctantly" يرتبط بالمقاومة والصراع الداخلي ضد القيام بالفعل، فتفعله على مضض وكره.

armA.definition: A small vehicle with wheels that you push to carry food, luggage, or shopping.
armA.arabic: عربة صغيرة ذات عجلات تُدفع باليد لنقل البضائع في المتجر أو الحقائب في المطار أو تقديم الطعام.
examples: He pushed the heavy shopping trolley down the supermarket aisle.
You can use a luggage trolley to carry your bags through the airport.
The flight attendant wheeled the drink trolley along the narrow cabin.
armA.mnemonic: تخيل انك تجر او تدحرج عربة التسوق وتلف بها رول في المتجر لتتذكر كلمة trolley

armB.definition: A cart on wheels used for transporting items, or a streetcar.
armB.arabic: العربية اللي بعجل زي عربية السوبر ماركت أو عربية نقل الشنط.
examples: I need a trolley for my bags.
Put the food in the shopping trolley.
The waiter brought the dessert trolley.
She loaded her luggage onto the airport trolley.
The hospital patient was moved on a trolley.
The city restored the vintage electric trolley for tourists.
armB.mnemonic: جاية من 'Roll' 'يتدحرج'.. الـ 'Trolley' بيمشي على عجل و 'Rolls'.

armA.definition: Cold and miserable; without hope or encouragement (for situations or weather).
armA.arabic: وصف للمكان البارد الكئيب اللي مفيهوش حياة، أو للمستقبل اللي مفيهوش أمل.
examples: The winter weather was cold and bleak.
The room looked bleak with no furniture.
It was a bleak day with heavy rain.
The company faces a bleak future if sales don't improve.
The report paints a bleak picture of the economy.
In the bleak midwinter, the wind moaned through the trees.
armA.mnemonic: اربطها بكلمة 'Block'.. لما الدنيا تكون مسدودة 'Block' قدامك، المستقبل بيبقى 'Bleak' وكئيب.

armB.definition: Offering little or no hope, warmth, or encouragement; cold, grim, and depressing.
armB.arabic: يصف شيئا كئيبا وميؤوسا منه لا يبعث على التفاؤل، سواء كان مشهدا طبيعيا قاحلا وباردا أو مستقبلا مظلما بلا أمل.
examples: The economic forecast looks bleak, with inflation rising and business investment falling sharply.
They wandered across the bleak, windswept landscape without finding any sign of shelter.
Without adequate funding, the future of the medical research project remains bleak.
armB.mnemonic: تذكر كلمة "bleak" بربطها بكلمة "black"، فكلاهما يصف شيئا مظلما، كئيبا، وخاليا من الأمل.

armA.definition: To openly resist or refuse to obey.
armA.arabic: إنك تتحدى حد أو ترفض تطيع الأوامر علناً. أو إن حاجة تكون صعبة جداً وتتحدى الوصف.
examples: I will defy him.
Do not defy the rules.
She decided to defy her parents' wishes.
The beauty of the scene defies description.
His actions defy all logic and reason.
A few brave souls dared to defy the tyrant's orders.
armA.mnemonic: لما تعمل 'Defy' للقانون، إنت بتقول 'De-fine' 'بتحدد' قانونك الخاص وبترفض تمشي وراهم.

armB.definition: To refuse openly to obey a person, rule, or authority, or to resist something successfully.
armB.arabic: ان يتحدى شخصا او يرفض الانصياع لسلطة او قانون بشكل علني وصريح، او يقاوم امرا ما بنجاح.
examples: They chose to defy the curfew and protest peacefully in the streets.
Some rare natural phenomena seem to defy all known scientific explanations.
Do not defy your manager if you want to keep your position at the company.
armB.mnemonic: تذكر كلمة "defend" الدفاع، فمن يقوم بفعل "defy" يقف مدافعا عن موقفه ويرفض الانصياع والتراجع.

armA.definition: Not taking into account; regardless of.
armA.arabic: كلمة بنستخدمها لما نقول إن في حاجة هتحصل مهما كانت الظروف أو العوامل التانية.
examples: Everyone can come, irrespective of age.
We play outside irrespective of the weather.
The rules apply to everyone, irrespective of their job.
The bonus is paid irrespective of the company's profits.
We must uphold human rights irrespective of political differences.
The law mandates equal treatment irrespective of race, creed, or color.
armA.mnemonic: 'Ir-' نفي + 'Respective' اعتبار.. يعني من غير أي اعتبار للظروف، 'بغض النظر'.

armB.definition: Without considering or being influenced by particular conditions, facts, or situations.
armB.arabic: تستخدم عادة مع حرف الجر of لتعني بغض النظر عن أو بصرف النظر عن، أي دون أن يتأثر الحكم أو الفعل بالظروف المذكورة.
examples: The competition is open to all applicants, irrespective of their age or background.
Irrespective of the final outcome, the team should be proud of their effort.
Every citizen is entitled to equal protection under the law, irrespective of social status.
armB.translations: بِغَضِّ النَّظَرِ عَنْ / بِصَرْفِ النَّظَرِ عَنْ
armB.mnemonic: تتكون الكلمة من البادئة "ir" بمعنى لا، والكلمة "respect" بمعنى اعتبار أو مراعاة، فتصبح دون اعتبار لأي شيء أو بغض النظر عنه.

armA.definition: Used to introduce the second element or clause in a comparison.
armA.arabic: أداة ربط تُستخدم للمقارنة بين شيئين أو شخصين أو فكرتين، بمعنى مِن أو بالمقارنة مع.
examples: She runs faster than I do.
The test was easier than we expected.
He would rather read books than watch movies.
armA.mnemonic: تذكر حرف a في كلمة "than" لتربطها بالمقارنة comparison على عكس كلمة "then" التي تحتوي على e وتعني الوقت.

armB.definition: Used to introduce the second part of a comparison.
armB.arabic: كلمة بنستخدمها للمقارنة بين حاجتين، بمعنى 'من' أو 'عن' لما نقول حاجة أكبر أو أصغر من حاجة.
examples: She is older than me.
I like tea more than coffee.
It is better to give than to receive.
The results were much better than we expected.
He is more of a poet than a musician.
Scarcely had we arrived than the storm broke.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'Than' فيها حرف 'A' زي كلمة 'After'.. يعني اللي بيجي بعدها هو اللي بنقارن بيه.

armA.definition: The act of putting something into something else, or something that is added inside.
armA.arabic: عملية إدخال أو إدراج شيء داخل شيء آخر، أو الشيء المُدرَج نفسه كإضافة نص أو أداة طبية.
examples: Careful insertion of the needle helps minimize patient discomfort.
The editor approved the insertion of an extra paragraph to clarify the point.
The sudden insertion of new rules caused confusion among the staff.
armA.mnemonic: تذكر الفعل الشائع "insert" بمعنى يدخل، واللاحقة "tion" تحوله ببساطة إلى اسم يدل على عملية الإدخال أو الإدراج.

armB.definition: The action of inserting something.
armB.arabic: عملية إدخال أو إدراج حاجة جوه حاجة تانية، زي إضافة كلمة في نص أو وضع شريحة في جهاز.
examples: The insertion of the key opened the door.
Check the insertion of the battery.
The insertion of a new clause changed the contract.
Surgical insertion of the device took two hours.
The text required the insertion of several footnotes.
The strategic insertion of troops turned the tide of the battle.
armB.mnemonic: الفعل 'Insert' 'يدخل'.. الـ 'Insertion' هي عملية الإدخال نفسها.

armA.definition: An unborn offspring in the process of development; an early stage of something.
armA.arabic: الجنين في مراحله الأولى خالص قبل ما يتكون شكله الكامل، أو بداية أي فكرة.
examples: The egg has an embryo.
We studied the chicken embryo.
The doctor checked the health of the embryo.
The project is still in embryo.
Human embryo research is a controversial topic.
The idea of democracy was present in embryo in ancient Greece.

armB.definition: An animal or human in the earliest stages of development before birth or hatching.
armB.arabic: كائن حي، كالإنسان أو الحيوان، في أولى مراحل تكوّنه ونموه قبل الولادة أو الفقس؛ ويُطلق مجازياً على الفكرة أو المشروع في بداياته الأولى.
examples: The fertility clinic carefully monitored the development of each embryo.
During the first eight weeks, the developing human is scientifically referred to as an embryo.
Their business plan was still only an embryo when they secured initial funding.
armB.mnemonic: تذكر بداية الكلمة em تشبه كلمة embedded اي مغروس بالداخل واللاحقة bryo يونانية تعني ينمو او ينتفخ فالكلمة تعني الكائن الصغير المنغرس في بداية نموه

armA.definition: Something that is morally right, beneficial, or helpful to people.
armA.arabic: الخير أو النفع؛ كل ما يحقق الفائدة أو الصلاح الأخلاقي للأفراد أو المجتمع.
examples: She dedicated her entire career to doing good for others.
The money was raised for the public good.
He tried to explain the difference between good and evil.
armA.mnemonic: تذكر ان كلمة "good" كاسم تعني الخير ذاته، مثل عبارة فعل الخير doing good التي تكرر دائما في الاعمال الإنسانية.

armB.definition: That which is morally right; righteousness.
armB.arabic: الخير نفسه، عكس الشر. أو ممكن تيجي بمعنى الفايدة والمصلحة.
examples: Good always wins in stories.
Do good and good will come to you.
We must work for the common good.
There is a lot of good in him.
The debate between good and evil is eternal.
Utilitarianism focuses on the greatest good for the greatest number.
armB.mnemonic: كلمة 'Good' قريبة من 'Gold' 'ذهب'.. الذهب معدن 'Good' وقيمته عالية.

armA.definition: Happening as a minor accompaniment to something else; not the main part.
armA.arabic: حاجة بتحصل بالصدفة أو كشيء جانبي مش أساسي مع حاجة تانية.
examples: Small costs are incidental.
The problem was incidental to the main issue.
We have some incidental expenses on the trip.
Any resemblance to real persons is purely incidental.
The discovery was incidental to their main research.
Cognitive development is not merely incidental to physical growth.
armA.mnemonic: جاية من 'Incident' 'حادثة/واقعة'.. الـ 'Incidental' هو الشيء العارِض اللي بيحصل على الهامش.

armB.definition: Happening as a minor secondary result of something more important, rather than as the main part.
armB.arabic: يصف شيئا يحدث كأمر ثانوي أو جانبي مصاحب لحدث رئيسي، وليس هو الهدف الأساسي أو الأهم.
examples: The company agreed to reimburse employees for travel and any incidental expenses.
Any health benefits gained from the job were purely incidental to her main purpose of earning money.
In criminal law, incidental damage must be carefully distinguished from deliberate intent.
armB.mnemonic: تذكر كلمة "incident" التي تعني حدثا عارضا؛ إضافة اللاحقة تجعلها تصف ما هو ثانوي وعارض وليس أساسيا.

armA.definition: Able to express ideas and feelings clearly, fluently, and effectively in speech or writing.
